source_file: ACC清分管理系统操作手册-en-translation.txt
content: ##ACC清分管理系统操作手册 目的 为规范温州市铁路与轨道交通投资集团有限公司运营分公司（以下简称“运营分公司”）的ACC清分管理系统操作流程，保证系统安全，特编制本手册。 适用范围 本操作手册适用于运营分公司ACC清分管理系统相关业务工作。 引用文本 下列引用文件中的条款通过本规章的引用成为本规章的条款。 《票务管理规则》WTTYY/KYB(I)/KY-006-01 用户操作 登录系统 业务描述 登录清分规则管理工作台选择界面，选择某个功能模块以进行下一步操作。 用户操作 登录系统 操作说明 鼠标双击安装目录下的，启动清分管理中心，出现如下图所示的启动界面： 启动成功后进入用户登录界面，如下图所示： 输入正确的用户编号和密码后，单击按钮后，可进入工作台选择界面，点击按钮，关闭登录界面并取消登录。 若输入的用户编号正确密码有误时，提示如下图所示信息： 若输入的用户编号有误密码正确时，提示如下图所示信息： 当连续输入错误的操作员编号或密码超过参数规定的次数时，系统将自动退出并关闭登录界面，提示信息如下图所示： ##ACC清分管理系统操作手册 用户操作 基本规则设置 业务描述 编辑和维护模拟乘客选择路径所需的基本信息，从而生成有效路径，及清分比例。 用户操作 基本规则设置 操作界面 在图3-3工作台选择界面中，点击进入基本规则管理子模块。如下图所示的工作界面： 其中： 功能导航区：可切换至相应的功能模块； 主操作区：完成当前模块下的主要操作以及对应的界面显示； 状态栏：当前系统的各种状态信息。 用户操作 基本规则设置 操作界面 功能导航 点击相应的TAB标签，可以切换至相应的模块界面。 用户操作 基本规则设置 操作界面 状态栏 状态栏用于描述当前系统的各种实时状态信息，如下图所示： 其中： 数据库连接状态：实时显示工作台与数据库的连接状态。 当前登录用户：显示登录该工作台的用户的用户名称。 当前系统时间：工作台所在设备的时间。 ##ACC清分管理系统操作手册

content: 用户操作 基本规则设置 清分算法参数 业务描述 新增编辑换乘因子及有效路径参数配置 用户操作 基本规则设置 清分算法参数 操作说明 在图3-7中，点击“清分算法参数”标签，进入清分算法参数界面，如图所示： 用户操作 基本规则设置 清分算法参数 参数配置 点击，弹出参数配置框口，如图所示页面： 输入路径选择概率敏感度，选择有效路径筛选倍增阈值、有效路径筛选增长阈值、有效路径允许最大数量，点击按钮，页面关闭，有效路径参数配置成功；点击，取消操作。 用户操作 基本规则设置 清分算法参数 查询 点击，查询显示所有的换乘因子配置信息，如下图所示： 若满足条件的记录多于一页时，翻页查询操作区功能将变为可用。点击跳转到首页，跳转到上一页，跳转到下一页，跳转到尾页。在页码输入区指定要查看的页码，点击按钮，可以跳转到指定的页码。 ##ACC清分管理系统操作手册 用户操作 基本规则设置 清分算法参数 新增 点击，弹出新增换乘因子对话框，如图所示： 输入换乘因子信息，点击按钮，系统会自动检测输入值的合法性，不合法时弹出相应的提示信息；合法时弹出新增换乘因子成功的提示信息，如图所示： 用户操作 基本规则设置 清分算法参数 修改 在图换乘因子查询界面中，选择一条换乘因子信息，点击，弹出修改因子对话框，如图所示修改换乘因子界面： 修改换乘因子信息后，点击按钮，系统自动检测输入的换乘因子信息的合法性，信息不合法时会弹出相应的提示信息；信息合法，弹出修改换乘因子信息成功的提示信息，如图所示： 用户操作 基本规则设置 清分算法参数 删除 删除换乘因子相关的配置。 在换乘因子查询界面中，选择一条换乘因子信息，点击，弹出如图所示询问框： 点击，删除该换乘因子配置信息；点击，取消删除操作。 ##ACC清分管理系统操作手册 用户操作 基本规则设置 收益方信息 业务描述 编辑并显示收益方信息。

content: 用户操作 基本规则设置 收益方信息 操作说明 在图3-7工作界面中，点击“收益方信息”标签，进入收益方信息界面，如图所示： 用户操作 基本规则设置 收益方信息 查询收益方 点击，查询显示所有的收益方配置信息，如图所示： 若满足条件的记录多于一页时，翻页查询操作区功能将变为可用。点击跳转到首页，跳转到上一页，跳转到下一页，跳转到尾页。在页码输入区指定要查看的页码，点击按钮，可以跳转到指定的页码。 用户操作 基本规则设置 收益方信息 新增收益方 点击，弹出新增收益方对话框，如图所示： 输入收益方信息，点击按钮，系统会自动检测输入值的合法性，不合法时弹出相应的提示信息；合法时弹出新增收益方成功的提示信息，如图所示： ##ACC清分管理系统操作手册 用户操作 基本规则设置 收益方信息 修改收益方 在收益方查询界面中，选择一条收益方信息，点击，弹出如图所示修改收益方界面： 修改收益方信息后，点击按钮，系统自动检测输入的收益方信息的合法性，信息不合法时会弹出相应的提示信息；信息合法，弹出修改收益方信息成功的提示信息，如图所示： 用户操作 基本规则设置 收益方信息 删除收益方 在图3-19收益方查询界面中，选择一条收益方信息，点击，弹出如图3-24所示询问框： 点击，删除该收益方配置信息；点击，取消删除操作。 ##ACC清分管理系统操作手册 用户操作 基本规则设置 线路信息 业务描述 编辑并显示线路信息。 用户操作 基本规则设置 线路信息 操作说明 在工作界面中，点击“线路信息”标签，进入线路信息界面，如图所示： 用户操作 基本规则设置 线路信息 查询线路 点击，查询显示所有的线路配置信息，如图所示： 若满足条件的记录多于一页时，翻页查询操作区功能将变为可用。点击跳转到首页，跳转到上一页，跳转到下一页，跳转到尾页。在页码输入区指定要查看的页码，点击按钮，可以跳转到指定的页码。

content: 用户操作 基本规则设置 线路信息 新增线路 点击，弹出新增线路对话框，如图所示： 输入线路信息，点击按钮，系统会自动检测输入值的合法性，不合法时弹出相应的提示信息；合法时弹出新增线路成功的提示信息，如图所示： 用户操作 基本规则设置 线路信息 修改线路 在线路信息查询界面中，选择一条线路信息，点击，弹出如图所示修改线路界面： 修改线路信息后，点击按钮，系统自动检测输入的线路信息的合法性，信息不合法时会弹出相应的提示信息；信息合法，弹出修改线路信息成功的提示信息，如图所示： 用户操作 基本规则设置 线路信息 删除线路 在线路信息查询界面中，选择一条线路信息，点击，弹出如图所示询问框： 点击，删除该线路配置信息；点击，取消删除操作。 ##ACC清分管理系统操作手册 用户操作 基本规则设置 车站信息 业务描述 编辑并显示车站信息。 用户操作 基本规则设置 车站信息 操作说明 在工作界面中，点击“车站信息”标签，进入车站信息界面，如图所示： 用户操作 基本规则设置 车站信息 查询车站 点击，查询显示所有的车站配置信息，如图所示： 若满足条件的记录多于一页时，翻页查询操作区功能将变为可用。点击跳转到首页，跳转到上一页，跳转到下一页，跳转到尾页。在页码输入区指定要查看的页码，点击按钮，可以跳转到指定的页码。 用户操作 基本规则设置 车站信息 新增车站 点击，弹出新增车站对话框，如图所示： 输入车站信息，点击按钮，系统会自动检测输入值的合法性，不合法时弹出相应的提示信息；合法时弹出新增车站成功的提示信息，如图所示： 用户操作 基本规则设置 车站信息 修改车站 在车站查询界面中，选择一条车站信息，点击，弹出修改车站信息对话框，如图所示： 修改车站信息后，点击按钮，系统自动检测输入的车站信息的合法性，信息不合法时会弹出相应的提示信息；信息合法，弹出修改车站信息成功的提示信息，如图所示： ##ACC清分管理系统操作手册

content: 用户操作 基本规则设置 车站信息 删除车站 在车站查询界面中，选择一条车站信息，点击，弹出如图所示询问框： 点击，删除该车站配置信息；点击，取消删除操作。 用户操作 基本规则设置 车站信息 同站分配 在车站查询界面中，选择一条车站信息，点击，弹出同站分配对话框，如图所示： 点击，弹出新增收益方对话框，如图所示： 选择收益方，输入分配比例，点击按钮，系统会自动检测输入值的合法性，不合法时弹出相应的提示信息；合法时弹出新增收益方成功的提示信息。 在同站分配界面中，选择一条收益方信息，点击，弹出同站分配比例调整对话框，如图所示： 修改收益方信息后，点击按钮，系统自动检测输入的收益方信息的合法性，信息不合法时会弹出相应的提示信息；信息合法，弹出修改收益方信息成功的提示信息。 在同站分配界面中，选择一条收益方信息，点击，弹出确定要删除选择的记录的提示信息，如图所示： 点击，删除该收益方分配比例配置信息；点击，取消删除操作。 点击按钮，系统自动检测输入的收益方信息的合法性，信息不合法时会弹出相应的提示信息；信息合法，弹出保存收益方信息成功的提示信息。 ##ACC清分管理系统操作手册 用户操作 基本规则设置 车站信息 收益方配置 在图3-33中，选择非虚拟站，点击，弹出收益方配置对话框，如图所示： 点击，弹出新增收益方对话框，如图所示： 选择收益方/编号，点击按钮，信息新增成功，提示信息如下： 说明：一个车站只能配置一个收益方。 在图中，选择一条收益方配置，点击，弹出确定要删除选择的记录的提示信息，如图所示： 点击，删除该收益方配置信息；点击，取消删除操作。 用户操作 基本规则设置 车站信息 有效性检查 点击，弹出确定要进行有效性检查提示信息，如图所示： 点击按钮，系统自动检测车站收益方信息的合法性，信息不合法时会弹出相应的提示信息；信息合法，弹出有效性检查成功的提示信息，如图所示： ##ACC清分管理系统操作手册 用户操作 基本规则设置 路段信息 业务描述 编辑并显示路段信息。 用户操作 基本规则设置 路段信息 操作说明 在工作界面中，点击“路段信息”标签，进入路段信息界面，如图所示： 用户操作 基本规则设置 路段信息 查询路段

|维保单位|维保单位人员|接报生产调度通知，自动成立抢修小组，工班长为抢修负责人，第一时间组织人员携带应急抢修工器具及相关备品备件赶赴现场。先期到达现场的工班人员为临时抢修负责人。抢修小组赶赴现场途中由应急抢修负责人做好人员分工，并及时与客运人员、ACC维护工班、临时抢修负责人进行对接，开展故障排查。将故障情况上报科室工程师。临时抢修负责人前往车控室报备，初步排查设备故障原因。抢修负责人到达现场后，临时抢修负责人与抢修负责人进行交接，统一由抢修负责人进行指挥。抢修负责人确认故障情况，确认是线路设备故障后组织抢修人员按照“先通后复”原则，实施抢修。工程师提供技术支持并依据现场故障情况协调相关物资进行抢修。信息联络员及时向生产调度及领导小组汇报现场处置情况。故障恢复后，应急抢修负责人向应急领导小组报告设备抢修结束，并做好现场人员、工器具、材料出清工作。| ##AFC On-site disposal plan for large-area system failures 注意事项 票务中心人员要求 若多个不同等级的票务系统故障，按照“就高不就低”原则启动Ⅱ级响应。 ACC维护工班应正确记录现场处置过程中的时间节点及内容，并根据现场情况做好信息的续报工作。 注意事项 车站人员要求 若应急处置过程中发生岗位人员不足，由现场总指挥指定一名胜任的人兼任。 若多个车站发生不同等级的AFC系统大面积故障，按照“就高不就低”原则启动Ⅱ级响应。

source_file: AFC系统大面积故障现场处置方案-en-translation.txt
content: 值班站长应在故障发生后立即确认进站客流，视情况向邻站请求支援。值班站长统一安排支援人员及驻站人员工作。车站应做好大客流配套预案发布准备工作。 值班员及站务员须确保票务安全，对车站边门严格把控。 值班员正确记录现场处置过程中的时间节点及内容。 车站应根据现场情况做好信息的续报工作。 全线AFC设备故障时，原则上各站统一售卖纸票，若持纸票乘客超程，按单程票计费方式补收超程费。 ##AFC On-site disposal plan for large-area system failures 注意事项 OCC要求 售卖纸票必须报OCC，由OCC通知全线各站做好人工检票准备工作。 注意事项 维保单位维修人员要求 涉及到电路故障处置时，维修工班人员必须验明无电后进行作业，保证双人作业，一人作业一人监护。 维修工班人员在作业区域应做好维修告示，避免乘客进入作业区域。 Supplementary Provisions 本现场处置方案由运营分公司客运部负责解释，并自发布之日起实行，原规章《AFC系统大面积故障现场处置方案》（WTTYY/KYB(Ⅲ)/YJ-005-02）同时废止。 如AFC 系统大面积故障现场处置方案与国家法律、法规、标准有冲突的地方，按照国家法律、法规、标准相关规定执行。

content: ##S2线施工管理规则 Purpose In order to standardize the construction organization and management of Wenzhou Municipal Railway S2 Line (hereinafter referred to as "S2 Line"), clarify the operation process and requirements of relevant posts, highlight the safety and planning of construction, strengthen the control of the construction process, and ensure that all

source_file: S2线施工管理规则-en-translation.txt
content: construction is carried out in a safe, orderly, standardized and efficient manner, the construction management rules of the S2 line are specially formulated. Scope of application The construction management rules of S2 line are applicable to the maintenance, inspection, repair and construction of driving equipment and service facilities and equipment

source_file: S2线施工管理规则-en-translation.txt
content: within the scope of S2 line, the operation of engineering trains, commissioning train operations, and the management of construction such as entering the rail area to carry out training. Cite text "Urban Rail Transit Driving Organization Rules" JT/T1185-2018

source_file: S2线施工管理规则-en-translation.txt
content: Define the rail travel area and the upper projection area It refers to the area within the building limit of the main line, wiring and depot line. Among them, the construction of platform lines within 1 meter of the edge of the station platform (including the upward projection area) is

source_file: S2线施工管理规则-en-translation.txt
content: included in the management of the rail area. Definition of a parking lot It refers to the collective term of depot and parking lot. Define the outer unit It refers to units other than operating branches and long-term outsourcing units (vehicle maintenance units, equipment and facility maintenance units, other designated

source_file: S2线施工管理规则-en-translation.txt
content: units, etc.). Define maintenance units refers to equipment maintenance units and vehicle maintenance units. Define the centralized management department It refers to the department (center) where the maintenance unit supervises and manages the construction of external units. Define the person in charge of construction

source_file: S2线施工管理规则-en-translation.txt
content: It refers to the person who is fully responsible for the organization, safety and personnel management of construction operations. There is only one construction person in charge for each construction. Define the construction liaison

source_file: S2线施工管理规则-en-translation.txt
content: It refers to the personnel responsible for the construction organization, safety and management of other work sites outside the operation site where the construction person in charge is carried out at multiple locations. Define a weekly plan

source_file: S2线施工管理规则-en-translation.txt
content: It refers to a construction plan that includes one week, including all driving and non-driving commissioning or maintenance plans. Define a daily supplement plan It refers to the maintenance plan that is not included in the weekly plan and is supplemented or needs to be adjusted in the weekly plan.

source_file: S2线施工管理规则-en-translation.txt
content: Define a temporary repair plan It refers to the plan to continue operations after the end of the day's operation after professional handling and evaluation of equipment failures that affect driving or large-scale equipment failures affecting customer service. ##S2线施工管理规则 Define the master

source_file: S2线施工管理规则-en-translation.txt
content: It refers to the main station where the person in charge of construction handles the procedures for requesting the sale point within the relevant area of the operation. Define auxiliary stations

source_file: S2线施工管理规则-en-translation.txt
content: It means that when the same construction operation is carried out at multiple points, the place where each construction liaison except the main station handles the procedures for requesting the cancellation point is the auxiliary station. The auxiliary station of the request point and the pin point may not be in the same location. In principle, the number of auxiliary stations for the same construction operation shall not exceed 3. Class C construction plans do not set up auxiliary stations.

source_file: S2线施工管理规则-en-translation.txt
content: Define the clearance of the construction area It means that after the construction is completed, the construction person in charge/construction liaison confirms that all operators have been evacuated, relevant equipment and facilities have returned to normal, and all tools and materials have been removed. Definition Construction that affects driving

source_file: S2线施工管理规则-en-translation.txt
content: It refers to the construction that will be affected by normal operation if there are passenger trains, commissioning trains, and engineering trains running on the line on the same day or the next day. Definition of construction that affects passenger transport

source_file: S2线施工管理规则-en-translation.txt
content: It refers to the construction when the function of the station's passenger service equipment and facilities is reduced, and the passenger flow organization and service quality are affected. Define driving operations It refers to construction operations that require the operation of engineering trains, commissioning trains or the cooperation of trains.

source_file: S2线施工管理规则-en-translation.txt
content: Definition Long-term and large-scale construction It refers to the construction operation of the same continuous construction period of more than 2 weeks or more on the main line or depot. ##S2线施工管理规则 Define Unauthorized cancellation of the job

source_file: S2线施工管理规则-en-translation.txt
content: It refers to operations that have not been canceled by the "Daily Supplementary Plan Notice" under special circumstances. Define Unauthorized delay of the job It refers to the application for extension of construction work to 0CC/DCC 30 minutes in advance before the end of the planned time, and the construction

source_file: S2线施工管理规则-en-translation.txt
content: of the sales point is delayed without authorization. Define emergency repair jobs It refers to the operation of emergency repair that must be carried out immediately when the equipment failure affecting the driving or passenger service reaches the level I or II response. Define emergency maintenance operations

source_file: S2线施工管理规则-en-translation.txt
content: It refers to the operation of not interrupting the operation but requiring immediate repair when the equipment failure affecting the driving or passenger service does not reach the response level II or above. Define the emergency repair order number

source_file: S2线施工管理规则-en-translation.txt
content: It refers to the order number issued by 0CC/DCC to implement emergency repair in case of emergency. Define line network level construction It refers to the construction of operations that affect the operation of two or more lines or customer service. Define a common bridge segment

source_file: S2线施工管理规则-en-translation.txt
content: The two line track areas are in the same bridge section, but the section is not completely physically isolated. For S1 and S2 lines, the section from the airport to Liushi East (hereinafter referred to as the "Jiliu section") is a common bridge section, and the S1 mileage in this area is DK40+800-DK46+630, and the S2 mileage is K60+150-K54+350.

source_file: S2线施工管理规则-en-translation.txt
content: Define the main party of the activity The unit responsible for the specific implementation and management of line-network construction operations. Define the job helper The unit responsible for assisting the auxiliary management of line and network level construction operations. Define finite space

source_file: S2线施工管理规则-en-translation.txt
content: Limited space refers to a space that is closed or partially enclosed, relatively isolated from the outside world, narrow entrances and exits, workers cannot work inside for a long time, poor natural ventilation, and easy to cause toxic and harmful, flammable and explosive substances to accumulate or insufficient oxygen content.

content: ##S2线施工管理规则 Construction plan management plan classification Line network level construction plan classification Line network level construction is divided into two categories according to the scope of influence, line network primary construction and line network secondary construction. Primary construction of line network (Class S)

source_file: S2线施工管理规则-en-translation.txt
content: It refers to the operation of the online network management site, affecting the driving safety or passenger service of two or more lines, and the construction must be completed by both parties. Secondary construction of line network (Class D)

source_file: S2线施工管理规则-en-translation.txt
content: It refers to the operation of the online network management site, which only affects the driving safety or passenger service of one line, but requires the consent of the other party. Construction plan management Plan classification

source_file: S2线施工管理规则-en-translation.txt
content: Class S construction must obtain the construction person in charge certificate recognized by the line network management party, and submit the construction plan to the relevant departments of both companies, and obtain the consent of the construction management engineers of both companies before the construction can be effective. The operation code in the construction notice of both parties for S construction must be the same, and the operation code is SS + the affected line number + operation category + date + serial number, of which the line number is the main party of the operation. For example, SS12A1-01-01 means that it affects the first A1 construction of S1 and S2 on the 1st of a certain month, of which S1 is the main party of the operation.

source_file: S2线施工管理规则-en-translation.txt
content: Class D construction must obtain the construction person in charge certificate recognized by the company under the jurisdiction of the equipment, and submit the construction plan to the relevant department of the line operator under the jurisdiction of the equipment, but the construction can only be effective after obtaining the consent of the construction management engineers of both companies. The Class D construction code is DS+ the affected line number + operation category + date + serial number, of which the line number is the main party of the operation. For example, DS12A1-01-01 means that it affects Line S1 on the 1st of a certain month, and requires the consent of S2 Line for the first A1 construction, of which Line S1 is the main party of the operation.

source_file: S2线施工管理规则-en-translation.txt
content: ##S2线施工管理规则 Construction plan management Plan classification Within the scope of the common bridge section, in principle, the construction category and the power outage and transmission status of the two lines are the same, and the catenary implementation of the same stop and transmission and the protection of the ground wire

source_file: S2线施工管理规则-en-translation.txt
content: must be jointly confirmed and approved by both parties. When both parties handle A1 construction, except for special requirements (such as signal debugging), construction personnel are not allowed to carry out down-track operations.

source_file: S2线施工管理规则-en-translation.txt
content: Within the scope of the joint bridge section, when the two sides carry out engineering vehicle operations (the speed limit of the engineering vehicle is 25km/h) and need to cooperate with the power outage and ground line of the adjacent line, the adjacent line can arrange A2 manual points to cooperate according to the actual needs, and the construction leaders of both sides must manage the construction team in the area well, and prohibit either party from crossing the intermediate isolation zone and entering the other party's track area. Both construction plans must specify in detail that there are construction vehicles in operation, and cross-regional operations are prohibited.

source_file: S2线施工管理规则-en-translation.txt
content: An obvious dividing line should be divided between the two lines of the joint bridge section, and the dividing line shall not be crossed without authorization if the construction operation is not specially noted in the construction plan.

source_file: S2线施工管理规则-en-translation.txt
content: In principle, before 20:30 every day, the dispatchers of both sides of the line must confirm each other's construction plans and arrangements for urban EMUs/engineering vehicles and power supply in the line network management area on that day, and understand the operation content, scope of influence, protective measures, and risk points of construction operations.

source_file: S2线施工管理规则-en-translation.txt
content: For details of the construction management regulations at the line network level in Wenzhou, please refer to the "Wenzhou Rail Transit Line Network Operation and Scheduling Regulations". ##S2线施工管理规则 Construction plan management Plan declaration, approval and related regulations Construction plan declaration regulations

source_file: S2线施工管理规则-en-translation.txt
content: When the construction management system fails, it is necessary to fill in the "Weekly Plan Declaration Form" (see Appendix D of the S2 Line Construction Management Rules), "Daily Supplementary Plan Declaration Form" (see Appendix E of the S2 Line Construction Management Rules), "Temporary Repair Plan Declaration Form" (see Appendix F of the S2 Line Construction Management Rules), and affix the special electronic seal of the construction and submit it in the form of email.

source_file: S2线施工管理规则-en-translation.txt
content: In principle, A1, A2, A3, and C1 construction are not allowed to operate during operating hours. For construction operations belonging to the equipment under the jurisdiction of the environmental control dispatcher (hereinafter referred to as "environmental control") / power dispatcher (hereinafter referred to as "ESC"), it must indicate "contact environmental

content: control / ESC before operation" when declaring the construction plan. When submitting the plan, the words used refer to the technical equipment line in the S2 line driving organization rules and the technical appendix D of the S2 line driving organization rules for the S2 line to implement the comprehensive

content: layout diagram of Wenzhou rail transit S2 line. Where it is necessary to use the municipal EMU for commissioning, training or cooperative operation, the consent of the vehicle department shall be obtained before declaring the plan.

source_file: S2线施工管理规则-en-translation.txt
content: In principle, materials/tools are not allowed to be stored in the rail area, and when they must be stored under special circumstances, the centralized management department must fill in the "Application Form for the Storage of Materials/Tools Rail Area" (see Appendix G of the S2 Line Construction Management Rules) to apply to the Quality and Safety Department, and can only be stored after approval and approval. The materials stored by the construction unit in the track area must be firmly fixed and will not invade the driving limit, and indicate in the remarks column when submitting the plan.

source_file: S2线施工管理规则-en-translation.txt
content: ##S2线施工管理规则 Construction plan management Plan declaration, approval and related regulations Construction plan declaration regulations When the operation area includes the main line, wiring and part of the line of the parking lot (the main operation site is on the main line), such construction shall be declared according to the Class

source_file: S2线施工管理规则-en-translation.txt
content: A plan. When the operation area includes both the depot line, the main line, and part of the wiring line (the main operation site is in the depot), such construction shall be declared according to the Class B plan.

source_file: S2线施工管理规则-en-translation.txt
content: When the construction operation requires the cooperation of other departments, the operation department must send the cooperation requirements (plan) to the cooperation department for comments, and only after the approval of the cooperation department can the operation department declare the construction plan, and indicate the agreed cooperation in the remarks column of the "Weekly/Daily Supplementary/Temporary Repair Plan Declaration Form".

source_file: S2线施工管理规则-en-translation.txt
content: When submitting the plan, it is necessary to truthfully fill in all elements of the construction, among which the construction impact and other safety-related elements need to be clearly understood by the reporting department and noted.

source_file: S2线施工管理规则-en-translation.txt
content: After meeting the safety conditions for entering the track, there is no need to declare a construction plan, and with the consent of the driving dispatcher (hereinafter referred to as the "line adjustment") or the parking dispatcher (hereinafter referred to as the "field adjustment"), the personnel can get off the track after completing the registration and safety protection.

source_file: S2线施工管理规则-en-translation.txt
content: ##S2线施工管理规则 Construction plan management Plan declaration, approval and related regulations Construction plan declaration regulations Weekly plan declaration and approval process (Appendix A of the S2 line construction management rules) Before 15:00 every Monday, all departments must submit important plans for the next week (in principle, driving plans will be arranged

source_file: S2线施工管理规则-en-translation.txt
content: every Monday, Wednesday and Friday, and non-driving plans will be arranged on Tuesday, Thursday, Saturday and Saturday): Operations of urban EMUs or engineering trains need to be operated (the "A1 Operation Plan Form" needs to be filled in (see Appendix I of the S2 Line Construction Management Rules));

source_file: S2线施工管理规则-en-translation.txt
content: Power outage operations of 110kV main substations (excluding operations below 400V of main substations); Operations at interfaces involving two or more lines. After approval by the professional engineers of the department, it will be submitted to the construction management engineer of the dispatching department (it will not be accepted after

source_file: S2线施工管理规则-en-translation.txt
content: the deadline). Before 17:00 every Tuesday, each department shall submit its department's non-driving plan for the next week according to the important plan issued by the dispatching department. When there is a holiday, the weekly plan declaration must be completed one working day before the holiday or implemented according to

source_file: S2线施工管理规则-en-translation.txt
content: the temporary notice of the dispatch department. Every Wednesday, the dispatching department prepares the first draft of the construction plan for the next week according to the construction plan submitted by each department and construction unit.

source_file: S2线施工管理规则-en-translation.txt
content: Every Thursday, the dispatching department organizes a construction coordination meeting, and each department and construction unit arranges special personnel to participate on time. Before 17:00 every Friday, the dispatching department will issue the "Weekly Construction Driving Notice" according to the results of the construction coordination meeting.

source_file: S2线施工管理规则-en-translation.txt
content: The prepared "Weekly Construction Driving Notice" shall be submitted to the leader of the construction management working group for review, and after issuance, the construction management engineer of the dispatching department shall be responsible for distributing it, and the external unit shall be responsible for notifying the centralized management department.

source_file: S2线施工管理规则-en-translation.txt
content: ##S2线施工管理规则 Construction plan management Plan declaration, approval and related regulations Construction plan declaration regulations Daily supplementary plan declaration and approval process (Appendix B of the S2 line construction management rules)

source_file: S2线施工管理规则-en-translation.txt
content: The A/C1 daily supplementary plan must be reported to the construction management engineer department of the dispatching department before 15:00 on the construction day. The supplementary plan for Class B days must be reported to the vehicle department before 15:00 on the day before construction.

source_file: S2线施工管理规则-en-translation.txt
content: The daily supplementary plan for Saturday and Sunday should be declared before 15:00 on Friday; When there is a holiday, the declaration must be completed before 15:00 on the last working day before the holiday.

source_file: S2线施工管理规则-en-translation.txt
content: The A/C1 category shall be coordinated and arranged by the construction management engineer of the dispatching department according to the actual situation, and issued in the form of "Daily Supplementary Plan Notice (A/C1 Category)" before 17:30 on the construction day; Category B will be issued by the site before 17:30 on the day before construction in the form of "Daily Supplementary Plan Notice (Category B)".

source_file: S2线施工管理规则-en-translation.txt
content: Daily supplementary plans involving fault repairs should be prioritized and not limited by weekly schedules. In principle, the daily supplementary plan does not accept commissioning trains, engineering train operation projects and non-fault construction plans. ##S2线施工管理规则 Construction plan management Plan declaration, approval and related regulations Construction plan declaration regulations

source_file: S2线施工管理规则-en-translation.txt
content: Temporary repair plan declaration and approval process (Appendix C of the S2 line construction management rules) The temporary repair plan should be reported to the OCC duty officer or DCC site dispatch 3 hours before the start of the operation. After approval, it will be issued in the form of

source_file: S2线施工管理规则-en-translation.txt
content: a "Notice of Temporary Repair Plan". For the temporary repair plan during the non-operation period of the main line, the corresponding fault must have corresponding fault records and fault work orders in the fault system, or tasks assigned by the leader under special circumstances. When applying for a temporary repair

source_file: S2线施工管理规则-en-translation.txt
content: plan at the line network level, the main party of the operation shall initiate an application one hour before the start of the operation, and the construction plan can be issued only after the joint review of the relevant line duty director. If the equipment failure occurs within one hour

source_file: S2线施工管理规则-en-translation.txt
content: before the start of the construction skylight, the emergency repair process will be issued. Temporary repair plans should be prioritized and not limited by weekly and daily supplementary plans. ##S2线施工管理规则 Construction plan management Plan declaration, approval and related regulations Regulations on the declaration of construction plans of external units

source_file: S2线施工管理规则-en-translation.txt
content: Before entering the construction under the jurisdiction of the operating branch, the external unit must sign the "Safety Agreement" (Appendix D of the S2 Line Construction Management Rules) with the Quality and Safety Department of the operating branch with the construction plan, and the Quality and Safety Department will organize the training of the construction personnel of the external unit, and obtain the construction person in charge certificate issued by the Quality and Safety Department (Appendix E of the S2 Line Construction Management Rules) before being eligible to declare the construction plan.

source_file: S2线施工管理规则-en-translation.txt
content: The external unit submits the construction plan to the centralized management department, which is responsible for reviewing the construction plan, safety measures, impact and other cooperation, etc., and after the review is correct, the centralized management department selects the construction supervisor and submits the plan to the dispatch department or vehicle department. When the construction requires the cooperation of other departments, the centralized management department shall be responsible for coordination.

source_file: S2线施工管理规则-en-translation.txt
content: If the external unit cannot find the centralized management department to which the professional or equipment belongs, the leader of the construction leading group will designate the centralized management department to provide cooperation, and the centralized management department will be responsible for assisting the external unit to declare the construction operation plan.

source_file: S2线施工管理规则-en-translation.txt
content: External units carry out construction operations in accordance with the relevant provisions of the "S2 Line Construction Management Rules" and accept assessments according to the assessment indicators. The construction management process of external units is shown in Appendix F of the S2 line construction management rules. ##S2线施工管理规则

source_file: S2线施工管理规则-en-translation.txt
content: Construction plan management Plan declaration, approval and related regulations Construction plan declaration regulations of maintenance units Before entering the jurisdiction of the operating branch for construction, the maintenance unit must sign a "Safety Agreement" with the Quality and Safety Department of the operating branch.

source_file: S2线施工管理规则-en-translation.txt
content: The training and certification of the person in charge of construction of the maintenance unit shall be carried out in accordance with its regulations, and the list of qualified personnel shall be reported to the Quality and Safety Department of the operation branch, and the Quality and Safety Department shall notify the Dispatch Department, Passenger Transport Department, and Vehicle Department.

source_file: S2线施工管理规则-en-translation.txt
content: Each department of the maintenance unit directly submits the construction plan to the dispatch department and the vehicle department in accordance with the regulations on submitting various plans. Construction plan management Plan declaration, approval and related regulations Additional testing regulations

source_file: S2线施工管理规则-en-translation.txt
content: According to the requirements of signal and vehicle functional testing, the signal and vehicle specialty should be tested on the test line of the depot in principle. Special cases require testing on the main line:

source_file: S2线施工管理规则-en-translation.txt
content: Use the EMU in the depot or the non-passenger train returning to the main line as the test train, and the train will be organized by the traffic survey to follow the last train for testing, and the test car must ensure that it is at least "one station and one section" safe interval with the last train and shall not affect the operation of the main line and passenger transport services.

source_file: S2线施工管理规则-en-translation.txt
content: The additional test needs to be initiated by the on-board workshop or maintenance dispatcher to the relevant cooperating departments by filling in the "Application Form for Additional Testing" (see Appendix J of the S2 Line Construction Management Rules), and the application form must specify in detail the safety control measures, test content, cooperation requirements, additional opening paths, etc. After the application form is approved by the duty director, the driving shall be organized according to the traffic order.

source_file: S2线施工管理规则-en-translation.txt
content: The additional test is not included in the construction plan management. In principle, only one additional train is allowed to be opened and must not affect other operations. ##S2线施工管理规则 Construction plan management Plan declaration, approval and related regulations Construction coordination meeting

source_file: S2线施工管理规则-en-translation.txt
content: In principle, the construction coordination meeting is scheduled to be held every Thursday, and adjustments will be made on holidays that will be notified separately. The construction coordination meeting requires the operation and maintenance management department, quality and safety department, dispatching department, passenger transport department, vehicle department, maintenance unit and

source_file: S2线施工管理规则-en-translation.txt
content: other personnel and the person in charge of construction of other units to participate, and the participants should grasp the scope of influence and safety measures of the department's construction plan. The main contents of the construction coordination meeting:

source_file: S2线施工管理规则-en-translation.txt
content: Explanation of the completion of construction and violations in the previous construction implementation week; the next construction implementation week construction plan review, coordination, problem handling; arrange and arrange key construction; Other construction management-related matters. ##S2线施工管理规则 Construction organization management Regulations on the organization of construction on the main line

source_file: S2线施工管理规则-en-translation.txt
content: In principle, after the operation is over and all trains return to the site, OCC will accept the station construction request procedures according to the construction plan of the day and confirm that the construction conditions are met. Under special circumstances, after the last train leaves the station and related areas, and other operating conditions are met, the operation can be approved to start.

source_file: S2线施工管理规则-en-translation.txt
content: When the main line construction involves a power outage in the depot power supply zone, the field dispatch must complete the train shunting work before the start of the construction operation, and shall not affect the main line construction operation.

source_file: S2线施工管理规则-en-translation.txt
content: Each construction department (unit) needs to arrive at the corresponding station 30 minutes before the approved operation start time to make construction preparations. Class A1 construction should be carried out at least 1 hour before the start of the planned operation, and the vehicle inspection and maintenance operations should be

source_file: S2线施工管理规则-en-translation.txt
content: done in the parking lot. It is forbidden to arrange manual operations in advance on the exit/entry path of engineering trains or commissioning trains, and manual operations can only be approved after the engineering train or commissioning train passes a safe distance. The power supply conditions of the construction operation

source_file: S2线施工管理规则-en-translation.txt
content: area planned for A1 and the protection area must be consistent Each construction department (unit) must complete the construction operation and clear the construction area within the approved operation end time. If it is necessary to extend the operation time for any reason, the person in charge of the construction

source_file: S2线施工管理规则-en-translation.txt
content: shall verbally propose it to the main station 30 minutes before the approved operation end time, and the main station shall apply to the line adjustment for extension, and the OCC duty director shall approve it before it can be executed. The main substation class C operation shall be applied

source_file: S2线施工管理规则-en-translation.txt
content: to the electrical/environmental adjustment by the duty officer of the main substation for extension, and the OCC duty director shall approve it before execution. Under normal circumstances, the extension point shall not exceed 20 minutes.

source_file: S2线施工管理规则-en-translation.txt
content: In principle, the end time of night construction should be 30 minutes before the start of the station operation inspection. ##S2线施工管理规则 Construction organization and management Regulations on the construction organization of the parking lot

source_file: S2线施工管理规则-en-translation.txt
content: If the operation time needs to be extended for any reason, the person in charge of construction shall apply to the site adjustment for an extension 30 minutes before the approved operation end time, and the site adjustment approval can be implemented. Under normal circumstances, the extension point shall not exceed 20 minutes.

source_file: S2线施工管理规则-en-translation.txt
content: In principle, engineering vehicles from other units are not allowed to enter the track area, and under special circumstances, the maintenance unit and the new line construction department of the operation branch must review whether the vehicle meets the online requirements, assign a driver to monitor, and report to the vehicle department for the record before going online.

source_file: S2线施工管理规则-en-translation.txt
content: In principle, construction operations in the parking lot during operation are not allowed to occupy the entry and exit sections at the same time, and one access line must be retained (except for power outage construction in the parking lot during operation).

source_file: S2线施工管理规则-en-translation.txt
content: The specific construction organization of the depot shall be implemented in accordance with the "S2 Line Depot Operation Rules". Construction organization and management The construction regulations of the station part

source_file: S2线施工管理规则-en-translation.txt
content: Operations that do not go off the track and do not affect driving equipment in the small platform area of the station shall be included in the C2 plan and managed by the Passenger Transport Department.

source_file: S2线施工管理规则-en-translation.txt
content: The fault handling operations that do not open and close the station platform door and can be carried out by the driving interval shall be handled according to the C2 plan and managed by the Passenger Transport Department after the approval of the traffic survey.

source_file: S2线施工管理规则-en-translation.txt
content: The daily sanitation and cleaning work of the small platform of the station can be handled according to the C2 plan after the whole train returns to the site on non-operating construction days, and is managed by the passenger transport department.

source_file: S2线施工管理规则-en-translation.txt
content: ##S2线施工管理规则 Construction organization management Engineering train or commissioning train organization When it is necessary to carry out engineering train and commissioning train operations on the main line, the construction party needs to prepare the "Wenzhou Municipal Railway S2 Line Phase I Engineering Vehicle Commissioning Task Book" (see Appendix K of

source_file: S2线施工管理规则-en-translation.txt
content: the S2 Line Construction Management Rules) before commissioning, and fill in the commissioning content step by step according to the task book format. All task books need to be filled in by the person in charge of construction/commissioning and the driver, and the task book will be submitted to the

source_file: S2线施工管理规则-en-translation.txt
content: driver and the vehicle department for the record after the construction is completed. The person in charge of construction should contact the site survey in advance and report on the preparation of materials, and the person in charge of site adjustment/construction should contact the site survey 1 hour before the

source_file: S2线施工管理规则-en-translation.txt
content: start of construction to confirm the exit time, operation path, operation mode, etc. Engineering trains or commissioning trains must ensure smooth wireless communication and good technical condition before entering the main line.

source_file: S2线施工管理规则-en-translation.txt
content: After the engineering train or commissioning train arrives at the designated construction operation area in principle, the dispatch order should be issued in time to block the area. After the construction is completed, the relevant lines will be opened and the train will be arranged to return.

source_file: S2线施工管理规则-en-translation.txt
content: When multiple traffic paths are involved, the construction must be organized according to a single path first, that is, all the turnouts on a single driving path are locked individually, and the person in charge of construction can only direct the driver to carry out construction after receiving the notice that the turnouts on the road are locked.

source_file: S2线施工管理规则-en-translation.txt
content: the train is in the blockade construction area at the direction of the construction manager; When the transfer operation is required in the blockade area, the person in charge of construction must confirm the safety of the transfer line before applying for a transfer to the line transfer, and notify the person in charge of construction after the line adjustment is ready to transfer the route, and the driver will follow the ground signal display and the person in charge of construction to instruct the train; After the transfer is completed, the next driving path must be prepared and the turnout must be locked separately, and then the person in charge of the construction must be notified to organize the construction of the path.

source_file: S2线施工管理规则-en-translation.txt
content: ##S2线施工管理规则 Construction organization and management Regulations on the treatment of red light bands generated during the construction process The internal construction plan of the maintenance unit may produce red light bands, and by default, the maintenance unit signals to assist it in eliminating red light bands. Construction operations that may

source_file: S2线施工管理规则-en-translation.txt
content: produce red light bands by external units must clearly cooperate with the profession in the column of the cooperating department. The construction plan has made it clear that red light bands may be generated, and when the construction unit cannot judge whether it is generated during the construction process, it

source_file: S2线施工管理规则-en-translation.txt
content: must take the initiative to consult the station attendant 30 minutes before the end of construction. If the red light band is generated within 30 minutes before the end of the construction, the person in charge of the construction is allowed to apply for an extension of the point, and

source_file: S2线施工管理规则-en-translation.txt
content: in principle, the delay time shall not exceed 20 minutes. 0CC line dispatch/station attendant must contact the person in charge of construction in time to confirm whether it is caused by construction, if it is caused by construction, notify the person in charge of construction to eliminate the red light

source_file: S2线施工管理规则-en-translation.txt
content: band before the sales point, and organize emergency repair if it occurs due to failure. ##S2线施工管理规则 Construction organization and management Construction request point procedure Construction unit sales point qualification Please sell the unit| A1/A2/A3/A4/B1/B2/C1|Construction category B3/C2| |-|-|-|

source_file: S2线施工管理规则-en-translation.txt
content: |Operation branch and maintenance unit|The person in charge of construction must be in the list submitted by the operation branch and maintenance unit, and make a request point with the employee card. |The person in charge of construction can use the employee card to request the cancellation point

source_file: S2线施工管理规则-en-translation.txt
content: |Construction units other than operating branches and maintenance units|The person in charge of construction must rely on the certificate of the person in charge of construction issued by the Ministry of Quality and Safety to carry out the operation of the sales point. |The person in charge of construction must rely on the certificate of the person in charge of construction issued by the Ministry of Quality and Safety to carry out the operation of the sales point

source_file: S2线施工管理规则-en-translation.txt
content: Note: The list refers to the list of qualified personnel in charge of construction who are qualified to serve as A1/A2/A3/A4/B1/B2/C1 construction of the relevant departments and maintenance units of the operating branch, and the list is updated on a monthly basis, and each unit must file with the Ministry of Quality and Safety in a timely manner.

source_file: S2线施工管理规则-en-translation.txt
content: ##S2线施工管理规则 Construction organization management Construction request and cancellation procedures Please point regulations (except B3/C1/C2) Only the construction of the main station without auxiliary stations: the person in charge of construction shall go to the station to register the request point 30 minutes before the start time of construction, and the

source_file: S2线施工管理规则-en-translation.txt
content: station attendant in the vehicle control room shall verify the construction plan, certificate of the person in charge of construction and employee ID in the "Weekly Construction Driving Notice", "Daily Supplementary Plan Notice" and "Temporary Repair Plan Notice" and other procedures to register in the "Station Construction Registration Book" (see

source_file: S2线施工管理规则-en-translation.txt
content: Appendix L of the S2 Line Construction Management Rules); When the construction conditions are met, the station attendant will convey the order to allow the construction after the inspection is approved.

source_file: S2线施工管理规则-en-translation.txt
content: The construction of both the main station and the auxiliary station: the person in charge of construction should go to the main station 30 minutes in advance to go through the registration procedures for the request, and the construction liaison person must arrive at the auxiliary station 30 minutes before the start time of the construction to go through the registration procedures, and the main station station attendant will request the point to the line of dispatch, and the auxiliary station attendant will verify the construction matters to the main station attendant and make a request to the main station attendant, and the main station will convey to the person in charge of construction and the auxiliary station after receiving the order to allow the construction of the main station. The station attendant of the auxiliary station notified the construction liaison to approve the construction of the project.

source_file: S2线施工管理规则-en-translation.txt
content: ##S2线施工管理规则 Construction organization management Construction request and cancellation procedures Please point regulations (except B3/C1/C2) For Class B operations, the person in charge of construction should go to the site 30 minutes in advance to handle the registration procedures for the construction request, and the specific operating procedures shall be handled

source_file: S2线施工管理规则-en-translation.txt
content: in accordance with the "S2 Line Depot Operation Rules". If the operation area includes the main line, wiring line and part of the depot line, the construction unit will go to the station to request the point, and the station will judge that the construction conditions are met before requesting

source_file: S2线施工管理规则-en-translation.txt
content: the point. Before approving the request, the consent of the field investigation must be obtained. If the operation area includes both the parking lot line, the main line, and some wiring lines, the construction unit will request a point from the site. Before approving the request, the consent of the

source_file: S2线施工管理规则-en-translation.txt
content: field survey must be obtained. When there is work by external units, the personnel of the centralized management department will assist in handling the request before starting the operation. The OCC/DCC must give the construction acknowledgment number and dispatch code when approving the construction request.

source_file: S2线施工管理规则-en-translation.txt
content: ##S2线施工管理规则 Construction organization and management Construction request cancellation procedure Cancel point regulations (except B3/C1/C2) For Class A operations, only the main station has no auxiliary station sales point, and the person in charge of construction will go to the station to go through the sales point procedures after the construction

source_file: S2线施工管理规则-en-translation.txt
content: area is cleared, and the station will go through the sales point procedures with the line adjustment. After the construction of Class B operations is completed and the construction area is cleared, the person in charge of construction will come to the site to handle the sales procedures (Class B

source_file: S2线施工管理规则-en-translation.txt
content: construction is not allowed to sell points in other places). Class A operation involves the sales points of some lines in the field, and the person in charge of construction must go to the station to handle the sales points after the construction area is cleared, and the line adjustment

source_file: S2线施工管理规则-en-translation.txt
content: must inform the site adjustment after approving the station sales points. Class B operations involve the sales points of the main line and some wiring lines, and the person in charge of construction must inform the line adjustment after the construction area is cleared.

source_file: S2线施工管理规则-en-translation.txt
content: The auxiliary station construction liaison is responsible for clearing this section of the line and reporting to the person in charge of construction to handle the sales point to the auxiliary station station attendant, and the auxiliary station station attendant handles the sales point to the main station station attendant; After the person in charge of construction confirms that all the operation areas are cleared, they can handle the sales point with the main station station attendant, and after the main station confirms all the auxiliary station sales points, the main station station attendant will handle the sales point to the line adjustment.

source_file: S2线施工管理规则-en-translation.txt
content: ##S2线施工管理规则 Construction organization and management Construction request cancellation procedure Cancel point regulations (except B3/C1/C2) For construction operations that require off-site sales points, the construction leader/construction liaison should indicate the location, number of people and relevant precautions of off-site sales points when requesting points. The station that registers the construction request

source_file: S2线施工管理规则-en-translation.txt
content: point should notify the station attendant of the off-site sales point in time. When the construction personnel sell the point at the off-site sales point station, after checking the construction content, number of construction personnel and location of the sales point are all correct, record the valid certificates, name, etc.

source_file: S2线施工管理规则-en-translation.txt
content: of the person in charge of the construction work, and check with the requesting point station to check that it is correct, the station attendant of the sales point station will handle the sales point to the bank and notify the requesting point that the construction has been sold out.

source_file: S2线施工管理规则-en-translation.txt
content: After the operation is completed, the construction liaison person is responsible for clearing the line in this section and reporting to the person in charge of construction, and at the auxiliary station (or the off-site sales point station corresponding to the auxiliary station), the auxiliary station (or the off-site sales point station corresponding to the auxiliary station) to the sales point registered at the main station; After confirming that all the operation areas are cleared, the sales point will be registered with the sales point registered at the main station, and the sales point station will record the valid certificates, name, etc. of the construction person in charge after checking with the person in charge of construction that the construction content, number of construction workers, and location are all correct, and after checking with the requesting point station, the sales point will be approved, and the sales point station will be responsible for handling the sales point with the bank.

source_file: S2线施工管理规则-en-translation.txt
content: ##S2线施工管理规则 Construction organization and management Construction request point procedure For details of the A2/A3 construction request point process, please refer to Appendix G of the S2 line construction management rules, and for details of the B1/B2 construction request point process, please refer to Appendix H of the S2 line construction

source_file: S2线施工管理规则-en-translation.txt
content: management rules. When the main substation and other construction operations are carried out within the scope of duty personnel, please refer to the station construction request point for handling the process, and the duty personnel in the sales process shall act as the station duty officer.

source_file: S2线施工管理规则-en-translation.txt
content: When construction operations are carried out within the scope of no on-duty personnel, such as zoning offices, interval substations, and opening and closing stations, the person in charge of construction shall directly request points from the line through the recording phone. After the line adjustment is approved, if the construction content belongs to the electric ring equipment, it will be contacted with the corresponding electric ring dispatch. After the job is completed, the line is reconciled.

source_file: S2线施工管理规则-en-translation.txt
content: For construction within the scope of the work well, the registration of the construction request point shall be handled by the nearest station according to the construction notice. The station only registers, does not control the construction process and behavior, and is responsible for the person in charge of construction. In principle, the key to the station work well is not borrowed, and if the situation is urgent, the personnel of the maintenance unit can borrow it with work permits and other documents, and the key must not be transferred to others during the borrowing period.

source_file: S2线施工管理规则-en-translation.txt
content: ##S2线施工管理规则 Construction organization management Construction requisition and cancellation procedures B3/C1/C2 class requisition points The construction personnel should go to the station/depot (DCC)/control center (OCC)/main office with relevant documents to complete the order formalities; Construction work begins after the consent of the station/depot (DCC)/control center (OCC)/main office;

source_file: S2线施工管理规则-en-translation.txt
content: After the construction is completed, the construction manager/construction liaison confirms that the line is cleared, and goes to the station/depot (DCC)/control center (OCC)/main office to go through the sales procedures; The construction will be completed after confirmation at the station/depot (DCC)/control center (OCC)/main office.

source_file: S2线施工管理规则-en-translation.txt
content: In the case of A1 operation, after the construction person in charge completes the application procedures to the station, the requesting station will notify the station and protection station at both ends of the operation area to set up red flashing lights, and finally the line adjustment will issue a blockade order. After the operation is completed, the person in charge of construction will apply to the sales point station for the sales point procedures, and then the sales point station will notify the stations and protection stations at both ends of the operation area to remove the red flashing lights, and finally complete the sales point. (For details of the construction process, please refer to Appendix I of the S2 Line Construction Management Rules) In case of special circumstances such as emergency repair, the dispatch order shall prevail.

source_file: S2线施工管理规则-en-translation.txt
content: ##S2线施工管理规则 Construction organization and management Basic requirements for operation cooperation The cooperating department must provide cooperation in strict accordance with the cooperation requirements, and arrive at the scene 30 minutes before the start time of the operation to prepare in advance.

source_file: S2线施工管理规则-en-translation.txt
content: The operation department that requires the cooperation of other departments shall accept the supervision of the cooperating department when carrying out relevant operations. The relevant operations involving turnouts in each major of the maintenance unit must be cooperated by signal professionals.

source_file: S2线施工管理规则-en-translation.txt
content: Special provisions for construction organization and management of long-term and large-scale construction For long-term and large-scale construction operations on the main line or in the parking lot, the construction department (unit) needs to submit a specific construction plan to the operation and maintenance management department in advance. After the approval

source_file: S2线施工管理规则-en-translation.txt
content: and approval of the operation and maintenance management department, each department can submit the construction plan to the construction management engineer of the dispatching department after countersigning. For long-term and large-scale construction operations on the main line or in the parking lot, the construction department (unit) needs to submit the

source_file: S2线施工管理规则-en-translation.txt
content: construction progress and related precautions to the operation and maintenance management department in writing every week. ##S2线施工管理规则 Construction organization and management Special regulations for A4 type construction A4 construction submission requirements (external units), when it is necessary to submit an A4 construction plan, the construction unit (external unit) must submit

source_file: S2线施工管理规则-en-translation.txt
content: a specific construction plan to the Quality and Safety Department and the operation and maintenance management department in advance, and the content of the plan should include: the total construction cycle, the time required for daily construction, the construction area, protective measures, whether it will affect the operation, whether it

source_file: S2线施工管理规则-en-translation.txt
content: will affect other equipment, and relevant cooperation needs. The plan can only be implemented after being approved by the Quality and Safety Department and the Operation and Maintenance Management Department, and countersigned and approved by the Dispatch Department, the Passenger Transport Department and the Vehicle Department.

source_file: S2线施工管理规则-en-translation.txt
content: A4 construction submission requirements (maintenance unit), when it is necessary to submit an A4 construction plan, the maintenance unit must submit a specific inspection and maintenance plan to the operation and maintenance management department in advance, and include the corresponding maintenance plan content and regulations. The inspection and maintenance plan can only be implemented after being approved by the Quality and Safety Department and the Operation and Maintenance Management Department, and countersigned and approved by the Dispatching Department, the Passenger Transport Department, and the Vehicle Department. (Except for the rail protection inspection of the Ministry of Quality and Safety)

source_file: S2线施工管理规则-en-translation.txt
content: The requirements for submitting A4 construction plans are as follows: The dispatch department must strictly approve the construction plan, and include A4 construction in the weekly plan management, and the construction plan must specify in detail the relevant safety protection measures, the number of construction personnel, the person in charge

source_file: S2线施工管理规则-en-translation.txt
content: of the construction, the operation location, the characteristics of the drone, etc., if the relevant information is not specified in detail, the dispatch department will not approve the plan; The maintenance unit must organize relevant personnel to conduct on-site monitoring of A4 construction and strengthen the control of the operation

source_file: S2线施工管理规则-en-translation.txt
content: site. The construction plan must be filled in by professional engineers or designated personnel of each maintenance department in the "Weekly Plan Declaration Form" and "Daily Supplementary Plan Declaration Form" and stamped with a special electronic seal for construction. ##S2线施工管理规则

source_file: S2线施工管理规则-en-translation.txt
content: Construction Organization and Management Special Regulations for Class A4 Construction Request Regulations (A4) When constructing within the scope of no personnel on duty, such as outside the section rail travel area, the person in charge of construction will directly request the dispatch point through the recording phone after taking corresponding

source_file: S2线施工管理规则-en-translation.txt
content: safety measures, and the production dispatch will send drone photos to the dispatch. When constructing work within the scope of stations, substations and other areas where there are duty personnel, please refer to the station construction request point for handling the process of selling points, and ask the duty personnel

source_file: S2线施工管理规则-en-translation.txt
content: in the process to act as station attendants. If the operation area includes both the main line, the wiring line and some lines of the depot, the consent of the field survey must be obtained before approving the request point.

source_file: S2线施工管理规则-en-translation.txt
content: When there is work by external units, the personnel of the centralized management department will assist in handling the request before starting the operation. Construction Organization Management Special Regulations for Class A4 Construction Regulations in Construction Operations (A4)

source_file: S2线施工管理规则-en-translation.txt
content: The traffic adjustment needs to notify the drivers of the whole line to strengthen the lookout of the A4 construction area, and take corresponding measures in time if there is an emergency;

source_file: S2线施工管理规则-en-translation.txt
content: Strictly implement the flight control area issued by relevant departments, and it is strictly forbidden to pass directly above the orbital area. Daily inspection flight tasks: If the UAV flies at a height higher than the orbit datum, it must be more than 20 meters away from the orbit horizontal and more than 30 meters away from the catenary height; Emergency repair flight missions: If the flight altitude of the UAV is higher than the orbit datum, it must be more than 10 meters away from the orbit horizontal and more than 15 meters away from the catenary height.

source_file: S2线施工管理规则-en-translation.txt
content: If an accident occurs during the operation of the UAV, the person in charge of construction should immediately report the specific location, time and approximate appearance and size of the UAV to the survey, so that the survey can quickly locate and evaluate the situation, and release emergency repair information according to the situation, subject to the dispatch order.

source_file: S2线施工管理规则-en-translation.txt
content: ##S2线施工管理规则 Construction Organization Management Special Regulations for Class A4 Construction Sales Point Regulations (A4) When constructing operations outside the interval track area and other areas where there are no personnel on duty, after the construction of A4 operations is completed and the construction area is cleared, the person in charge

source_file: S2线施工管理规则-en-translation.txt
content: of construction must inform the drivers of the whole line after approving the sales point. Construction Organization and Management Special Regulations for Class A4 Construction Emergency Cooperation (A4) In case of emergency, the UAV needs to perform aerial photography, emergency rescue and other flight tasks, and after urgently reporting to

source_file: S2线施工管理规则-en-translation.txt
content: the relevant departments as required, according to the emergency repair information of the operation branch, cooperate with the on-site commander-in-chief (person in charge of emergency repair) to carry out emergency repairs, and the instructions of the person in charge of on-site emergency repair shall prevail.

source_file: S2线施工管理规则-en-translation.txt
content: Construction organization and management Construction regulations in the track protection area When constructing in the S2 Line Track Protection Area (see Appendix J of the S2 Line Construction Management Rules), the Quality and Safety Department will review the approved construction plan and notify the Dispatch Department, Passenger Transport Department, Vehicle

source_file: S2线施工管理规则-en-translation.txt
content: Department and other relevant departments. For construction within special protection zones, the maintenance unit shall send special personnel to supervise. Construction organization and management Limited space operation requirements Operators should strictly follow the operation instructions, and have the right to stop other personnel's illegal operations and refuse anyone's illegal commands.

source_file: S2线施工管理规则-en-translation.txt
content: According to the characteristics of limited space risk factors, it is equipped with gas detection and alarm instruments, mechanical ventilation equipment, respiratory protective equipment, full-body safety belts and other protective equipment and emergency rescue equipment that meet national standards or industry standards, and carry out regular maintenance, maintenance and regular testing of related supplies and equipment to ensure normal use.

source_file: S2线施工管理规则-en-translation.txt
content: Confined space operations shall strictly abide by the requirements of "ventilation first, then testing, and then operation". If there is an explosion risk, elimination or control measures shall be taken, and relevant electrical facilities and equipment, lighting fixtures, emergency rescue equipment, etc. shall meet the explosion-proof safety requirements. Before operation, the safety disclosure of the operators shall be organized, and the guardians shall inspect the risk control measures such as ventilation, testing, and necessary partitions, removals, and replacements one by one, to confirm that the protective equipment can be used normally and that the work site is equipped with necessary emergency rescue equipment to ensure that all operating conditions meet safety requirements. Emergency rescue personnel shall make emergency rescue preparations to ensure timely and effective handling of emergencies.

source_file: S2线施工管理规则-en-translation.txt
content: Guardians shall supervise the whole process, maintain real-time contact with operators, and shall not leave the work site or enter the limited space to participate in the operation. When abnormal situations are found, guardians should immediately organize operators to evacuate the site. After a confined space operation accident occurs, emergency response shall be carried out immediately in accordance with the on-site disposal plan, and scientific rescue shall be organized. If safety measures are not taken to blindly rescue, the guardian shall stop it.

source_file: S2线施工管理规则-en-translation.txt
content: During the operation, special personnel shall be arranged to continuously ventilate and test the gas concentration in the operation area. If the operation is interrupted, the operator shall re-ventilate and pass the gas test before entering the confined space again.

source_file: S2线施工管理规则-en-translation.txt
content: It is strictly forbidden for unrelated personnel to enter dangerous workplaces with limited space, and safety warning signs or safety notice boards are set up in conspicuous positions to remind personnel to enhance their awareness of risk prevention and control and take corresponding protective measures.

source_file: S2线施工管理规则-en-translation.txt
content: For applicable places, mechanical work can be considered instead of human work. If any of the following situations occur during the operation, the operator should immediately stop the operation and evacuate the confined space: the operator is unwell; the failure of safety protection equipment or personal protective equipment;

source_file: S2线施工管理规则-en-translation.txt
content: gas detection alarm alarm; the guardian or the person in charge of the work site issues an evacuation order; Other conditions that could jeopardize safety. Construction organization and management Regulations on the transfer of engineering vehicles

source_file: S2线施工管理规则-en-translation.txt
content: The transfer operation of engineering vehicles is strictly carried out in accordance with the "Engineering Vehicle Transfer Operation Procedure" formulated by the S1 and S2 lines shared facilities and equipment joint meeting, and the transfer operation is organized according to the A1 construction plan of the line network. In principle, it is included in the management of the "Weekly Construction Driving Notice", and no plan changes are allowed at will.

source_file: S2线施工管理规则-en-translation.txt
content: It is proposed that the operator of the engineering vehicle must participate in the construction coordination meeting on time, put forward the resource requirements of the construction operation site at the meeting, and the construction management engineer will coordinate the construction resources in a unified manner.

source_file: S2线施工管理规则-en-translation.txt
content: After the transfer operation is sold at Lingkun Station, the traffic dispatcher will organize the vehicle to run to the depot, and the conversion track must be cleared before the start of the operation and inspection, which shall not affect the relevant work of the organization and operation such as operation and inspection and early departure on the same day. When the vehicle, signal and other equipment fail during the transfer operation, and the operation of the next day will be affected after the transfer operation is completed, the 0CC duty officer may terminate the transfer operation according to the situation.

source_file: S2线施工管理规则-en-translation.txt
content: ##S2线施工管理规则 Relevant regulations on catenary power outage and transmission operations The S2 line catenary hanging ground wire operation adopts the self-hanging and self-dismantling method. Relevant provisions on catenary power outage and transmission operations Catenary power supply zone power outage and transmission requirements for power outage and transmission conditions in catenary

source_file: S2线施工管理规则-en-translation.txt
content: power supply zones The power outage and power transmission conditions of the main line catenary power supply zone shall be jointly confirmed by the line dispatcher, the power regulator and the duty director;

source_file: S2线施工管理规则-en-translation.txt
content: The power outage and power transmission conditions of the catenary power supply zone involving the entry and exit sections shall be jointly confirmed by the line dispatcher, the electric power regulator, the field regulator and the duty director;

source_file: S2线施工管理规则-en-translation.txt
content: The power outage and power transmission conditions of the catenary power supply zone of the parking lot shall be jointly confirmed by the field modulation and ESC and inspection and investigation, and the emergency repair operations involved shall be confirmed by the power supply personnel. Among them, except for the disconnect switches of the maintenance warehouse, application warehouse, car wash garage and wheelset testing shed, the rest of the catenary and disconnect switches in the parking lot are under the jurisdiction of the power dispatcher (the specific management boundary is implemented in accordance with the relevant provisions of the "Regulations on Power Dispatching").

source_file: S2线施工管理规则-en-translation.txt
content: ##S2线施工管理规则 Relevant provisions on catenary power outage and transmission operations Catenary power supply partition power outage (transmission) procedures for the main line catenary power supply zone After the line adjustment and the duty officer jointly confirm that the catenary power supply zone preparing for power outage (transmission) meets the conditions

source_file: S2线施工管理规则-en-translation.txt
content: for power outage (transmission), the line adjustment will notify the power to mediate (transmit) the power supply; After the ESC verifies that the power outage (transmission) conditions meet the requirements, the power outage (transmission) operation is carried out;

source_file: S2线施工管理规则-en-translation.txt
content: After the ESC operation is completed and the power is stopped (transmitted) as required, the line and dispatch duty director shall be notified; After the line dispatch and the duty officer jointly confirm that the power has been stopped (transmitted), the line dispatch will issue a power outage (transmission) notice

source_file: S2线施工管理规则-en-translation.txt
content: to the relevant station. Relevant provisions on catenary power outage and transmission operation Catenary power supply partition power outage Procedure for hanging (dismantling) ground wire on the main line catenary Procedure for hanging (dismantling) the ground wire for the construction operation of the main line catenary

source_file: S2线施工管理规则-en-translation.txt
content: After the power outage of the catenary power supply zone in the operation area, the conditions for the inspection are met, and the request for the construction operation is approved;

source_file: S2线施工管理规则-en-translation.txt
content: After the construction personnel and the ESC go through the formalities, the construction personnel will hang the ground wire on the spot, and the construction operation will begin after the ground wire is hung;

source_file: S2线施工管理规则-en-translation.txt
content: After the construction operation is completed, the construction personnel dismantle the ground wire, confirm that the equipment is back to normal and the line is cleared, and go through the procedures with the ESC before going to the sales point.

source_file: S2线施工管理规则-en-translation.txt
content: The construction operation is completed after the line survey and approval of the sales point. ##S2线施工管理规则 Relevant regulations on catenary power outage and transmission operation Catenary power supply partition power outage (transmission) procedures for catenary power supply zones in parking lots (except inspection warehouses).

source_file: S2线施工管理规则-en-translation.txt
content: After the field adjustment and inspection jointly confirm that the catenary preparing for power outage (transmission) meets the conditions for power outage (transmission), the field adjustment notifies the power to mediate (transmit) the power supply.

source_file: S2线施工管理规则-en-translation.txt
content: After the ESC verifies that the power outage (transmission) conditions meet the requirements, the power outage (transmission) operation is carried out; After the ESC operation is completed and the power is stopped (transmitted) as required, the field dispatch is notified;

source_file: S2线施工管理规则-en-translation.txt
content: After the field survey confirms that the power has been stopped (transmitted), the site will issue a notice of power outage (transmission) to the relevant construction unit. Relevant regulations on catenary power outage and transmission operation Catenary power supply partition power outage and transmission Procedures for hanging (dismantling) the ground

source_file: S2线施工管理规则-en-translation.txt
content: wire of the catenary in the parking lot (except for the inspection warehouse). After the power outage of the catenary in the operation area, the field survey confirms that the conditions are met, and the request point for the construction operation is approved;

source_file: S2线施工管理规则-en-translation.txt
content: After the construction personnel and the ESC go through the formalities, the construction personnel will hang the ground wire on the spot, and the construction operation will begin after the ground wire is hung;

source_file: S2线施工管理规则-en-translation.txt
content: After the construction operation is completed, the construction personnel remove the ground wire, confirm that the equipment is back to normal and the line is cleared, and go through the formalities with the ESC before going to the site to adjust the sales point;

source_file: S2线施工管理规则-en-translation.txt
content: The construction operation is completed after the site survey approves the sales point. The power outage (transmission) and hanging (dismantling) of the catenary of the inspection depot in the depot shall be implemented in accordance with the "S2 Line Depot Operation Rules".

source_file: S2线施工管理规则-en-translation.txt
content: ##S2线施工管理规则 Regulations on catenary power outage and transmission operations The catenary power supply zone is stopped and transmitted When working under the catenary or near its live body, the construction operation department or unit shall follow the following regulations: no power outage (2m away), power outage and ground wire (1m

source_file: S2线施工管理规则-en-translation.txt
content: and less than 1m away from the catenary), power outage but no need to hang the ground wire (more than 1m away from the catenary, 2m and less), and live electricity. Construction operation regulations that must stop the power supply of the catenary:

source_file: S2线施工管理规则-en-translation.txt
content: If the catenary power outage (excluding the single strand of the parking lot), the ESC is responsible for stopping the power supply of the catenary in the relevant operation area.

source_file: S2线施工管理规则-en-translation.txt
content: The operation that requires the hanging of the ground wire must be verified by the qualified personnel in the operation area in all incoming directions of the operation area, the ground wire must be hung up, and the red flashing light protection must be set.

source_file: S2线施工管理规则-en-translation.txt
