content: When the operation of hanging (dismantling) the ground wire is not qualified for operation, the operating unit must obtain the consent of the power supply department of the maintenance unit to cooperate with the hanging (dismantling) of the ground wire before applying for the construction plan.

source_file: S2线施工管理规则-en-translation.txt
content: During the non-operation period, when the up/down line in a power supply zone is commissioned or engineering trains, the adjacent line will not handle A2 construction operations. During the non-operation period, the up/down catenary in a power supply zone shall be carried out for power outage construction, and the adjacent

source_file: S2线施工管理规则-en-translation.txt
content: line catenary should also be protected from power outage; During the emergency repair construction during operation, whether the up/down catenary is electrified shall be determined by the general person in charge of emergency repair on site according to the situation. ##S2线施工管理规则 Construction safety management

source_file: S2线施工管理规则-en-translation.txt
content: The person in charge of construction, the construction liaison, and the construction supervisor must have the corresponding qualifications and implement the certificate system. Each construction operation needs to set up one construction person in charge, and the auxiliary station has another liaison for the facility worker. In addition, all operations

source_file: S2线施工管理规则-en-translation.txt
content: require the cooperation of on-site local personnel, and the construction work of other units needs to be appointed by the centralized management department (except for C2 type construction), and the maintenance unit will arrange a supervisor according to the construction project according to the situation, use large tools, use important

source_file: S2线施工管理规则-en-translation.txt
content: equipment of the station or C2 plan that may damage the station structure needs to arrange a construction supervisor. Construction safety management Responsibilities of the person in charge of construction/construction liaison The person in charge of construction shall be responsible for the overall construction of the work;

source_file: S2线施工管理规则-en-translation.txt
content: Responsible for the safety management of operators and equipment; Responsible for handling the procedures for requesting and selling points; Responsible for the organization and command of the operation process; Responsible for timely contact with stations and depots related matters;

source_file: S2线施工管理规则-en-translation.txt
content: Responsible for the implementation or confirmation of operational safety protection measures (the power outage of the catenary and the hanging ground wire need to be notified of the ESC); Responsible for confirming that the construction area is cleared and the equipment status is returned to normal. ##S2线施工管理规则

source_file: S2线施工管理规则-en-translation.txt
content: Construction safety management Responsibilities of construction supervisors Assist external units to handle construction sales points, and check the construction protection and labor protection of personnel in other units; Responsible for counting the construction personnel entering and leaving the operation area;

source_file: S2线施工管理规则-en-translation.txt
content: Responsible for supervising the safety of construction operations of external units; Responsible for inspecting the personnel and items (tools, materials, construction waste, etc.) of external units to clear the line, and give feedback to the station;

source_file: S2线施工管理规则-en-translation.txt
content: Check and confirm that the operating equipment used in the construction has returned to normal use and has been reinforced and will not invade the driving limit, and give feedback to the station;

source_file: S2线施工管理规则-en-translation.txt
content: Inspect and supervise the comprehensive management of personnel from other units cooperating with the operation (theft, smoking, etc.). Construction safety management Qualifications for the person in charge of construction/liaison/supervisor Familiar with the "S2 Line Driving Organization Rules", "S2 Line Construction Management Rules" and other relevant regulations;

source_file: S2线施工管理规则-en-translation.txt
content: be familiar with the nature, content, methods, steps, requirements, etc. of the homework; Have safety knowledge and skills related to this operation; It is necessary to obtain the certificate of the person in charge of construction for the list submitted by the operating branch and maintenance unit, or pass the

source_file: S2线施工管理规则-en-translation.txt
content: training examination organized by the Quality and Safety Department. ##S2线施工管理规则 Construction safety management Construction protection The protection of construction operations follows the principle of "who sets it, who removes", and implements "automatic control, mutual control, and other control".

source_file: S2线施工管理规则-en-translation.txt
content: All construction operations must be set up in accordance with the construction management regulations and the provisions of the professional maintenance regulations, and the person in charge of construction should check and implement the safety protection measures of the work industry to ensure that the protection is in place and eliminate potential safety hazards.

source_file: S2线施工管理规则-en-translation.txt
content: All construction workers entering the line construction must wear fluorescent clothing, labor protection shoes, and safety helmets, and use other safety protective equipment according to the nature of the operation and operation requirements. Before construction, the person in charge of construction should organize construction members to conduct pre-shift safety education.

source_file: S2线施工管理规则-en-translation.txt
content: After the construction is completed, the construction manager/liaison/supervisor must ensure that the line is cleared and the equipment condition returns to normal. ##S2线施工管理规则 Construction safety management Construction protection Construction operation red flashing light protection Tasks that require a red flash: A1 class homework;

source_file: S2线施工管理规则-en-translation.txt
content: When the A2 type operation needs to be connected to the ground wire. Requirements for red flash settings: Station attendants need to register the location and number of red flashing lights set for A1 operations;

source_file: S2线施工管理规则-en-translation.txt
content: The red flashing light set in the rail area must be clearly marked with the name and number of the workshop of the department to which the equipment belongs; For A1 type operations, the nearest station personnel will place two red flashing lights 10 meters outside the end walls of

source_file: S2线施工管理规则-en-translation.txt
content: the operation area, and a red flashing light will be set up at the end wall of the protection area (in case of multi-strand stations, each strand needs to be set separately according to regulations), and the red flashing lights will be placed in the center of the track bed

source_file: S2线施工管理规则-en-translation.txt
content: or on the track. After the construction is completed, the station personnel will take the red flashing lights out of the track clearance area. After the catenary is hung on the ground wire, place a red flashing light in the center of the track bed or on the track 5

source_file: S2线施工管理规则-en-translation.txt
content: meters outside the ground wire insulation rod, and remove the red flashing light at the same time after the ground wire is removed. When two A1 operations work in the common protection area, two red flashing lights shall be set at the boundary between the common protection area and the

source_file: S2线施工管理规则-en-translation.txt
content: operation area, and the red flashing lights can be removed after the two construction is completed. (See Appendix K of the S2 Line Construction Management Rules) You don't need to set a red flash in the following cases:

source_file: S2线施工管理规则-en-translation.txt
content: When one end of the engineering train or commissioning train operation area belongs to the end line, there is no need to set up red flash light protection at the end of the end line;

source_file: S2线施工管理规则-en-translation.txt
content: When the whole line is running an engineering train or commissioning a train, there is no need to set up red flashing lights at both ends of the operation area. The construction protection in the parking lot shall be implemented in accordance with the "S2 Line Parking Yard Operation Rules".

source_file: S2线施工管理规则-en-translation.txt
content: ##S2线施工管理规则 Construction safety management Construction safety When people and engineering trains operate in the same area, the person in charge of construction and the conductor shall coordinate according to the on-site situation according to the following principles:

source_file: S2线施工管理规则-en-translation.txt
content: According to the direction of construction, the train is in front and the personnel are behind, and in principle, it must not be reversed or there is operation before and after the train runs;

source_file: S2线施工管理规则-en-translation.txt
content: There should be a safety separation distance of more than 50 meters between non-accompanying construction personnel and the train, and in principle, the train should not retreat casually; If there is a need for a bullet train, the person in charge of the construction must negotiate with the train commander before the train can be trained, so as to ensure personal safety;

source_file: S2线施工管理规则-en-translation.txt
content: Operators should set up a red flashing light in the direction of incoming vehicles in their own on-site operation area to protect them. Construction Safety Management Construction Safety Regulations on the protection area of engineering trains and commissioning trains

source_file: S2线施工管理规则-en-translation.txt
content: When operating a commissioning train or engineering train, the front and rear protection distance must ensure that "1 station and 1 section" is idle, and when operating an automatic protection train without a train in the construction area, only one train is allowed to carry out construction operations in principle (except for train rescue).

source_file: S2线施工管理规则-en-translation.txt
content: The protection zone can be shared between A1 operations when the two power supply conditions do not conflict. ##S2线施工管理规则 Construction safety management Construction safety Catenary live electricity, power outage and ground wire protection

source_file: S2线施工管理规则-en-translation.txt
content: Operators should ensure a safety distance of at least 2 meters between their equipment, materials, parts, etc. and the live catenary. The catenary in the power outage area where it is not clear whether the catenary is live and the ground wire is not hung is considered to be electrified.

source_file: S2线施工管理规则-en-translation.txt
content: Other construction operations are not allowed to be arranged in the protected area of the construction operation of engineering trains and commissioning trains. If you want to carry out hot work during the construction operation, you must apply for the "Fire Operation Permit" in accordance with the "Fire Safety Management

source_file: S2线施工管理规则-en-translation.txt
content: Measures", and it is strictly forbidden to carry out hot work without the "Fire Operation Permit". The construction person in charge/construction supervisor of other units shall be responsible for safety management and safety supervision.

source_file: S2线施工管理规则-en-translation.txt
content: When declaring the construction plan, all construction units and departments should strictly follow the relevant regulations and put forward safety protection requirements and cooperation requirements in combination with the actual situation during the construction operation. During the construction operation, the construction unit and department should strictly abide by the above safety regulations.

source_file: S2线施工管理规则-en-translation.txt
content: ##S2线施工管理规则 Construction safety management Construction plan Scope of application of construction plan The construction of A1 and B1 (excluding vehicle maintenance operations), the technical transformation and upgrading of existing equipment and facilities, or the construction management working group deems necessary to carry out A1 and B1 (excluding vehicle maintenance operations)

source_file: S2线施工管理规则-en-translation.txt
content: in the operation line of the operation branch. Class A, B1, B2 and C1 construction or construction management working group deemed necessary by the construction management working group to carry out Class A, B1, B2 and large-scale construction that affect the normal use of passenger transport organization and fire protection

source_file: S2线施工管理规则-en-translation.txt
content: control system on the operation line. Construction safety management construction plan Construction plan classification of construction plan According to the content and scope of construction, the construction plan is divided into line network level construction plan and company level construction plan. The line network level construction scheme includes:

source_file: S2线施工管理规则-en-translation.txt
content: The line-network level software upgrade and configuration modification construction plan that affects the driving. The construction plan for upgrading and configuring AFC systems at the line network level affecting passenger transport services.

source_file: S2线施工管理规则-en-translation.txt
content: The construction plan for software upgrade and configuration modification of vehicle traction and braking systems that directly affect the operation of two or more lines. The centralized management department of equipment and facilities deems it necessary to review the system upgrade and configuration modification plan of two or more line

source_file: S2线施工管理规则-en-translation.txt
content: operators. Technical transformation of driving equipment and facilities, affecting the driving organization of two or more lines or causing changes in the performance of driving equipment on two or more lines.

source_file: S2线施工管理规则-en-translation.txt
content: the expansion and transformation of the transfer station seriously affects the construction of fire protection, passenger service quality and the use of equipment and facilities; The construction management working group believes that it is necessary to review the construction plan of two or more line operators.

source_file: S2线施工管理规则-en-translation.txt
content: ##S2线施工管理规则 Construction safety management Construction plan Construction plan classification The company-level construction plan includes: Software upgrades and configuration modifications that affect single-line driving. AFC system upgrade and configuration modification construction plan affecting single-line passenger transport services. Software upgrade and configuration modification construction plan with safety certification and safety restrictions.

source_file: S2线施工管理规则-en-translation.txt
content: The software upgrade and configuration modification of the vehicle traction and braking system that directly affect single-line driving are modified. The centralized management department of equipment and facilities believes that it is necessary to review the system upgrade and configuration modification plan reviewed by the company.

source_file: S2线施工管理规则-en-translation.txt
content: The technical transformation of driving equipment and facilities affects the construction of single-line driving organization and causes changes in the performance of driving equipment. closed entrances and exits, multi-station equipment transformation, equipment linkage above the whole station range, etc.; seriously affect the construction of single-line fire protection, passenger service quality

source_file: S2线施工管理规则-en-translation.txt
content: and the use of equipment and facilities; EMU construction for new function tests and load-bearing capacity tests for single-line vehicles (traction, braking and running part systems) and driving equipment; The construction management working group believes that it is necessary to review the construction plan of the company. ##S2线施工管理规则

source_file: S2线施工管理规则-en-translation.txt
content: Construction safety management construction plan construction plan approval process Line network level construction plan The construction unit shall issue a construction plan and report it to the project management department (referring to the "New Line Construction Department, Operation and Maintenance Management Department or Vehicle Department", the same below) for approval,

source_file: S2线施工管理规则-en-translation.txt
content: and the project management department shall be responsible for organizing and convening a plan review meeting, inviting the heads of relevant units and departments to review and countersign the plan, and the relevant professional departments shall issue the emergency treatment plan required for the plan, and use it as an

source_file: S2线施工管理规则-en-translation.txt
content: attachment. After the countersigning is passed, the construction will be submitted for implementation according to the plan. Company-level construction plan The construction unit shall issue a construction plan, and after it is submitted to the project management department for review and approval, the project management department shall organize the quality

source_file: S2线施工管理规则-en-translation.txt
content: and safety department to review and countersign, and invite other relevant departments to participate in the review if necessary. The "Construction Special Plan Review Form" is detailed in Appendix O of the S2 Line Construction Management Rules ##S2线施工管理规则 Construction safety management Construction plan Construction plan preparation requirements

source_file: S2线施工管理规则-en-translation.txt
content: The construction plan must include the following contents: project overview, construction time and location, scope of influence, construction organization, construction preparation, construction method, cooperating departments and requirements, safety management measures and emergency plans, protection of existing equipment, etc. The construction unit shall refine and supplement according to the specific situation of construction.

source_file: S2线施工管理规则-en-translation.txt
content: Project Overview: refers to the main situation of the construction, including the project name, the name of the participating units, the construction object, the construction project, etc.; Construction time and location: refers to the implementation period and specific operation location of the construction;

source_file: S2线施工管理规则-en-translation.txt
content: Scope of influence: refers to the specific impact and construction requirements of the construction on the existing order and status of the driving organization, passenger transport organization, equipment and facility status, building structure, etc.;

source_file: S2线施工管理规则-en-translation.txt
content: Construction organization: refers to the organizational structure, key position leaders, their responsibilities and relationships with each other of the construction; ##S2线施工管理规则 Construction safety management Construction plan Construction plan preparation requirements

source_file: S2线施工管理规则-en-translation.txt
content: Construction preparation: refers to the preparation of the necessary elements of the construction such as technology, materials, machinery and equipment, personnel, etc., whether it meets the construction needs, and the technical documents and disclosure documents required for the construction should be submitted together;

source_file: S2线施工管理规则-en-translation.txt
content: Construction method: refers to the specific operation time, location, implementation steps, specific requirements, implementation standards and objectives of the construction; Cooperate with departments and requirements: When the construction requires the operating company to cooperate with the operation, clarify the cooperation department and cooperative matters;

source_file: S2线施工管理规则-en-translation.txt
content: Safety management measures and emergency plans: refers to the safety key points and implementation requirements, risk points and preventive measures, protective measures and handling methods in emergency situations of the construction, and establishes an emergency liaison mechanism;

source_file: S2线施工管理规则-en-translation.txt
content: Protection of existing equipment: refers to the protection or protective measures of existing equipment taken in the relevant areas such as material and equipment transfer, construction site, etc.; Other requirements: necessary explanations and supplements to the plan by the construction unit.

source_file: S2线施工管理规则-en-translation.txt
content: ##S2线施工管理规则 Emergency repair and emergency repair operation regulations Basic regulations on emergency repair During emergency repair operations, if the operation cannot be maintained, the emergency repair area should be blocked, and it is strictly forbidden to use equipment within the blockade to organize driving; The on-site commander (person in charge

source_file: S2线施工管理规则-en-translation.txt
content: of emergency repair) should keep in touch with the line or field adjustment at any time and use the driving interval to carry out emergency repair. When the emergency repair is initiated in the main line area, the emergency repair order number must be issued by the second-level dispatch of

source_file: S2线施工管理规则-en-translation.txt
content: the maintenance unit with the consent of the duty director, and the emergency repair order shall be issued by the line transfer to the station. When emergency repair is initiated in the parking lot, the emergency repair order number will be issued by the site to the secondary dispatch of

source_file: S2线施工管理规则-en-translation.txt
content: the maintenance unit. When the fault affects the entry and exit of the train, the field adjustment should give priority to ensuring the main line operation. After the emergency repair order is issued, according to the division of labor under the jurisdiction of the equipment, the line adjustment/electric regulation/environmental adjustment

source_file: S2线施工管理规则-en-translation.txt
content: will cooperate with the on-site commander (person in charge of emergency repair) to carry out emergency repairs. When it is necessary to enter and exit the orbital area, the consent of the line adjustment/field adjustment must be obtained; When it is necessary to operate power supply equipment, the consent of

source_file: S2线施工管理规则-en-translation.txt
content: the power control must be obtained; When it is necessary to operate environmental control equipment, the consent of environmental control must be obtained. During emergency repair operations, the construction approval number shall not be issued, and the emergency repair order number shall be issued and the line adjustment/field adjustment code

source_file: S2线施工管理规则-en-translation.txt
content: shall be given. The format of the main line emergency repair order number is "S2-XXXX (year) XX (month)-XX (number of times)", and the format of the emergency repair order number of the depot is "XT/TT (the first 2 characters of the depot name)-XXXX (year) XX (month)-XX (number of times)". ##S2线施工管理规则

source_file: S2线施工管理规则-en-translation.txt
content: Emergency repair and emergency maintenance operation regulations Basic regulations on emergency repair When the main line is repaired, the line adjustment shall register the emergency repair operation in the "Construction Operation Register" (see Appendix M of the S2 line construction management rules), and fill in the emergency repair order number

source_file: S2线施工管理规则-en-translation.txt
content: in the construction code column; When the yard area is repaired, the field survey shall register the emergency repair operation in the "Construction/Maintenance Operation Register", and fill in the emergency repair order number in the construction code column.

source_file: S2线施工管理规则-en-translation.txt
content: When the catenary needs to be blacked out: the on-site commander (person in charge of emergency repair) will make a power outage request, and the line adjustment/field investigation will confirm that the power outage conditions are met, and the electric conductor will organize the catenary to cut off power; After the power outage operation is completed, the line investigation notifies the on-site commander (person in charge of emergency repair); The on-site commander (person in charge of emergency repair) can start work only after confirming that the catenary has been cut off and the on-site ground wire protection measures are good.

source_file: S2线施工管理规则-en-translation.txt
content: After receiving the emergency repair order, the station should cooperate with the preliminary preparations for emergency repair, and arrange personnel to be responsible for opening the end door and handling the registration procedures for emergency repair personnel to enter the track.

source_file: S2线施工管理规则-en-translation.txt
content: After the line or field investigation issues an emergency repair order, when it is necessary to send additional emergency repair personnel or tools to enter the track area again for emergency repair, it must be approved by the line or field investigation, and then go through the orbit registration procedures again before entering the track area according to the order of the on-site commander-in-chief (person in charge of emergency repair).

source_file: S2线施工管理规则-en-translation.txt
content: Emergency repair and emergency maintenance operation regulations Emergency repair protection regulations After issuing the blocking command, the line or field adjustment sets blockades on the turnouts, axle sections, etc. through the signal terminal for protection; The on-site commander (person in charge of emergency repair) sets up red flashing lights at

source_file: S2线施工管理规则-en-translation.txt
content: both ends of the operation area for protection. When the power outage of the catenary is required for emergency repair operations, ground wires must be hung at both ends of the operation area after the power outage. ##S2线施工管理规则

source_file: S2线施工管理规则-en-translation.txt
content: Emergency repair and emergency maintenance operation regulations Emergency repair organization procedures Emergency repair of equipment in the main line range during operation Use intervals for emergency repair The operation adjustment should keep in touch with the on-site commander-in-chief (person in charge of emergency repair) at any time, make driving adjustments,

source_file: S2线施工管理规则-en-translation.txt
content: maintain limited operation services, and create time and space for emergency repair under the premise of meeting the operation. According to the driving interval, the on-site commander (person in charge of emergency repair) is notified of the available emergency repair time. The on-site commander (person in charge of emergency repair)

source_file: S2线施工管理规则-en-translation.txt
content: should accurately grasp the available time and organize professionals to carry out emergency repairs. Before the end of the expected time, the on-site commander (person in charge of emergency repair) will confirm with the traffic survey again that the equipment needs to be used and restore the equipment to the

source_file: S2线施工管理规则-en-translation.txt
content: state of train traffic. Before using the equipment, it should be confirmed with the on-site commander-in-chief (person in charge of emergency repair) that the train traffic conditions and restrictions are met, and confirm that the on-site personnel and tools have been cleared to a safe area.

source_file: S2线施工管理规则-en-translation.txt
content: Emergency repair and emergency maintenance operation regulations Emergency repair organization procedures During operation, equipment in the main line area emergency repair blockade line emergency repair When the blockade line is repaired, the line will delineate the scope of the blockade according to the requirements of the on-site commander-in-chief (person in

source_file: S2线施工管理规则-en-translation.txt
content: charge of emergency repair) and issue a blockade order. The traffic survey formulates a driving adjustment plan according to the scope of emergency repair blockade and the impact of emergency repair operations to maintain operation services to the greatest extent. ##S2线施工管理规则

source_file: S2线施工管理规则-en-translation.txt
content: Emergency repair and emergency maintenance operation regulations Emergency repair organization procedures Emergency repair equipment in the main line during non-operation period When there is no construction in the emergency repair area

source_file: S2线施工管理规则-en-translation.txt
content: The line dispatch directly blocked the emergency repair area, and organized emergency repair personnel to carry out emergency repairs in the lower track area. Emergency repair and emergency maintenance operation regulations Emergency repair organization procedures Emergency repair of equipment in the main line during non-operation period When there is construction

source_file: S2线施工管理规则-en-translation.txt
content: work in the emergency repair area The line dispatch directly cancels all construction operations in the emergency repair area, organizes emergency repair personnel to enter the track area, blocks the emergency repair operation area, and notifies the emergency repair workers to leave the track clearance area in an orderly manner

source_file: S2线施工管理规则-en-translation.txt
content: to go through the sales procedures. When it is necessary to change the operating conditions (if a new regional power outage, ground line is required, etc.), the on-site commander-in-chief (person in charge of emergency repair) shall apply to the line before handling the emergency repair operation, and the request operation

source_file: S2线施工管理规则-en-translation.txt
content: can be handled only after the conditions are met. When personnel or tools need to enter and exit the rail area during the emergency repair period, the station must first obtain the consent of the traffic investigation, and then contact the on-site commander-in-chief (person in charge of emergency repair) to

source_file: S2线施工管理规则-en-translation.txt
content: use the order of the on-site commander (person in charge of emergency repair) as permission to enter and exit the rail area. ##S2线施工管理规则 Emergency repair and emergency maintenance operation regulations Emergency repair organization procedures

source_file: S2线施工管理规则-en-translation.txt
content: The emergency repair of parking equipment shall be carried out in accordance with the provisions of the "S2 Line Parking Yard Operation Rules". Emergency repair and emergency maintenance operation regulations Emergency repair organization procedures Emergency maintenance

source_file: S2线施工管理规则-en-translation.txt
content: Emergency maintenance does not issue an emergency repair order number, and maintenance personnel carry out maintenance operations in accordance with the verbal orders of line adjustment/field adjustment. During emergency maintenance of the main line, the station will cooperate with the relevant procedures such as personnel entering the orbit or entering

source_file: S2线施工管理规则-en-translation.txt
content: the equipment room according to the traffic order. The depot handles related procedures such as entering the track or entering the equipment room according to the field adjustment order. When emergency maintenance operations affect passenger services, stations should adjust passenger services according to the impact and strengthen passenger explanations. When

source_file: S2线施工管理规则-en-translation.txt
content: emergency maintenance operations affect driving, the traffic survey determines the driving adjustment plan according to the impact of the fault, and organizes maintenance personnel to deal with it at the interval between driving.

source_file: S2线施工管理规则-en-translation.txt
content: ##S2线施工管理规则 Regulations on emergency repair and emergency maintenance operations Regulations on emergency repair or emergency maintenance of additional trains to the section The maintenance personnel apply to the traffic survey to go to the rail area for emergency repairs, and the traffic survey notifies the maintenance personnel to go to

source_file: S2线施工管理规则-en-translation.txt
content: the corresponding platform to wait for the vehicle according to the train arrangement, and informs the driver that there are maintenance personnel to add rides. When personnel take the train to the fault point, priority is given to boarding the driver's cab and no more than 2 people are allowed;

source_file: S2线施工管理规则-en-translation.txt
content: When there are many people, other personnel board the cabin close to the driver's cab. After getting on the bus, the personnel should explain the parking points in the section to the driver and must not interfere with the driver's normal driving. After the train arrives at the emergency repair

source_file: S2线施工管理规则-en-translation.txt
content: site in the section and stops, the emergency repair personnel get off the train through the side door of the driver's cab and enter the track area. After personnel enter the track area and reach the safe area, they should immediately report the line adjustment; The traffic survey notified the

source_file: S2线施工管理规则-en-translation.txt
content: driver to resume normal operation after leaving the emergency repair site with a speed limit of 25km/h. After the operation is completed, when it is necessary to return to the station from the section, the on-site personnel will contact the traffic adjustment and explain the specific parking location of the

source_file: S2线施工管理规则-en-translation.txt
content: pick-up train. According to the requirements of the returning personnel, the train is arranged to be in manual driving mode with a speed limit of 25km/h at 200m before the pick-up point. After the train arrives at the pick-up location, all personnel board through the side door of the driver's

source_file: S2线施工管理规则-en-translation.txt
content: cab, and the driver confirms that the personnel are on the train and reports the traffic adjustment, and runs to the front station according to the traffic adjustment order. If the addition of the passenger compartment may lead to complaints from passengers, the on-site commander (person in charge of emergency

source_file: S2线施工管理规则-en-translation.txt
content: repair) will report to the operation, and in principle, the operation will organize them to take an empty car to or leave the fault site. ##S2线施工管理规则 Emergency repair and emergency repair operation regulations Operation guarantee

source_file: S2线施工管理规则-en-translation.txt
content: After the emergency repair or emergency maintenance operation is completed, the maintenance personnel must keep in touch with the OCC and assign relevant professionals to do a good job of operation support according to the dispatcher's arrangement, and in principle, the guarantee will be until the end of the operation on the same day.

source_file: S2线施工管理规则-en-translation.txt
content: During the operation period, it is strictly forbidden for security personnel to operate relevant equipment without the permission of the OCC. The support personnel can propose to the OCC to board the train to inspect the equipment or enter the relevant equipment room to monitor the equipment as needed. ##S2线施工管理规则

source_file: S2线施工管理规则-en-translation.txt
content: Statistical analysis and assessment The vehicle department conducts statistical analysis of the B type construction operation, fills in the corresponding report and reports it to the dispatching department, and the dispatch department completes the construction weekly and monthly reports in combination with the A/C1 plan analysis report.

source_file: S2线施工管理规则-en-translation.txt
content: Statistical analysis and assessment Plan fulfillment rate and accuracy The plan fulfillment rate refers to the ratio of the actual number of completed construction projects in various plans to the number of planned arrangements.

source_file: S2线施工管理规则-en-translation.txt
content: The planning accuracy rate refers to the ratio of the number of arranged construction projects that have not been adjusted, increased, or deleted to the number of planned arrangements. Any adjustment (including adjustment of operation time, location, cooperation requirements, etc.) and deletion (i.e., canceling the corresponding operation content to the

source_file: S2线施工管理规则-en-translation.txt
content: relevant management unit before the start of the operation) in the weekly plan and daily supplementary plan shall be regarded as inaccurate planning and included in the corresponding statistical indicators.

source_file: S2线施工管理规则-en-translation.txt
content: Any increase or modification of the construction operation items arranged in the weekly plan and daily supplementary plan will not affect the fulfillment rate of the plan. Statistical analysis and assessment Statistical indicators of construction operations

source_file: S2线施工管理规则-en-translation.txt
content: the actual number of completed pieces, the cashing rate and the accuracy rate of the weekly plan, daily supplementary plan and temporary repair plan; the number and reasons for the construction not completed according to the weekly plan, daily supplementary plan, and temporary repair plan;

source_file: S2线施工管理规则-en-translation.txt
content: The utilization rate of construction time of completed weekly and daily supplementary plans, that is, the ratio of actual construction time to planned construction time. ##S2线施工管理规则 Statistical analysis and assessment 施工管理工程师应根据施工统计指标对施工计划进行相应的调整。 Retry Reason 周计划兑现率要求达到95%，日补充计划、临时补修计划兑现率要求达到100%。 Retry Reason 周计划准确率要求达到95%，日补充计划、临时补修计划准确率要求达到100%。 Retry Reason 周计划、日补充计划作业时间利用率要求到达80%。 Retry Reason 日补充计划申报的作业项目原则上不得超过本周本部门（单位）周施工计划作业项目的5%。 Retry Reason 因与临时补修计划、恶劣天气等特殊情况或其他施工作业冲突而调整的周计划、日补充计划按该项作业完成计入统计指标中。 Retry Reason 故障型新增日补充计划及施工工作组或领导组指定的日补充计划不纳入考核。 Retry

source_file: S2线施工管理规则-en-translation.txt
content: Reason ##S2线施工管理规则 Retry Reason 统计分析与考核 施工考核规定 Retry Reason 施工考核分为对施工单位考核和施工负责人考核。 Retry Reason 统计分析与考核 施工考核规定 施工负责人考核 Retry Reason 施工负责人证采用积分管理，按1年内15分计分，满一年后自动恢复满分；施工负责人证有效期小于1年时，有效期内按15分计分。 Retry Reason 自取证之日起，1年内累计扣分达到或超过15分，则施工负责人证撤销，且自撤销证件起1年内不得申请施工负责人证。 Retry Reason 因违规施工导致一次考核15分的，自撤销证件起3年内不得申请施工负责人证。 Retry Reason 因违规施工造成重大财产损失或人员伤亡的，终身不得申请施工负责人证。 Retry Reason 质量安全部负责施工负责人证管理，对证件积分进行统计，将具备施工负责人资质的人员录入施工系统并及时更新施工负责人证名单，并报送至调度部、客运部、车辆部等部门。 Retry Reason 调度部负责收集施工负责人违规行为，核查信息后填写《违规行为通知单》（S2线施工管理规则附表N），并报送质量安全部。 Retry Reason 客运部、车辆部负责协助调度部收集施工过程中的违规行为记录。 Retry Reason ##S2线施工管理规则 统计分析与考核 施工考核规定 施工负责人考核 Retry Reason 施工负责人有以下违规行为的，将扣除积分。其中A/C类施工发生违规行为，由现场发现人上报当班行调，行调记录事情经过后上报施工管理工程师，施工管理工程师核查信息后填报《违规行为通知单》；B类施工发现违规行为，由现场发现人上报当班场调，场调记录事情经过后上报施工管理工程师，施工管理工程师核查信息后填报《违规行为通知单》。 Retry Reason |扣分分值|扣分行为| Retry Reason |-|-|

source_file: S2线车站设备操作手册（客运服务）-V2.0-en-translation.txt
content: 5.1 Introduction to ticket vending machines Automatic ticket vending machine (TVM/iTVM) is placed in the non-paid area of the station to provide passengers with self-service use, complete the rail transit ticket sales function, can identify and store coins and banknotes, and change coins and banknotes. TVM is composed of independent

source_file: S2线车站设备操作手册（客运服务）-V2.0-en-translation.txt
content: components such as passenger display touch screen, operating status display, ticket card sales unit, banknote processing unit, banknote change unit, coin handling unit, maintenance printer, maintenance panel, power module, main control unit, etc., which are connected through corresponding cables. The following operations mainly involve the business operations of station posts.

source_file: S2线车站设备操作手册（客运服务）-V2.0-en-translation.txt
content: The main functional modules of automatic ticket vending machines are banknote receiving module, coin processing module, and ticket processing module. Banknote receiving module: It is mainly composed of a banknote reader and a banknote recycling box. One device can install one banknote recycling box, which can store up to 1000

source_file: S2线车站设备操作手册（客运服务）-V2.0-en-translation.txt
content: RMB. Coin handling module: coin identifier, circular changer, coin change box and coin recovery box. One device can be equipped with one coin recovery box, which can accept two types of coins of 1 yuan and 5 jiao respectively, and can store up to 2,000 coins of 1 yuan. One

source_file: S2线车站设备操作手册（客运服务）-V2.0-en-translation.txt
content: device is equipped with 2 coin change boxes, and one coin change box can store up to 700 coins of 1 yuan. Ticket processing module: It consists of 2 ticket boxes and 1 scrap ticket box. The ticket box has a storage capacity of 1000 tickets and a waste ticket

source_file: S2线车站设备操作手册（客运服务）-V2.0-en-translation.txt
content: box capacity of 300 tickets. The modes of automatic ticket vending machines include normal mode, downgrade mode, and emergency mode. Emergency mode has the highest priority. Normal mode includes normal service mode and suspended service mode. Downgrade mode includes no change mode, coin only mode, banknote only mode, and no

source_file: S2线车站设备操作手册（客运服务）-V2.0-en-translation.txt
content: banknote change mode. In emergency mode, the station stops selling tickets, and the passenger display screen shows that the service is suspended. In normal service mode, the operation status display shows green "Normal Service" or red "Paused Service".

source_file: S2线车站设备操作手册（客运服务）-V2.0-en-translation.txt
content: In no change mode, there is no change for coins or banknotes. The operation status display shows yellow "No change". The banknote module cannot be used in coin-only mode. The operation status display shows a yellow "Coins only".

source_file: S2线车站设备操作手册（客运服务）-V2.0-en-translation.txt
content: The coin module cannot be used in banknote-only mode. The operation status display displays yellow "Banknote only". In banknote-free change-free mode, there is no banknote-free change. The operation status display shows yellow "Banknote-free change".

source_file: S2线车站设备操作手册（客运服务）-V2.0-en-translation.txt
content: The modes in the device include: "device on", "device off", "no change mode", "coin only mode", "bill only mode", "no bill change mode", and "cancel all modes". The "Device On" and "Device Off" functions realize the local opening and shutting down of the device. The "Cancel All Modes" function realizes the normal service functions of the device. The "No Change Mode", "Coin Only Mode", "Banknote Only Mode", and "No Banknote Change Mode" functions realize the downgrade function of this device.

source_file: S2线车站设备操作手册（客运服务）-V2.0-en-translation.txt
content: When communication with the station computer system is interrupted, the automatic ticket vending machine has the ability to work in isolation and save data. The automatic ticket vending machine is equipped with a large-capacity storage device, which can save the equipment data for at least the last 7 days. When the communication is restored, the saved transaction data can be uploaded to the station computer in time. The automatic ticket vending machine uses a DOM disk to store the transaction data and all other operating data, and when the system communication is interrupted, the data can be exported to the station computer through the offline data import and export function.

content: 6Automatic Ticket Gates (AGMs) 6.1 Introduction to ticket gates The automatic ticket gate is divided into two types: two-way ticket gate and wide-channel ticket gate, with a standard channel net width of 550mm and a wide channel net width of 900mm.

source_file: S2线车站设备操作手册（客运服务）-V2.0-en-translation.txt
content: The ticket gate includes: main control unit, reader and antenna, recovery mechanism, blocking device (door), passenger display, traffic indicator, warning light and speaker, alarm, maintenance panel, main power supply, etc. Pass entry and exit ticket inspection. Commands can be issued through SC or set on the machine as: inbound mode, outbound mode, and two-way mode. The conversion of the three modes can also be realized through automatic operation schedule, command issuance and in-place control. In different operating modes, the automatic ticket gate gives clear reminders to passengers through traffic indicators, passenger displays, and roof guides.

source_file: S2线车站设备操作手册（客运服务）-V2.0-en-translation.txt
content: The automatic ticket gate accepts one-ticket pass, Wenzhou citizen card, UnionPay QuickPass and QR code and other gate methods to check passengers entering and exiting the station, with inbound and outbound passenger flow records, fare deduction records, blacklist usage records and information output functions.

source_file: S2线车站设备操作手册（客运服务）-V2.0-en-translation.txt
content: The door blocking mechanism can store a specified number of door opening instructions, and has a feedback prompt of the door opening signal in place, and can read out relevant information through the data interface. In the event of an emergency, the control center and station staff can control the opening of all ticket gates by operating the computer terminal or pressing the emergency button to ensure that passengers leave the paid area without hindrance. At the same time, the ticket gate has the ability to work offline and save data. In the state of computer communication failure between the ticket gate and the station, the ticket gate can still work normally and ensure that the operating data storage capacity is not less than 7 days. There is an obvious prompt for abnormal ticket gates, and the method of returning from the ticket insertion port is adopted.

content: 7.1 Introduction to intelligent customer service center Semi-automatic ticket vending machines are placed in the station intelligent customer service center to help passengers handle ticket business and administrative affairs through conductors. Ticket card business includes ticket sales, recharge, update, outbound tickets, and related processing of boarding codes. Semi-automatic ticket vending

source_file: S2线车站设备操作手册（客运服务）-V2.0-en-translation.txt
content: machines are composed of independent components such as the duty display touch screen, two passenger displays, readers, printers, code scanners, ID card modules, power modules, and main control units, which are connected through corresponding cables.

source_file: S2线车站设备操作手册（客运服务）-V2.0-en-translation.txt
content: When communication with the station computer system is interrupted, the semi-automatic ticket vending machine has the ability to work in isolated islands and save data. The semi-automatic ticket vending machine is equipped with a large-capacity storage device, which can save the equipment data for at least the last 7 days. When the communication is restored, the saved transaction data can be uploaded to the station computer in time. The semi-automatic ticket vending machine uses a DOM disk to store the transaction data and all other operating data, and when the system communication is interrupted, the data can be exported to the station computer through the offline data import and export function.

It can be moved between different stations and different areas (paid areas/non-paid areas) to reduce operational losses

source_file: S2线车站设备操作手册（客运服务）-V2.0-en-translation.txt
content: and cope with large passenger flows, making it convenient for passengers to check tickets. source_file: S2线车站设备操作手册（客运服务）-V2.0-en-translation.txt
content: receive data with PCA. PCA needs to update system parameters before use, and has strict permission management functions. content: The inbound ticket inspection function is equivalent to the function of the entry gate, which can perform inbound ticket inspection on the ticket card. When using the inbound ticket inspection function, the work area must be in the "non-paid area". The validity of the ticket card is judged, and if the ticket is valid, the station entry information is written into the ticket.

source_file: S2线车站设备操作手册（客运服务）-V2.0-en-translation.txt
content: The outbound ticket inspection function is equivalent to the function of the gate. Outbound ticket inspection can be carried out. When outbound ticket inspection, the work area must be in the "payment area". The validity of the ticket card is judged, and if the ticket is valid, the outbound information is written to the ticket. One-way tickets need to be manually collected.

source_file: S2线车站设备操作手册（客运服务）-V2.0-en-translation.txt
content: The station computer system is placed in the station control room and ticket room, and is used by the duty officer and above, and is used for station AFC terminal equipment monitoring and management, mode management, time management, parameter management, data management, report management, maintenance management, revenue management, ticket management, authority management, system management and peripheral management. The station is mainly used for monitoring management, revenue management and ticket management modules, and the functions of the mode management and peripheral management modules in emergency situations.

source_file: S2线车站设备操作手册（客运服务）-V2.0-en-translation.txt
content: Station monitoring realizes real-time monitoring of the operation of the equipment of the station, can view the current status data, cash box/ticket box data, real-time passenger flow of the equipment, and can control the equipment status by sending commands to single control or group. At the same time, you can query the event history of one or more selected devices.

source_file: S2线车站设备操作手册（客运服务）-V2.0-en-translation.txt
content: Revenue management subordinate equipment cash management, reserve fund management, ticket management, supplementary payment management and duty attendant handover management, ticket refund statistics, BOM transaction management 6 modules. It can be used for the process record and data summary of station reserve fund and ticket allocation, clearance, handover and inventory.

source_file: S2线车站设备操作手册（客运服务）-V2.0-en-translation.txt
content: Ticket management is subordinate to 8 modules: ticket card inventory management, equipment ticket card management, warehousing management, warehousing management, allocation management, inventory management, ticket card sales and inventory statistics, and paper ticket sales statistics. It can be used for the process records and data summary of station ticket card distribution, recycling, handover and inventory.

source_file: S2线车站设备操作手册（客运服务）-V2.0-en-translation.txt
content: Mode management is used when the operation mode of a single or group terminal equipment needs to be changed in case of emergency, and peripheral management is used for uploading and using PCA inspection ticket data. The operation mode of the station AFC system includes normal operation mode, downgrade mode and emergency release mode. The normal operation mode includes normal service and suspension of service. Downgrade mode includes inbound inspection exemption mode, outbound inspection exemption mode, time inspection exemption mode, date exemption mode, fare exemption mode, and train failure mode.

Work report submission procedure Monthly report on safety work of the passenger transport department

source_file: 客运部工作报表及应急信息报送管理实施细则1015-en-translation.txt
content: Before the 26th of each month, the departmental safety management engineer will summarize the daily safety work of the station this month (including station safety inspection, station security inspection, station emergency drill, safety training and education, etc.), and form a monthly safety work report on the last working day of each month, which will be reviewed by the department head and submitted to the Quality and Safety Department. (See Appendix H).

source_file: 客运部工作报表及应急信息报送管理实施细则1015-en-translation.txt
content: ##客运部工作报表及应急信息报送管理实施细则 Work report submission procedure Accident event analysis report If the external department urgently needs it, the station/workshop only provides the specific time point and objective facts of the incident, and subjective analysis and speculative statements are strictly prohibited.

source_file: 客运部工作报表及应急信息报送管理实施细则1015-en-translation.txt
content: If the station has an accident or public opinion event such as train delay, train clearance, and large-scale impact on passenger services due to operational failure, the accident event analysis report (see Appendix I) shall be formed according to the driving log, on-site time recording points, audio and video, relevant filling ledger and other materials, and the event report shall follow the principle of "truthful statement, logical rigor, and dialectical analysis".

source_file: 客运部工作报表及应急信息报送管理实施细则1015-en-translation.txt
content: ##客运部工作报表及应急信息报送管理实施细则 Work report submission procedure Accident event analysis report Statement based on facts Truthful statements are the primary principles of security incident reporting, that is, do not exaggerate or speculate, and the information presented in the report must be true. For example:

source_file: 客运部工作报表及应急信息报送管理实施细则1015-en-translation.txt
content: (1) The safety incident is "construction personnel enter the blockade area", and it is important not to express the title as "a person-vehicle collision incident at a certain station" and take the lead in characterizing the incident, which can be expressed as "an incident where construction personnel mistakenly enter the blockade area".

source_file: 客运部工作报表及应急信息报送管理实施细则1015-en-translation.txt
content: (2) The safety event is "rainwater flows into the entrance and exit of a certain station", and the title should not be expressed as "rainwater backflow occurs at the entrance and exit of a certain station", and the safety event should be used with caution.

source_file: 客运部工作报表及应急信息报送管理实施细则1015-en-translation.txt
content: Work report submission procedure Accident event analysis report Logical rigor The security incident report should be logical and rigorous, that is, the key information in the incident report should be consistent with the direction of the statement, and the key information should be in line with the direction of the

source_file: 客运部工作报表及应急信息报送管理实施细则1015-en-translation.txt
content: statement. Work report submission procedure Accident event analysis report Dialectical analysis The part of the safety accident or public opinion incident that is caused by its own improper operation and the corresponding rules and regulations should be clearly pointed out in the cause analysis of the incident report. At the

source_file: 客运部工作报表及应急信息报送管理实施细则1015-en-translation.txt
content: same time, even if the negative impact of a safety accident or public opinion incident has become a fait accompli, it should also be seen that the active action in the early reminder and post-event disposal should be seen, and the incident should be stated based on the facts.

source_file: 客运部工作报表及应急信息报送管理实施细则1015-en-translation.txt
content: ##客运部工作报表及应急信息报送管理实施细则 Work report submission procedure Accident event analysis report The content of the accident report must strictly comply with the reporting time limit and reporting specifications. Specific requirements: Public opinion incident: Within 12 hours of the incident, the hotline management engineer will form a preliminary investigation and incident report based

source_file: 客运部工作报表及应急信息报送管理实施细则1015-en-translation.txt
content: on relevant ledgers, records, audio and video recordings and other materials, and submit it to the Quality and Safety Department and the General Management Department within 24 hours after the head of the comprehensive technical office and the head of the department review step by step.

source_file: 客运部工作报表及应急信息报送管理实施细则1015-en-translation.txt
content: Occurrence of safety incidents or large-scale incidents affecting driving/passenger services: Within 12 hours of the incident, the regional station manager will form a preliminary investigation and incident report based on driving logs, audio and video recordings and other materials, and submit it to the person in charge of the station service center for review and report to the department safety management engineer.

source_file: 客运部工作报表及应急信息报送管理实施细则1015-en-translation.txt
content: If two or more stations need to submit an incident report, the designated personnel of the station center must first merge and sort out multiple incident reports in chronological order, and submit them to the department's safety management engineer after review by the person in charge of the station center.

source_file: 客运部工作报表及应急信息报送管理实施细则1015-en-translation.txt
content: ##客运部工作报表及应急信息报送管理实施细则 Work report submission procedure Accident event analysis report Safety accident: Within 30 minutes after the accident, the regional station manager shall submit a written accident briefing to the person in charge of the center, and after being reviewed by the person in charge of the center and the head

source_file: 客运部工作报表及应急信息报送管理实施细则1015-en-translation.txt
content: of the department, it shall be submitted to the Ministry of Quality and Safety within 40 minutes after the incident. The content includes: (1) The unit, location, and category of the accident/incident; (2) The time, place and scene of the accident/incident; (3) The preliminary cause of the accident/incident;

source_file: 客运部工作报表及应急信息报送管理实施细则1015-en-translation.txt
content: (4) A brief history of the accident/incident; (5) The number of casualties (including disappearances and evacuations) that the accident/incident has caused or may have caused and the preliminary estimate of direct economic losses; (6) The impact of the accident/incident on the surrounding environment and whether it causes environmental damage;

source_file: 客运部工作报表及应急信息报送管理实施细则1015-en-translation.txt
content: (7) Measures taken; (8) Matters requested for coordination and support; (9) The name, position, and contact number of the reporter; (10) Other situations that should be reported. After the accident rescue and rescue are completed, the department should immediately organize a departmental accident analysis meeting to analyze the causes, determine

source_file: 客运部工作报表及应急信息报送管理实施细则1015-en-translation.txt
content: responsibilities, formulate preventive measures, put forward handling opinions, and submit the "Accident/Incident Investigation Report" to the Ministry of Quality and Safety in accordance with the time specified in the "Operational Accident (Incident) Investigation and Management Measures".

source_file: 客运部工作报表及应急信息报送管理实施细则1015-en-translation.txt
content: ##客运部工作报表及应急信息报送管理实施细则 Station Operation Emergency Information (hereinafter referred to as Emergency Information) Submission Procedures Station Operation and Service Hotline Emergency Information Submission Requirements Emergency response must follow the principle of "disposal first, then report";

source_file: 客运部工作报表及应急信息报送管理实施细则1015-en-translation.txt
content: The main methods of emergency information reporting include telephone notification, Zhejiang government nail, and OA email (decreasing priority, but multiple communication channels can also be used at the same time);

source_file: 客运部工作报表及应急信息报送管理实施细则1015-en-translation.txt
content: The regional station manager/foreman is the first person responsible for the emergency information reporting of the station/work class, and the hotline management engineer is the first person responsible for the emergency information reporting of the hotline.

source_file: 客运部工作报表及应急信息报送管理实施细则1015-en-translation.txt
content: When an emergency occurs, after the station/work team reports to the OCC as soon as possible, the regional station manager/work team leader/hotline management engineer will notify the person in charge of the center or professional engineer (see Appendix A for details) by phone depending on the severity of the incident and do a good job in the internal information reporting of the Zhejiang government nail information of the passenger transport department. Information reporting needs to be timely and complete, accurate and concise, and the reporting needs to ensure that the information is closed-loop to achieve the first, continuation and final reports. Reporting personnel should pay attention to distinguishing sensitive information, and selectively publish the on-site situation in the group in the form of a combination of pictures and texts or data;

source_file: 客运部工作报表及应急信息报送管理实施细则1015-en-translation.txt
content: If major and sensitive incidents are involved, they can report directly to the department head by telephone when necessary, and care should be taken to avoid using social software to prevent the leakage and spread of sensitive information. ##客运部工作报表及应急信息报送管理实施细则

source_file: 客运部工作报表及应急信息报送管理实施细则1015-en-translation.txt
content: Station operation emergency information (hereinafter referred to as emergency information) submission procedures Information briefing principles The incident briefing should follow the reporting principle of "reporting the situation, the reason for the approval, and the progress of the follow-up".

source_file: 客运部工作报表及应急信息报送管理实施细则1015-en-translation.txt
content: Station operation emergency information (hereinafter referred to as emergency information) reporting procedures Information briefing submission principles Rapid reporting The station/team will report the situation to the OCC and the regional station manager/foreman / hotline management engineer as soon as possible. After receiving the report, the regional station manager/foreman / hotline

source_file: 客运部工作报表及应急信息报送管理实施细则1015-en-translation.txt
content: management engineer will quickly report the location, incident process, and impact to the corresponding personnel in a summary statement. Special attention must be paid to the location of the incident must be clear and accurate when reporting, such as a fire in a shop outside the station, which can be

source_file: 客运部工作报表及应急信息报送管理实施细则1015-en-translation.txt
content: expressed as "a fire broke out in a shop 4-5 meters outside the XX entrance and exit of XX station", and it should not be expressed as "a fire broke out in a shop at the XX entrance and exit of XX station". ##客运部工作报表及应急信息报送管理实施细则

source_file: 客运部工作报表及应急信息报送管理实施细则1015-en-translation.txt
content: Station operation emergency information (hereinafter referred to as emergency information) reporting procedures Information briefing submission principles Reasons for approval Report the cause of the incident as soon as possible after investigating or understanding it clearly. For emergencies that cannot be investigated for the time being, the regional station manager/foreman /

source_file: 客运部工作报表及应急信息报送管理实施细则1015-en-translation.txt

After the hotline management engineer connects with the relevant departments, he will report the possible reasons speculated by professionals, such as the follow-up investigation is clear, and follow up the information in a

source_file: 客运部工作报表及应急信息报送管理实施细则1015-en-translation.txt
content: timely manner. Station operation emergency information (hereinafter referred to as emergency information) reporting procedures Information briefing submission principles Continue to report progress For events that have a greater impact or are sensitive, after the first report, the regional webmaster/foreman manager/hotline management engineer should continue to report the incident handling process,

source_file: 客运部工作报表及应急信息报送管理实施细则1015-en-translation.txt
content: and report the final possible results of the incident as soon as possible according to the disposal situation until the incident is disposed of. ##客运部工作报表及应急信息报送管理实施细则 Station Operation Emergency Information (hereinafter referred to as Emergency Information) Submission Procedures Information Submission Examples

source_file: 客运部工作报表及应急信息报送管理实施细则1015-en-translation.txt
content: Take the passenger casualty incident at Station XX as an example: Breaking report: At XX:XX on XX Month XX, XX year, a middle-aged male passenger on the XX train up XX Station fainted and was carried to the middle of the platform by the passenger. At present, the station on

source_file: 客运部工作报表及应急信息报送管理实施细则1015-en-translation.txt
content: duty has arrived at the scene to deal with it, the passenger is unconscious, and the station has reported to OCC and dialed 120; Reason for approval: Through preliminary understanding, the passenger did not collide or collide with others on the train, and he fainted in the seat, which may

source_file: 客运部工作报表及应急信息报送管理实施细则1015-en-translation.txt
content: be caused by his own physical reasons, and the specific reasons need to be understood later; Continue to report progress: (1) The duty station has performed cardiopulmonary resuscitation and artificial respiration rescue on the passenger, and the defibrillator has been activated, but the passenger is still in a coma;

source_file: 客运部工作报表及应急信息报送管理实施细则1015-en-translation.txt
content: (2) The passenger has been sent to XX Hospital for rescue, and his family has been contacted to rush to the hospital, but the passenger is found to have no heartbeat in the ambulance, and there may be death;

source_file: 客运部工作报表及应急信息报送管理实施细则1015-en-translation.txt
content: (3) The hospital announced the death of the passenger, the cause of death was sudden death, and the family had not yet arrived at the hospital. ##客运部工作报表及应急信息报送管理实施细则 Station Operation Emergency Information (hereinafter referred to as Emergency Information) Submission Procedures Information Submission Examples

source_file: 客运部工作报表及应急信息报送管理实施细则1015-en-translation.txt
content: The service hotline takes the unilateral misdeduction of public opinion as an example: Breaking report: At XX:XX on XX month XX, XX, the service hotline received feedback from passengers, received a deduction text message at 6:30, and did not take rail transit recently. The hotline checked the background data and

source_file: 客运部工作报表及应急信息报送管理实施细则1015-en-translation.txt
content: (1) ACC reported that due to the upgrade of the ticketing system, abnormal deductions were made, resulting in compulsory deductions for passengers who used the Wenzhou Rail APP on XX month XX, and refunds are being made in the background;

source_file: 客运部工作报表及应急信息报送管理实施细则1015-en-translation.txt
content: (2) The service hotline has received a total of XX abnormal deductions from passengers, all of which have recorded passenger information and done a good job of explanation, and there have been no complaints from passengers.

source_file: 客运部工作报表及应急信息报送管理实施细则1015-en-translation.txt
content: (3) On the same day, passengers called in from XX, connected to XX, not connected to XX, and APP message feedback from XX. ##客运部工作报表及应急信息报送管理实施细则 Station Operation Emergency Information (hereinafter referred to as Emergency Information) Submission Procedures Information Submission Examples

source_file: 客运部工作报表及应急信息报送管理实施细则1015-en-translation.txt
content: The ticketing team took the ACC software upgrade failure incident as an example Breaking report: At XX:XX on XX month XX, XX year, the ACC maintenance team upgraded the entire line network to the ACC system QR code gate server, and found that the software failed to achieve the predetermined

source_file: 客运部工作报表及应急信息报送管理实施细则1015-en-translation.txt
content: function during the upgrade process, affecting the use of QR code gate service by passengers on the whole line network; Reason for approval: The failure of software upgrade causes the ACC system QR code server to not work normally, affecting the main line operation the next day;

source_file: 客运部工作报表及应急信息报送管理实施细则1015-en-translation.txt
content: Continue to report progress: (1) The ACC maintenance team returns the original version of the QR code server to the emergency version according to the emergency treatment content in the upgrade plan;

source_file: 客运部工作报表及应急信息报送管理实施细则1015-en-translation.txt
