source_file: 施工管理总则-en-translation.txt
content: ##施工管理总则 Purpose In order to effectively strengthen and standardize the construction organization and management of operating lines within the jurisdiction of Wenzhou Railway and Rail Transit Investment Group Co., Ltd. (hereinafter referred to as Municipal Railway Investment Group), strengthen the content and procedures of construction operations, and ensure the orderly

source_file: 施工管理总则-en-translation.txt
content: construction organization and normal and reliable operation of facilities and equipment, the general rules for construction management are specially formulated. Scope of application The general rules of construction management are applicable to the maintenance, inspection, maintenance and construction of driving equipment and service equipment operating lines within the jurisdiction of

source_file: 施工管理总则-en-translation.txt
content: the Municipal Railway Investment Group, as well as the management of plans such as the operation of engineering trains, commissioning trains and comprehensive drills in the track entry area. Each line shall formulate the "Construction Management Rules" of the line according to the actual situation. Cite text

source_file: 施工管理总则-en-translation.txt
content: Rules for the Investigation and Handling of Operational Accidents (Incidents) (WTTYY/AJB(I)/AQ-010-01) Fire Safety Management Measures Wenzhou Urban Rail Transit Management Measures ##施工管理总则 Definition Each line should define proper nouns according to the characteristics of the line to avoid ambiguity. The definition of common terms can be referred to the following.

source_file: 施工管理总则-en-translation.txt
content: Define the rail travel area It refers to the area within the building limit of the main line, wiring and depot lines. The construction operation area exceeds the building limit, but the vertical projection above it is still within the limit, and must be included in the management of the

source_file: 施工管理总则-en-translation.txt
content: rail area. Definition of a parking lot It means that the depot and parking lot are collectively referred to as the parking lot. Define the outer unit It refers to units other than the line operating unit, excluding units that have long-term maintenance agreements with the line operating unit.

source_file: 施工管理总则-en-translation.txt
content: Define the person in charge of construction It refers to the person who is fully responsible for the organization, safety and personnel management of construction operations. There is only one construction person in charge for each construction. Define the construction liaison

source_file: 施工管理总则-en-translation.txt
content: It refers to the personnel responsible for the construction organization, safety and management of other work sites outside the operation site where the construction person in charge is carried out at multiple locations. ##施工管理总则 Define the master

source_file: 施工管理总则-en-translation.txt
content: It refers to the main station where the person in charge of construction handles the procedures for requesting the sale point within the relevant area of the operation. Define auxiliary stations

source_file: 施工管理总则-en-translation.txt
content: It means that when the same construction operation is carried out at multiple points, the place where each construction liaison person except the main station goes through the procedures for requesting the cancellation point is the auxiliary station. The auxiliary station of the request point and the sales point can not be the same location.

source_file: 施工管理总则-en-translation.txt
content: Define the clearance of the construction area It means that after the construction is completed, the construction person in charge/construction liaison confirms that all operators have been evacuated, relevant equipment and facilities have returned to normal, and all tools and materials have been removed. Definition Construction that affects driving

source_file: 施工管理总则-en-translation.txt
content: It refers to the construction that if there are passenger trains, commissioning trains, and engineering trains running on the line on the same day or the next day, the safety will be affected. Definition of construction that affects passenger transport

source_file: 施工管理总则-en-translation.txt
content: It refers to the construction when the function of the station's passenger service equipment and facilities is reduced, and the passenger flow organization and service quality are affected. Define line network level construction

source_file: 施工管理总则-en-translation.txt
content: It refers to the construction of the operation affecting the operation of two days or more lines or customer service. ##施工管理总则 Organization and responsibilities When multiple lines are operated, a line-network level construction management coordination group should be established, composed of the vice president of each line operating unit. Responsible

source_file: 施工管理总则-en-translation.txt
content: for coordinating the line-network level construction issues that could not be agreed upon at the construction coordination meeting; supervising and guiding the work of each line construction leading group and working group; reviewing the relevant regulations of construction and maintenance management; inspecting the implementation of construction work.

source_file: 施工管理总则-en-translation.txt
content: The construction organization of each line operating unit should have a construction management leading group and a construction management working group. Both the leading group and the working group should have a team leader and team members. The division of responsibilities should have clear division of labor requirements for the leader and members of the leading group and the leader and team members of the working group.

source_file: 施工管理总则-en-translation.txt
content: ##施工管理总则 Construction plan management Plan classification Line network level construction is divided into two categories according to the scope of influence, line network primary construction and line network secondary construction. Primary construction of line network:

source_file: 施工管理总则-en-translation.txt
content: It refers to the construction that affects the driving or customer service of two lines or more and has a large impact area. Secondary construction of line network: It refers to the construction that may affect the driving or customer service of two lines or more, and the impact area

source_file: 施工管理总则-en-translation.txt
content: is small, and the impact can be greatly reduced or eliminated by certain means. By time: The construction plan can be divided into monthly plan, weekly plan, daily supplementary plan, and temporary repair plan according to time. Each line should be combined with the actual work in the form of

source_file: 施工管理总则-en-translation.txt
content: weekly plan or monthly plan. According to the location and nature of the construction operation, it is divided into three categories, namely the construction that affects the main line and wiring traffic, the construction in the depot, and the construction that does not affect the traffic in other areas. For

source_file: 施工管理总则-en-translation.txt
content: details, please refer to the construction plan according to the location and nature classification table. Classification table of construction plans by location and nature |classification|properties|classification|description| |-|-|-|-| | Class A|Construction affecting the main line and wiring traffic| A1|In the main line and wiring track area, the construction of trains is required

source_file: 施工管理总则-en-translation.txt
content: | Class A|Construction affecting the main line and wiring traffic| A2|In the main line and wiring track area, there is no need to build a train | Class A|Construction affecting the main line and wiring traffic| A3|Within the scope of stations, zoning offices, main substations, and control centers, it affects

source_file: 施工管理总则-en-translation.txt
content: the construction of driving equipment and facilities 1.1. ##施工管理总则 Classification table of construction plans by location and nature |classification|properties|classification|description| |-|-|-|-| | Category B|Construction in the depot| B1|In the depot, the construction of trains that need to be operated (excluding train maintenance).|

source_file: 施工管理总则-en-translation.txt
content: | Class B|Construction in the depot| B2|In the depot, there is no need to run a train, but it needs to enter the depot line limit, or affect the operation of power supply, signal and other equipment, or plant trees within 3 meters outside the depot line limit, build related facilities, or need fire and other construction that affects the operation

source_file: 施工管理总则-en-translation.txt
content: | Category B|Construction in the parking lot| B3|Construction work in the parking lot other than B1/B2 is Category B3 (except for the maintenance of offices, canteens and other living and office equipment and facilities).

source_file: 施工管理总则-en-translation.txt
content: | Class C|Construction that does not affect traffic within the scope of stations, zoning offices, main substations, control centers, etc.| C1|Large-scale operations that affect the normal use of passenger transport and fire-fighting equipment or require fire (external units enter the substation, communication equipment room, signal equipment room, environmental control and electronic control room, lighting and distribution room, battery room, water pump room, and other gas fire extinguishing and protection rooms).

source_file: 施工管理总则-en-translation.txt
content: | Class C|Construction that does not affect traffic within the scope of stations, subdivisions, main substations, control centers, etc.| C2|Inspections or inspections that partially affect passenger transport but have little impact and do not affect the operation of fire protection and other equipment after taking measures, and the use of simple equipment (such as the use of electricity of 220V and below, drilling, etc., do not violate safety regulations) and other construction

source_file: 施工管理总则-en-translation.txt
content: Note: Each line can be subdivided into categories again based on its own actual situation, but it must be maintained as a whole. ##施工管理总则 Construction plan management Plan declaration, approval and related regulations General regulations for construction plan declaration

source_file: 施工管理总则-en-translation.txt
content: The construction plan must be submitted by the professional engineers or designated personnel of each line through the construction management system, and when the construction management system is not available, the electronic template can be used to stamp the construction special electronic seal to supplement the plan submitted by mailbox.

source_file: 施工管理总则-en-translation.txt
content: In principle, except for B3/C2, which is not included in the management of monthly/weekly/daily supplementary/temporary repair plans, everything else needs to be included, of which A1, A2, A3, and C1 construction are not allowed to operate during operating hours.

source_file: 施工管理总则-en-translation.txt
content: For construction operations under the jurisdiction of environmental regulation/ESC, it must indicate "contact environmental regulation/ESC before operation" when declaring the construction plan. ##施工管理总则 Construction plan management Plan declaration, approval and related regulations General regulations for construction plan declaration

source_file: 施工管理总则-en-translation.txt
content: When the operation area includes the main line, wiring and part of the line of the parking lot (the main operation site is on the main line), such construction shall be declared according to the Class A plan.

source_file: 施工管理总则-en-translation.txt
content: When the operation area includes both the depot line, the main line, and part of the wiring line (the main operation site is in the depot), such construction shall be declared according to the Class B plan.

source_file: 施工管理总则-en-translation.txt
content: The primary construction of the line network must obtain the certificate of the person in charge of the construction recognized by the affected line operator, and submit the construction plan to the affected line operator, and obtain the consent of all the affected line operators before the construction can be effective.

source_file: 施工管理总则-en-translation.txt
content: The secondary construction of the line network needs to obtain the certificate of the person in charge of the construction recognized by the company under the jurisdiction of the equipment, and submit the construction plan to the relevant departments of the unit under the jurisdiction of the equipment, but the construction can only be effective after obtaining the consent of all possible affected line operating units.

source_file: 施工管理总则-en-translation.txt
content: When submitting the plan, all elements of the construction must be truthfully reported, and the construction impact and other safety-related elements must be clearly understood by the reporting department and noted. ##施工管理总则 Construction plan management Plan declaration, approval and related regulations Construction plan declaration regulations of non-governmental units

source_file: 施工管理总则-en-translation.txt
content: The external unit shall take the "Construction Plan Approval Form" (see Appendix A of the General Provisions of Construction Management) to the line operating unit for review; The business centralization department of the line operation unit shall review the construction plan with the cooperating department;

source_file: 施工管理总则-en-translation.txt
content: The external unit is qualified to declare the construction plan after signing the "Safety Agreement" with the operating unit with the "Construction Plan Approval Form" after the review, and participating in the construction personnel training organized by the operating unit.

source_file: 施工管理总则-en-translation.txt
content: The external unit submits the relevant construction plan to the centralized management department, which selects the construction supervisor and submits the plan to the operating unit. External units carry out construction operations in accordance with the relevant provisions of the "Construction Management Rules" of each line, and accept the assessment

source_file: 施工管理总则-en-translation.txt
content: of relevant departments according to the assessment indicators. ##施工管理总则 Construction plan management Plan declaration, approval and related regulations Monthly plan declaration principles The construction unit shall send the equipment maintenance plan for the next month to the line operation and management unit before the 20th (including the 20th) of each

source_file: 施工管理总则-en-translation.txt
content: month in accordance with the relevant maintenance procedures. Construction plan management Plan declaration, approval and related regulations Weekly plan declaration principles The weekly plan shall be submitted by the applicant at least one week before the start of the operation. Each line determines the submission time node according to the

source_file: 施工管理总则-en-translation.txt
content: actual situation. Construction plan management Plan declaration, approval and related regulations Supplementary plan declaration principles The daily supplementary plan should be submitted by the applicant at least 7 hours before the start of the assignment.

source_file: 施工管理总则-en-translation.txt
content: The daily supplementary plan involving fault maintenance should be arranged in a timely manner and is not limited by the weekly plan. Construction plan management Plan declaration, approval and related regulations Temporary repair plan declaration process

source_file: 施工管理总则-en-translation.txt
content: The temporary repair plan should be submitted by the applicant 3 hours before the start of the operation. The corresponding fault must have corresponding fault records and fault work orders in the fault system. Temporary repair plans should be prioritized and not limited by weekly and daily supplementary plans.

source_file: 施工管理总则-en-translation.txt
content: Construction plan management Plan declaration, approval and related regulations Emergency repair operation declaration process The main line emergency repair operation shall be issued by OCC to the production dispatch/maintenance scheduling emergency repair order number according to the degree of impact, and under special circumstances, the production dispatcher/maintenance dispatcher shall apply

source_file: 施工管理总则-en-translation.txt
content: to OCC for an emergency repair order through a recorded telephone. The emergency repair operation of the depot shall be handled in accordance with the operation rules of each line depot.

source_file: 施工管理总则-en-translation.txt
content: The main line emergency repair operation does not require a construction approval number, and a line adjustment code needs to be given. ##施工管理总则 Construction plan management Construction plan Scope of use of construction plan

source_file: 施工管理总则-en-translation.txt
content: The construction unit needs to prepare a construction plan for the technical transformation of existing equipment and facilities carried out by the operating unit on the operation line or the construction management working group deems it necessary to prepare a construction plan, and the construction unit needs to prepare a construction plan for the construction carried out by the operating unit on the operation line, which will be implemented after being countersigned and approved by the relevant departments of the operating unit;

source_file: 施工管理总则-en-translation.txt
content: Periodic and phased construction and maintenance operations are carried out, and when the operation area or scope of influence is not expanded, a general construction plan can be formulated for countersigning and approval; before operation, a specific plan must be formulated according to the actual situation and implemented after review by the centralized management unit.

source_file: 施工管理总则-en-translation.txt
content: In order to ensure that the construction can start on the scheduled date, the construction plan should be countersigned and approved one week before the scheduled start date in principle. ##施工管理总则 Construction plan management Construction plan Construction plan classification

source_file: 施工管理总则-en-translation.txt
content: According to the scope of construction influence, the construction plan is divided into line and network level construction plan, company level construction plan and departmental level construction plan. The line-network level construction plan refers to the construction plan issued by the construction operation of complex operations, affecting multiple lines and

source_file: 施工管理总则-en-translation.txt
content: a large impact area, and requiring multi-unit, multi-departmental and multi-professional joint construction operations. For example: Technical transformation of driving equipment and facilities, affecting the driving organization of multiple lines, or causing changes in the performance of driving equipment on multiple lines. Such as software upgrades, main office transformations, new lines,

source_file: 施工管理总则-en-translation.txt
content: etc. The construction plan for the expansion and transformation of the transfer station seriously affects the quality of fire protection and passenger transport services and the use of equipment and facilities; The construction management working group believes that it is necessary to review the construction plan of multiple line operators.

source_file: 施工管理总则-en-translation.txt
content: The company-level construction plan refers to the construction plan issued by the construction operation with complex operation content, affecting a single line and a large impact area, and requiring multi-departmental and multi-professional joint construction operations. For example:

source_file: 施工管理总则-en-translation.txt
content: The technical transformation of driving equipment and facilities affects the driving organization of the line and causes changes in the performance of the driving equipment. Closed entrances and exits, multi-station equipment transformation, equipment linkage above the whole station range, etc.; Construction plans that seriously affect the quality of single-line fire

source_file: 施工管理总则-en-translation.txt
content: protection, passenger transport services and the use of equipment and facilities; The construction management working group believes that it is necessary to review the construction plan of a single line operating unit.

source_file: 施工管理总则-en-translation.txt
content: The departmental construction plan refers to the construction plan issued by the construction operation with simple operation content and only a few professional cooperation. For example: turnout replacement, catenary maintenance, daily commissioning of trains, etc.:

source_file: 施工管理总则-en-translation.txt
content: construction plans other than the line network level and company level are included in departmental management; Other construction plans deemed necessary by the department. ##施工管理总则 Construction plan management construction plan construction plan approval process Line network level construction scheme:

source_file: 施工管理总则-en-translation.txt
content: The equipment management department of the line operation unit will issue the construction plan, and the technical department of the line operation unit will be responsible for organizing the plan review meeting, and invite the heads of relevant units and departments to review and countersign the plan. After the countersigning is passed, the construction will be submitted for implementation as planned.

source_file: 施工管理总则-en-translation.txt
content: Company-level construction plan: The equipment management department of the line operating unit shall issue the construction plan, and be responsible for organizing the plan review meeting, and inviting the heads of relevant departments to review and countersign the plan. After the countersigning is passed, the construction will be submitted for

source_file: 施工管理总则-en-translation.txt
content: implementation as planned. Departmental construction plan: The operation department of the maintenance unit will issue a construction plan, and send the professional engineers of the department and relevant personnel of the cooperating department to review and countersign the plan. After the countersigning is passed, the construction will be submitted for

source_file: 施工管理总则-en-translation.txt
content: implementation as planned. ##施工管理总则 Construction plan management Construction plan Construction plan preparation requirements The construction plan must include the following contents: project overview, construction time and location, scope of influence, construction organization, construction preparation, construction method, cooperating departments and requirements, safety management measures and emergency plans, protection of existing equipment,

source_file: 施工管理总则-en-translation.txt
content: etc.; The construction unit must refine and supplement according to the specific situation of the construction. Project Overview: refers to the main situation of the construction, including the project name, the name of the participating units, the construction object, the construction project, etc.;

source_file: 施工管理总则-en-translation.txt
content: Construction time and location: refers to the implementation period and specific operation location of the construction; Scope of influence: refers to the specific impact and construction requirements of the construction on the existing order and status of the driving organization, passenger transport organization, equipment and facility status, building structure, etc.;

source_file: 施工管理总则-en-translation.txt
content: Construction organization: refers to the organizational structure, key position leaders, their responsibilities and relationships with each other of the construction; ##施工管理总则 Construction plan management Construction plan Construction plan preparation requirements

source_file: 施工管理总则-en-translation.txt
content: Construction preparation: refers to the preparation of the necessary elements of the construction such as technology, materials, machinery and equipment, personnel, etc., whether it meets the construction needs, and the technical documents and disclosure documents required for the construction should be submitted together;

source_file: 施工管理总则-en-translation.txt
content: Construction method: refers to the specific operation time, location, implementation steps, specific requirements, implementation standards and objectives of the construction; Cooperate with departments and requirements: When the construction requires the operating company to cooperate with the operation, clarify the cooperation department and cooperative matters;

source_file: 施工管理总则-en-translation.txt
content: Safety management measures and emergency plans: refers to the safety key points and implementation requirements, risk points and preventive measures, protective measures and handling methods in emergency situations of the construction, and establishes an emergency liaison mechanism;

source_file: 施工管理总则-en-translation.txt
content: Protection of existing equipment: refers to the protection or protective measures of existing equipment taken in the relevant areas such as material and equipment transfer, construction site, etc.; Other requirements: necessary explanations and supplements to the plan by the construction unit. ##施工管理总则

source_file: 施工管理总则-en-translation.txt
content: Construction safety management Responsibilities of the person in charge of construction/construction liaison The person in charge of construction shall be responsible for the overall construction of the work; Responsible for the safety management of operators and equipment; Responsible for handling the procedures for requesting and selling points;

source_file: 施工管理总则-en-translation.txt
content: Responsible for the organization and command of the operation process; Responsible for timely contact with stations and depots related matters; Responsible for the implementation or confirmation of operational safety protection measures (the power outage of the catenary and the hanging ground wire need to be notified of the ESC);

source_file: 施工管理总则-en-translation.txt
content: Responsible for confirming that the construction area is cleared and the equipment status is returned to normal. Construction safety management Responsibilities of construction supervisors Assist external units to handle construction sales points, and check the construction protection and labor protection of personnel in other units;

source_file: 施工管理总则-en-translation.txt
content: Responsible for counting the construction personnel entering and leaving the operation area; Responsible for supervising the safety of construction operations of external units; Responsible for inspecting the personnel and items (tools, materials, construction waste, etc.) of external units to clear the line, and give feedback to the station;

source_file: 施工管理总则-en-translation.txt
content: Check and confirm that the operating equipment used in the construction has returned to normal use and has been reinforced and will not invade the driving limit, and give feedback to the station;

source_file: 施工管理总则-en-translation.txt
content: Inspect and supervise the comprehensive management of personnel from other units cooperating with the operation (theft, smoking, etc.). Construction safety management Qualifications for the person in charge of construction/liaison/supervisor Be familiar with the "Driving Organization Rules", "Construction Management Rules" and other relevant regulations of this line;

source_file: 施工管理总则-en-translation.txt
content: be familiar with the nature, content, methods, steps, requirements, etc. of the homework; Have safety knowledge and skills related to this operation; must be submitted by the company and maintenance units to the list of personnel, or pass the organized training examination to obtain the construction person in charge certificate;

source_file: 施工管理总则-en-translation.txt
content: The person in charge of construction/liaison/supervisor shall uniformly obtain the certificate of the person in charge of construction. ##施工管理总则 Construction safety management Construction protection The protection of construction operations follows the principle of "who sets it, who removes", and implements "automatic control, mutual control, and other control".

source_file: 施工管理总则-en-translation.txt
content: All construction operations must be set up in accordance with the construction management regulations and the provisions of the maintenance procedures of each specialty, and the person in charge of construction should check and implement the safety protection measures of the work to ensure that the protection is in place and eliminate potential safety hazards. All construction operation units should further formulate and implement safety protection measures according to the nature and actual situation of each specialty to ensure the safety of construction operations.

source_file: 施工管理总则-en-translation.txt
content: All construction workers entering the line construction must wear fluorescent clothing and labor protection shoes (safety helmets must be worn for underground, tunnel and high-altitude work), and use other safety protective equipment according to the nature of the operation and operation requirements. Before construction, the person in charge of construction should organize construction members to conduct pre-shift safety education.

source_file: 施工管理总则-en-translation.txt
content: After the construction is completed, the construction manager/liaison/supervisor must ensure that the line is cleared and the equipment condition returns to normal. Red flashing light protection for construction operations: Driving operations entering the rail area must be protected by red flashing lights in accordance with regulations, and non-driving operations may

source_file: 施工管理总则-en-translation.txt
content: not be equipped with red flashing lights, and red flashing lights must be set up after connecting to the ground wire. When one end of the engineering train or commissioning train operation area belongs to the end line, there is no need to set up red flashing light protection at

source_file: 施工管理总则-en-translation.txt
content: the end of the end line. The construction protection in the parking lot shall be implemented in accordance with the relevant provisions of the relevant parking lot operation rules. ##施工管理总则 Construction safety management Construction safety

source_file: 施工管理总则-en-translation.txt
content: When people and engineering trains operate in the same area, the person in charge of construction and the conductor shall coordinate according to the on-site situation according to the following principles:

source_file: 施工管理总则-en-translation.txt
content: According to the direction of construction, the train is in front and the personnel are behind, and in principle, it must not be reversed or there is operation before and after the train runs;

source_file: 施工管理总则-en-translation.txt
content: There should be a safety separation distance of more than 50 meters between non-accompanying construction personnel and the train, and in principle, the train should not retreat casually; if there is a need for EMUs, the person in charge of construction must negotiate with the conductor before moving on to ensure personal safety;

source_file: 施工管理总则-en-translation.txt
content: Operators should set up a red flashing light in the direction of incoming vehicles in their own on-site operation area to protect them. Catenary live charge, power outage and ground wire protection:

source_file: 施工管理总则-en-translation.txt
content: For non-hanging ground line construction, the safety distance between the operator, including the equipment, materials, parts, etc., and the catenary should be at least 2 meters. The catenary in the power outage area where it is not clear whether the catenary is live and the ground wire is not hung

source_file: 施工管理总则-en-translation.txt
content: is considered to be electrified. Other construction operations are not allowed to be arranged in the protected area of the construction operation of engineering trains and commissioning trains. If you want to carry out hot work during the construction operation, you must apply for the "Fire Safety Management Measures" of

source_file: 施工管理总则-en-translation.txt
content: each line, and it is strictly forbidden to carry out hot work without the "Fire Operation Permit". ##施工管理总则 Construction organization and management Please take time for the main line construction

source_file: 施工管理总则-en-translation.txt
content: In principle, after the operation is completed and all trains return to the site, OCC will accept the station construction request procedures uniformly after confirming that the construction conditions are met according to the construction plan of the day. Under special circumstances, after the last train leaves the station and related areas, and other operating conditions are met, the start of operation can be approved.

source_file: 施工管理总则-en-translation.txt
content: The construction personnel should arrive at the request point before the approved construction start time, and at the same time reserve enough time for the registration of the request process and the inventory of personnel and equipment to ensure that the construction starts on time.

source_file: 施工管理总则-en-translation.txt
content: Construction organization and management The main line construction sales point time The main line construction sales point time should reserve sufficient pre-operation inspection time to ensure that the first train of the operation chart is driven out normally. Construction organization management Construction entry certificate

source_file: 施工管理总则-en-translation.txt
content: Internal unit/maintenance unit: construction notice, work permit/construction person in charge certificate. External units: "Construction Plan Approval Form", construction notice, construction person in charge certificate. ##施工管理总则 Construction organization and management Construction request point regulations

source_file: 施工管理总则-en-translation.txt
content: After the construction is completed, the person in charge of construction confirms that the line is cleared, the equipment is returned to normal and the self-protection is dismantled and then goes to the station/signal building to carry out the cancellation point. At the same time, it is necessary to clarify and strengthen the management and process of auxiliary station sales points and off-site sales points. Each line operating unit should sort out a clear process of requesting points to ensure that the construction is carried out in an orderly manner. The authority of the request point for various construction plans is as follows:

source_file: 施工管理总则-en-translation.txt
content: Class A construction can only be carried out after approval; Class B construction can only be carried out after site survey approval; Class C construction can only be carried out after approval by the territorial management department;

source_file: 施工管理总则-en-translation.txt
content: The construction of Class A at the line network level can only be carried out after the approval of the operation and adjustment of the affected lines; The construction of Class B at the line network level can only be carried out after the field adjustment of the affected lines

source_file: 施工管理总则-en-translation.txt
content: is approved; The construction of Class C at the line network level must be approved by the local management department of the affected line before it can be carried out; ##施工管理总则 Relevant regulations on catenary power outage and transmission operation Catenary power supply zone power outage

source_file: 施工管理总则-en-translation.txt
content: The conditions for power outage and transmission of the main line catenary shall be jointly confirmed by the duty director, the line adjustment, and the power control system, and it is necessary to strictly follow the power outage and transmission process, strictly control the safety points of each type, confirm the site situation with the person in charge of construction, and operate after meeting the relevant conditions to ensure that there is no error.

source_file: 施工管理总则-en-translation.txt
content: The conditions for power outage and transmission of the catenary in the parking lot are jointly confirmed by the duty director, the line adjustment, the electric conditioning and the field adjustment, and it is necessary to strictly follow the power outage and transmission process, strictly control the safety points of each type of adjustment, confirm the site situation with the person in charge of construction, and operate after meeting the relevant conditions to ensure that there is no error.

source_file: 施工管理总则-en-translation.txt
content: Relevant regulations on catenary power outage and transmission operation Procedures for hanging (dismantling) ground wires of the main line catenary The ESC should strictly control the operation points, confirm the site situation with the person in charge of construction, and operate after meeting the relevant conditions. The hanging and dismantling

source_file: 施工管理总则-en-translation.txt
content: of the ground wire must be operated by professionally qualified personnel. When working under the catenary or near its live body, the construction operation department or unit should indicate when submitting the plan according to the nature of the operation, the distance between the catenary and the catenary during operation,

source_file: 施工管理总则-en-translation.txt
content: and relevant regulations: no power outage is required (2m away), power outage is required to hang the ground wire (1m and less than 1m away from the catenary), power outage is required but does not need to be hung on the ground wire (1m away from the catenary, 2m and

source_file: 施工管理总则-en-translation.txt
content: below), and must be electrified. ##施工管理总则 Organization of engineering trains or commissioning trains When it is necessary to carry out engineering trains and commissioning train operations on the main line, the construction party needs to prepare relevant operation task books before commissioning. All task books need to be filled in

source_file: 施工管理总则-en-translation.txt
content: by the person in charge of construction/commissioning, drivers, etc., and the relevant task books should be submitted to the driver and the vehicle department for the record after the construction is completed.

source_file: 施工管理总则-en-translation.txt
content: The person in charge of construction should contact the site survey in advance and report on the preparation of materials, and the person in charge of site adjustment/construction should contact the site survey 1 hour before the start of construction to confirm the exit time, operation path, operation mode, etc.

source_file: 施工管理总则-en-translation.txt
content: Engineering trains or commissioning trains must ensure smooth wireless communication and good technical condition before entering the main line. After the construction vehicle arrives at the designated construction operation area, the dispatch shall issue a dispatch order to block the area in time; after the construction is completed, the relevant

source_file: 施工管理总则-en-translation.txt
content: lines shall be opened and the engineering vehicle shall be arranged to return to the factory. ##施工管理总则 Organization of engineering trains or commissioning trains When multiple traffic paths are involved, the construction must be organized according to a single path first, that is, all the turnouts on a single driving

source_file: 施工管理总则-en-translation.txt
content: path are locked individually, and the person in charge of construction can only direct the driver to carry out construction after receiving the notice that the turnouts on the road are locked.

source_file: 施工管理总则-en-translation.txt
content: The engineering train is in the blockade construction area with the instructions of the person in charge of construction; When the transfer operation is required in the blockade area, the person in charge of construction must confirm the safety of the transfer line before applying for a transfer to the line transfer. After the transfer is completed, the transfer must prepare the next driving path and lock the turnout separately, and then notify the person in charge of construction to organize the construction of the path.

source_file: 施工管理总则-en-translation.txt
content: ##施工管理总则 Statistical analysis Each line operator needs to formulate statistical analysis indicators based on actual conditions, including but not limited to the following: the actual number of completed projects of monthly plans, weekly plans, daily supplementary plans, and temporary repair plans;

source_file: 施工管理总则-en-translation.txt
content: the fulfillment rate of monthly plans, weekly plans, daily supplementary plans, and temporary repair plans; the accuracy of monthly plans, weekly plans, daily supplementary plans, and temporary repair plans; the number and reasons for the construction pieces that have not been completed according to the monthly plan, weekly plan, daily

source_file: 施工管理总则-en-translation.txt
content: supplementary plan and temporary repair plan; The utilization rate of construction time for completed monthly, weekly, and daily supplementary plans, that is, the ratio of actual construction time to planned construction time. Each line operator needs to formulate monthly and annual reports for construction data analysis. Supplementary Provisions

source_file: 施工管理总则-en-translation.txt
content: The general rules of construction management shall be interpreted by the dispatching department of the operation branch and implemented from the date of promulgation. Appendix General Provisions of Construction Management Appendix A "Construction Plan Approval Form"

content: (4) Retain relevant evidence.In the process of handling incidents, means such as recording, screenshots, backups, and video recordings may be used to record in detail the occurrence, development, and disposal process, steps, and results of the incident. source_file: 生产系统软件升级管理规定（试行）-en-translation.txt
content: Production system software: refers to the system that controls and coordinates computers and external devices, supports the development and operation of application software, is a collection of various programs without user intervention, and is responsible for managing various independent hardware in the computer system, so that they can work in harmony.

source_file: 生产系统软件升级管理规定（试行）-en-translation.txt
content: Upgrade: refers to the software update that modifies equipment programs and system parameters or adds new functions to make the equipment run better and get the optimization effect. Revert: Refers to an activity where there is a problem using the software online and it is reverted to a previous version.

source_file: 生产系统软件升级管理规定（试行）-en-translation.txt
content: External units: refers to suppliers, design units, construction units, system equipment manufacturers and other units other than operating branches. Demand department: The department that proposes upgrade requirements for existing software functions is the demand department. Focal department: The management department of production system software is the centralized department.

source_file: 生产系统软件升级管理规定（试行）-en-translation.txt
content: Maintenance unit: refers to facility and equipment maintenance unit and vehicle maintenance unit. Relevant departments: departments involved in the organization and implementation of production system software upgrades (use departments, interface management departments, etc.). ##生产系统软件升级管理规定 (Trial) Responsibilities Demand department Responsible for proposing upgrade requirements to the centralized department.

source_file: 生产系统软件升级管理规定（试行）-en-translation.txt
content: Responsible for verifying, tracking, and inspecting the functions of cooperating with the production system software upgrade. Responsibilities Centralized department Responsible for the formulation, revision, review and implementation of production system upgrade management regulations of the operation branch.

source_file: 生产系统软件升级管理规定（试行）-en-translation.txt
content: Responsible for leading and organizing relevant units to prepare production system software upgrade plans. Responsible for soliciting opinions from various departments and carrying out the review and countersigning process. Responsible for leading the implementation, tracking, inspection and verification of the production system software upgrade plan. Responsibilities Relevant departments

source_file: 生产系统软件升级管理规定（试行）-en-translation.txt
content: Responsible for the review and countersigning of the production system software upgrade plan and related technical data. According to the functional management scope of the department, cooperate with the demand department and the centralized department to carry out software upgrades.

source_file: 生产系统软件升级管理规定（试行）-en-translation.txt
content: The software upgrade plan of the primary and secondary production system needs to be submitted to the Ministry of Quality and Safety for review and signature. ##生产系统软件升级管理规定 (trial) hierarchical management of production system software upgrades

source_file: 生产系统软件升级管理规定（试行）-en-translation.txt
content: Upgrades are divided into three levels according to the impact on driving safety and passenger service quality: the impact on driving safety and the service quality of passengers on the line network is set as the first level, and the heads of relevant departments of the centralized department and the

source_file: 生产系统软件升级管理规定（试行）-en-translation.txt
content: maintenance unit are responsible for the upgrade process and monitoring and control; those that affect the service quality of passengers are set as second-level, and the professional engineers of the centralized department and the heads of relevant departments of the maintenance unit are responsible for the follow-up and control of

source_file: 生产系统软件升级管理规定（试行）-en-translation.txt
content: the upgrade process; It is set as level 3 that does not affect driving safety and passenger service quality, and the professional engineers of the maintenance unit are responsible for the upgrade process and monitoring and control.

source_file: 生产系统软件升级管理规定（试行）-en-translation.txt
content: For the upgrade classification list, please refer to Appendix A of the Regulations on the Management of Production System Software Upgrades (Trial) "Classification List of Production System Software Upgrades". ##生产系统软件升级管理规定 (trial) hierarchical management of production system software upgrades The software upgrade of the operating branch adopts a hierarchical approval method.

source_file: 生产系统软件升级管理规定（试行）-en-translation.txt
content: The first-level software upgrade is proposed by the demand department, and the centralized department cooperates with the preparation of the plan and fills in the "Production System First-level Software Upgrade Approval Form" (Annex A of the Production System Software Upgrade Management Regulations (Trial)), which is countersigned by the Quality and Safety Department, relevant units and departments, and reported to the leader in charge of the software centralization department of the operation branch for approval and approval before implementation.

source_file: 生产系统软件升级管理规定（试行）-en-translation.txt
content: The secondary software upgrade is proposed by the production system software requirements department, and the production system software centralization department cooperates with the preparation of the plan and fills in the "Production System Secondary Software Upgrade Approval Form" (Annex B of the Production System Software Upgrade Management Regulations (Trial)), which is countersigned by relevant units and departments after review, and reported to the Ministry of Quality and Safety for approval before implementation.

source_file: 生产系统软件升级管理规定（试行）-en-translation.txt
content: The three-level software upgrade is proposed by the production system software requirements department, and the production system software centralization department cooperates with the preparation of the plan and fills in the "Production System Three-level Software Upgrade Approval Form" (Production System Software Upgrade Management Regulations (Trial) Appendix C), which is countersigned by relevant units and departments after review, and reported to the person in charge of the production system software centralization department for approval and approval.

source_file: 生产系统软件升级管理规定（试行）-en-translation.txt
content: Production system software upgrades involving professional interfaces and equipment operations, interfaces and function changes must be countersigned and approved by the professional interface and user departments. ##生产系统软件升级管理规定 (Trial) Production system software upgrade management and requirements

source_file: 生产系统软件升级管理规定（试行）-en-translation.txt
content: In principle, all production system software upgrades should be piloted and tested first, and then fully promoted and rolled out. According to the requirements of production system software upgrades, the production system software centralization department requires external units to modify the production system software and provide necessary production system software

source_file: 生产系统软件升级管理规定（试行）-en-translation.txt
content: modification instructions, production system software test reports, production system software upgrade plans (pilot tests) (if any), production system software upgrade plans, safety commitments (or security certifications) and other technical information:

source_file: 生产系统软件升级管理规定（试行）-en-translation.txt
content: The production system software modification instructions mainly describe the changes and reasons for the changes of this version of the production system software compared with the previous version of the production system software.

source_file: 生产系统软件升级管理规定（试行）-en-translation.txt
content: The production system software test report must include the laboratory (or on-site) test content, test standards, test results and test conclusions of this version of the production system software. The production system software upgrade plan (pilot test) mainly includes the test purpose, test content, test time, test equipment, scope of

source_file: 生产系统软件升级管理规定（试行）-en-translation.txt
content: influence, test result analysis, test conclusion, etc., of which the test time is determined according to the influence scope and characteristics of the production system software upgrade. The production system software upgrade plan (Appendix B of the Regulations on the Management of Production System Software Upgrade (Trial)) mainly includes the

source_file: 生产系统软件升级管理规定（试行）-en-translation.txt
content: upgrade time, content, implementation scope, scope of influence, implementation plan and steps, upgrade procedures, functional verification and other specific contents and steps, as well as relevant cooperating departments and cooperating contents and projects. The production system software upgrade plan includes but is not limited to the production system software upgrade

source_file: 生产系统软件升级管理规定（试行）-en-translation.txt
content: pilot test report, the production system software function test plan, the production system software upgrade emergency recovery plan and safety measures and the production system software modification part of the list of all interfaces. ##生产系统软件升级管理规定 (Trial) Production system software upgrade management and requirements

source_file: 生产系统软件升级管理规定（试行）-en-translation.txt
content: According to the requirements of production system software upgrades, the production system software centralization department requires external units to modify the production system software and provide necessary production system software modification instructions, production system software test reports, production system software upgrade plans (pilot tests) (if any), production system software upgrade plans, safety commitments (or security certifications) and other technical information:

source_file: 生产系统软件升级管理规定（试行）-en-translation.txt
content: Security commitment or security certification mainly promises or certifies that all test results are true and valid, and that the production system software is safe and reliable, including but not limited to test results, test conclusions and production system software version information.

source_file: 生产系统软件升级管理规定（试行）-en-translation.txt
content: Other technical materials include instructions, technical manuals, maintenance manuals, drawings, production system software test reports, etc. During the pilot test, the production system software was modified and must be re-tested and declared. Test data and records must be kept on record for future reference.

source_file: 生产系统软件升级管理规定（试行）-en-translation.txt
content: Production system software without a production system software inspection report or a production company safety assessment report is prohibited from testing or upgrading on the equipment. If the equipment during operation finds problems with the production system software and needs to return the previous version of the production system software,

source_file: 生产系统软件升级管理规定（试行）-en-translation.txt
content: it must be approved by the person in charge of the production system software centralization department, and the first-level production system software must be reported to the Quality and Safety Department. ##生产系统软件升级管理规定 (Trial) Production System Software Upgrade Procedure Production system upgrade application approval

source_file: 生产系统软件升级管理规定（试行）-en-translation.txt
content: The production system software centralization department and the demand department review the production system software upgrade plan and related materials. The production system software upgrade project can only be implemented after approval at all levels.

source_file: 生产系统软件升级管理规定（试行）-en-translation.txt
content: In principle, the relevant departments should not exceed 3 working days from receiving the review materials to issuing approval opinions. After receiving the approval opinions of each department, the centralized department organizes a special meeting on the software upgrade of the production system to negotiate the cooperation of various departments.

source_file: 生产系统软件升级管理规定（试行）-en-translation.txt
content: ##生产系统软件升级管理规定 (Trial) Production System Software Upgrade Program Production system software upgrade implementation The on-site production system software upgrade centralized department is responsible for the implementation of specific production system software upgrades, and the demand department is responsible for the production system software upgrade and cooperation.

source_file: 生产系统软件升级管理规定（试行）-en-translation.txt
content: Before implementing the software upgrade of the on-site production system, the centralized department must conduct technical disclosure. In the process of implementing the software upgrade of the production system, the card control measures of one-person operation and one-person monitoring must be strictly implemented.

source_file: 生产系统软件升级管理规定（试行）-en-translation.txt
content: The original production system software data should be backed up before the production system software upgrade or test, and if the test fails, problems are found, or it is not expected to be completed on time beyond the planned time during the upgrade or testing, the original production system software should be restored immediately.

source_file: 生产系统软件升级管理规定（试行）-en-translation.txt
content: After the new production system software is updated on the equipment, it must be verified in accordance with the requirements of the production system software upgrade plan, and the test results must be recorded, including the test item, tester, test date, equipment name, test location, etc., and the test results must be signed and confirmed by the external unit, the software centralization department and the cooperating department.

source_file: 生产系统软件升级管理规定（试行）-en-translation.txt
content: ##生产系统软件升级管理规定 (trial) Production system software upgrade program ledger management The production system software centralization department establishes a professional production system software version management ledger (Annex D) according to the system and equipment, and does a good job in tracking and managing the production system software version during the application process.

source_file: 生产系统软件升级管理规定（试行）-en-translation.txt
content: After each production system software upgrade, the production system software ledger information should be updated in time. The production system software centralization department shall establish production system software files, including but not limited to each version of the production system software itself and production system software related information after delivery

source_file: 生产系统软件升级管理规定（试行）-en-translation.txt
content: and operation. If any production system software upgrade fails, or a failure occurs due to an error in the production system software upgrade, the production system software centralized department must cooperate in preparing a report, and the failure affecting driving and passenger transport services must be submitted to the Quality

source_file: 生产系统软件升级管理规定（试行）-en-translation.txt
content: and Safety Department within 3 working days. The report includes, but is not limited to, an overview of the software upgrade of the production system, the reasons for the failure, and the next steps. ##生产系统软件升级管理规定 (Trial) Appendix

source_file: 网络与数据安全管理办法-en-translation.txt
content: Network and data security management measures Purpose In order to further strengthen the network and data security management of the operating branch, improve the ability and level of network and data security assurance, ensure the normal operation of information systems, networks and computer rooms, ensure the continuity and security of

source_file: 网络与数据安全管理办法-en-translation.txt
content: system business applications, ensure the integrity, confidentiality and availability of data and information, and ensure the legalization of software, so as to support the normal development of the business of the operating branch, combined with the requirements of the digital reform of the city and the group and the actual

source_file: 网络与数据安全管理办法-en-translation.txt
content: situation of the operating branch, the "Network and Data Security Management Measures" are specially formulated. Scope of application The scope of application of the "Network and Data Security Management Measures" is to departments or individuals who use the networks, systems and software under the jurisdiction of the operating branch.

source_file: 网络与数据安全管理办法-en-translation.txt
content: Citation standards Interim Measures for the Management of Network and Information Security, Wen Tietou [2022] No. 115 "Interim Measures for the Data Security Management of Wenzhou Railway Investment Group" Wen Tietou [2023] No. 164 "Informatization Project Management Measures" Wen Tietou Operation [2024] No. 2 Definition

source_file: 网络与数据安全管理办法-en-translation.txt
content: Network refers to the internal management network of the operation branch (i.e., the operation management information system network that provides services for the internal management of the operation) and the production network (the information system network that provides the infrastructure management platform for the operation and production).

source_file: 网络与数据安全管理办法-en-translation.txt
content: Data refers to the data generated by the information system under the jurisdiction of the operating branch (including computer, server and network data, software, documents, etc.). Software refers to the operating system, office software (WPS, etc.) and anti-virus software of computers under the jurisdiction of the operating branch.

source_file: 网络与数据安全管理办法-en-translation.txt
content: Enterprise data processors refer to departments and affiliated units that independently determine the purpose and method of processing in data processing activities, including but not limited to data collection, storage, use, modification, processing, transmission, provision, and disclosure carried out through information technology or other means.

source_file: 网络与数据安全管理办法-en-translation.txt
content: Information products include seven categories: databases (distributed databases and centralized databases), operating systems (desktop operating systems and server operating systems), general servers, workstations, all-in-one computers, portable computers, and desktop computers. Organizational structure and responsibilities Technical Contracts Department

source_file: 网络与数据安全管理办法-en-translation.txt
content: Formulate network and data security, software legalization work plans and related systems, standards, and specifications of operating branches; Responsible for reviewing the network security plan of the information project; inspect and spot check the implementation of network and data security and software legalization work of various departments;

source_file: 网络与数据安全管理办法-en-translation.txt
content: Take the lead in organizing the handling of network security incidents and the rectification of software legalization, and summarize and count network security incidents and software legalization ledgers; Take the lead in organizing various departments to promote the application of information and innovation products and the filing of other guarantees;

source_file: 网络与数据安全管理办法-en-translation.txt
content: Organize and operate the publicity and implementation of network and information security and software legalization of branches; Cooperate with the group's big data management department to carry out other related work. departments

source_file: 网络与数据安全管理办法-en-translation.txt
content: Responsible for handling network security incidents and software legalization rectification according to departmental responsibilities, and providing supporting materials required for software legalization; According to the responsibilities of the department, it is responsible for formulating emergency plans and on-site disposal plans for relevant system network security;

source_file: 网络与数据安全管理办法-en-translation.txt
content: Responsible for formulating, reviewing and implementing the network security plan of the information project; Responsible for the implementation of the application of Xinchuang products and the filing of other guarantees; Responsible for implementing the requirements of enterprise data processing activities;

source_file: 网络与数据安全管理办法-en-translation.txt
content: Cooperate with the completion of network and data security and software legalization publicity and implementation; Cooperate with the technical contract department and superior departments to carry out other related work. Data information personnel

source_file: 网络与数据安全管理办法-en-translation.txt
content: Application specialist: Promote the system (module) under its jurisdiction in the operating branch, and clarify the scope and permission of the system (module). Data Specialist: Supervises the data processing activities carried out in the operating branch of the system (module) under its jurisdiction to ensure that the data in the

source_file: 网络与数据安全管理办法-en-translation.txt
content: system (module) is correct and standardized and complies with the standards. Network and data security administrator: cooperate with or assist the relevant departments at higher levels to carry out network and data security self-inspection and inspection activities in the operation branch, and the information liaison officer of the operation branch

source_file: 网络与数据安全管理办法-en-translation.txt
content: serves as the administrator. Planning and construction management In the early stage of project approval for the construction of information projects, network security plans should be formulated simultaneously in the overall system plan. New R&D information projects should determine the level of protection in the overall system plan.

source_file: 网络与数据安全管理办法-en-translation.txt
content: Implement a network and data security protection system. All departments organize and carry out information system security protection level grading, filing, evaluation, and rectification with reference to the "Basic Requirements for Network Security Level Protection of Information Security Technology" (GB/T22239).

source_file: 网络与数据安全管理办法-en-translation.txt
content: In the process of network system planning, upgrading, transformation and construction, the network construction plan should be organized and reviewed to form corresponding review records. All departments should strengthen the bidding and procurement management of information products, reasonably formulate bidding and procurement plans for information products, and prepare requirements documents.

source_file: 网络与数据安全管理办法-en-translation.txt
content: If the procurement of information products due to special needs does not pass the safety and reliability assessment requirements, the expert demonstration of exceptional procurement should be organized in the preparation stage of the demand document, and the project approval work should be carried out in accordance with the approval procedures for the procurement and project bidding projects of the group's state-owned enterprises after obtaining the demonstration results. The final list of exception procurement shall be reported to the technical contract department and the group network security and information technology department for the record according to the responsibilities.

source_file: 网络与数据安全管理办法-en-translation.txt
content: The procurement, operation and maintenance of confidential products, network security products, cryptographic products and other supporting equipment shall be carried out in accordance with relevant national regulations. Strengthen the work of software legalization and insist on using genuine software. O&M security management

source_file: 网络与数据安全管理办法-en-translation.txt
content: The management of security aspects such as employees and external personnel, information assets, computer rooms, network configuration and accounts, security assessments, terminals, virus protection, security monitoring and auditing, accounts, passwords and permissions, configuration changes, training, vulnerability reinforcement, patches, etc. shall comply with the provisions of the "Information System Security Management Regulations", and the management of operation management information systems shall be implemented with reference to the Group's "Interim Measures for Network and Information Security Management".

source_file: 网络与数据安全管理办法-en-translation.txt
content: In the event of an incident endangering network and data security, it shall be implemented in accordance with the "Special Emergency Plan for Cybersecurity Emergencies (Trial)". All departments should strengthen the operation and maintenance management of information products, and it is strictly forbidden to use virtual machines or other methods

source_file: 网络与数据安全管理办法-en-translation.txt
content: to replace operating systems and databases with products that have not passed the safety and reliability evaluation during use. Computer users shall comply with the Group's "User Information Security Management Measures". Data security management

source_file: 网络与数据安全管理办法-en-translation.txt
content: The principle of data security work follows: "data security must be managed by managing business data, and data business must be managed by data security", forming a work pattern of joint management.

source_file: 网络与数据安全管理办法-en-translation.txt
content: Data processing activities shall fulfill data security protection obligations, take effective measures to prevent risks such as data tampering, destruction, leakage, improper acquisition and use, ensure that national security, public interests, and the legitimate rights and interests of individuals and organizations are not harmed, and social ethics, business ethics, and professional ethics are observed.

source_file: 网络与数据安全管理办法-en-translation.txt
content: Enterprise data processors shall follow the principles of lawfulness and legitimacy in collecting data, and shall not steal or collect data in other illegal ways. Where enterprise data processors entrust others to carry out data processing activities, they shall clarify the data security responsibilities and obligations of the entrusting party

source_file: 网络与数据安全管理办法-en-translation.txt
content: and the entrusted party by signing contracts and agreements. If an enterprise data processor needs to transfer data due to mergers, restructuring, bankruptcy, or other reasons, it shall clarify the data transfer plan and notify the affected users through telephone, text messages, emails, announcements, etc.

source_file: 网络与数据安全管理办法-en-translation.txt
content: When enterprise data processors provide data externally, they shall specify the scope, categories, conditions, procedures, etc. of the provision. If data is disclosed through network interfaces, it must be realized through the data sharing and exchange platform established by the group.

source_file: 网络与数据安全管理办法-en-translation.txt
content: Enterprise data processors shall analyze and judge the possible impact on national security and public interests before data disclosure, and shall not disclose any significant impact. Enterprise data processors shall establish a data destruction system, clarify the requirements for destruction objects, rules, processes, and technologies, and record and retain destruction

source_file: 网络与数据安全管理办法-en-translation.txt
content: activities. Data processors shall record logs such as data processing, permission management, and personnel operations during the entire life cycle of data. Logs shall be retained for no less than six months.

source_file: 网络与数据安全管理办法-en-translation.txt
content: Data classification is implemented in accordance with the Group's "Interim Measures for Data Security Management of Wenzhou Railway Investment Group". Supervision and notification management The Technology Contract Department will regularly or irregularly carry out spot checks on network and data security and software legalization for various departments.

source_file: 网络与数据安全管理办法-en-translation.txt
content: Establish a notification system for network and data security and software legalization. The technical contract department shall be responsible for editing the notification, and the content of the notification shall include the results of random inspections of network security and software legalization, network security incidents, etc.

source_file: 网络与数据安全管理办法-en-translation.txt
content: The technical contract department puts forward rectification opinions on the occurrence of network security incidents and the installation of non-genuine software, guides the improvement of relevant supporting systems, and includes them in the annual assessment. Supplementary Provisions

source_file: 网络与数据安全管理办法-en-translation.txt
content: The Network and Data Security Management Measures shall be interpreted by the Technical Contract Department and implemented from the date of promulgation. If there is a conflict with national laws, regulations, and standards, the network and data security management measures shall be implemented in accordance with national laws, regulations, and

source_file: 网络与数据安全管理办法-en-translation.txt
content: relevant standards.

(hereinafter referred to as the "operation branch"), clarify the division of responsibilities and notification requirements for information communication, improve

content: Within the scope of the operating line under the jurisdiction of the operating branch, all kinds of incidents affecting the quality of rail transit operation or normal operation order, causing or likely to cause equipment and facility failure, property damage, casualties, negative impact of the operating branch, etc., such information is collectively referred to as operational emergency information.

content: rail transit operation. Common operational risk events are shown in Appendix B. content: Group Company (hereinafter referred to as the Construction and Safety Department). General Management Department It is the centralized management department of the operating branch to deal with the control of media and public opinion.

content: Responsible for receiving operational emergency information, collecting and reviewing incident reports, preparing external announcements, and explaining the incident to social media and relevant departments. Dispatch department It is the centralized management department of the operation of the branch operation emergency information, and is responsible for improving the emergency information notification
