content: mechanism of the operation branch in a timely manner according to the requirements of the group company. Responsible for the notification of emergency information within the scope of the operating branch and the operation management center.

source_file: 运营应急信息通报规则-en-translation.txt
content: Responsible for the collection, summary, verification and analysis of operational emergency information, and the classification and grading of information. When the incident affects the operation equipment and facilities, it is responsible for notifying the maintenance unit of the operation emergency information.

source_file: 运营应急信息通报规则-en-translation.txt
content: When the early warning information of the meteorological department or the relevant data of the meteorological service platform reaches the warning value, it is responsible for publishing meteorological information. In the event of an emergency affecting other operating lines, the OCC of other lines shall be responsible for mutual notification

source_file: 运营应急信息通报规则-en-translation.txt
content: of information. Other departments Formulate and improve the internal information notification mechanism of the department in accordance with these rules to ensure smooth information. After receiving the information, it should respond in a timely manner, handle the incident in accordance with the job responsibilities, accurately grasp the information content, and

source_file: 运营应急信息通报规则-en-translation.txt
content: ensure that the information submitted is true and objective. Responsible for the upload and release of operational emergency information, ensure smooth information, and report to superior leaders or departments in a timely manner. Information classification and grading Emergency information classification

source_file: 运营应急信息通报规则-en-translation.txt
content: According to the degree of impact of the event on the operation, it is divided into level I. information, level II information, level III information, and level IV information from high to low. Level I information Occur of general accidents or above; Dangerous incidents of urban rail transit occur;

source_file: 运营应急信息通报规则-en-translation.txt
content: Launch the special emergency plan of the operation branch and issue a level I response; 30 minutes or more late (8 minutes or more for the first train); Other temporary operating organization adjustments need to be reported to the municipal authorities.

source_file: 运营应急信息通报规则-en-translation.txt
content: Level II information (the following events occur and do not reach level I information) Activate the special emergency plan of the operation branch and issue a level II response; 15 minutes or more and less than 30 minutes late; trains are disconnected and passengers are cleared;

source_file: 运营应急信息通报规则-en-translation.txt
content: When the train exceeds "two stations and two sections" from the terminal station due to signaling equipment failure, it is downgraded to a mode without ATP protection to carry passengers beyond the distance of "one station and one section"; the train rushes more than 5m; train rushing signal;

source_file: 运营应急信息通报规则-en-translation.txt
content: Trains without ATP protection run overspeeding; passenger trains that should stop at the station pass through without stopping or depart without opening the door (platform door or door) after stopping; Stopping at the station without permission for boarding and disembarking operations; live trains mistakenly enter the powerless area;

source_file: 运营应急信息通报规则-en-translation.txt
content: Affect other line passenger transport, transfer station transfer and connection and other line network-level events. Ⅲ级信息（发生以下事件且未达到Ⅱ级信息） 启动运营分公司专项应急预案并发布Ⅲ级响应； 晚点5min及以上15min以下； 发生影响列车正点率、列车运行图兑现率、列车服务可靠度、列车退出正线运营故障率、车辆系统故障率、信号系统故障率、供电系统故障率、站台门故障率的事件； 使用车辆或信号的某一项旁路功能（含站台门互锁解除）； 列车冲标超过m且未超过5m； 计轴区段故障影响到列车正常运行； 通信设备故障，专用无线手持台、车站或列车广播不可用； 发生3人以下客伤，乘客可自行活动； 一般事件中已明确需发布Ⅰ级、Ⅱ级信息外的其他事件； 轨行区异物影响列车运行； 其他影响列车运行和乘客服务的事件。 Ⅳ级信息（发生以下事件且未达到Ⅲ级信息） 启动运营分公司专项应急预案并发布Ⅳ级响应； 设备设施故障或告警，但未影响到列车运行或乘客服务； 轨行区异物不影响列车运行； 其他未影响列车运行和乘客服务的事件。 信息分类 启动专项应急预案发布Ⅱ级或Ⅰ级响应时，不对信息进行分类，直接按Ⅱ级或Ⅰ级响应的组别分级发布。 启动专项应急预案发布Ⅲ级或Ⅳ级响应或其他运营应急信息，应对信息进行分类，按相应类别的接收群组发布信息。 运营应急信息按照类别可分为以下几类： 气象灾害类 各类气象预警信息，地震，气象服务平台提供的气象数据达到警戒值时的信息等。 社会治安类 打架斗殴、不雅社会行为、聚众闹事及网络安全事件等。 公共卫生事件类 突发传染病等。 设备故障类 按照设备所属专业不同，设备故障类信息又可分为以下专业：市域动车组、工程车辆、通号、工务、供电、机电专业。 信息接收群组建立 运营分公司各部门、维保单位及相关需要接受运营信息的单位应向调度部提报不同分级、分类信息的接收人员名单，人员名单或联系方式有变化时24h内报调度部更新。 不同级别、类别信息接收群组的相关岗位详见附录B。 通报原则及程序 信息通报原则 遵循“快捷准确、逐级负责、真实有效”的原则，任何部门和个人，都不得迟报、漏报、瞒报、谎报、错报。

source_file: 运营应急信息通报规则-en-translation.txt
content: 重要敏感信息保密原则。涉及员工应保持对应急信息敏感性，禁止随意散播。 分类分级报送原则。认真研判事故事件影响程度，根据工作需要分类分级报送。 根据事故事件发展，持续跟进动态报送原则。 信息报告内容 事故/事件发生单位、部位，类别。 事故/事件发生的时间、地点以及事故现场情况； 事故/事件发生的初步原因； 事故/事件的简要经过； 事故/事件已经造成或者可能造成的人员伤亡情况（包括失踪、撤离情况）和初步估计的直接经济损失； 事故/事件对周边环境的影响，是否造成环境破坏； 已经采取的措施； 请求协调、支持的事项； 报告人的姓名、职务和联系电话； 其他应当报告的情况，报告后出现新情况的，应及时续报。 应急信息通报要求 现场人员发现设备设施故障或发生突发事件，必须立即向OCC报告。第一时间无法详细报告时，应待进一步了解清楚后及时向OCC续报。 发生突发事件时，现场负责人应视实际情况报110、120、119。 发生突发事件时，OCC要在5min内完成首条信息发布；事件处置过程中，OCC应与现场加强联系，事件处理到关键节点或有变化时，及时进行信息续报。 同时发生多起事件时，按最高的事件级别通报信息；若事件在处置过程中升级，则按事件升级后的最高事件级别通报信息。 OCC接报事件信息后，应对信息进行分类分级，然后发送至相应浙政钉群组。当判定为Ⅰ、Ⅱ、Ⅲ级信息时，应同步发送短信进行通报。当判定为Ⅰ级或Ⅱ级信息时，OCC在发送短信的同时，还应以电话方式通报本部门、质量安全部、综合管理部部门负责人、业务相关分管领导；事件有可能影响其他线路时，还应电话通知受影响线路的OCC。 向集团公司通报信息要求 判定为Ⅰ级及Ⅱ级信息时，OCC按流程在运营分公司范围内完成信息通报。运营分公司按照集团公司信息通报要求，向集团公司进行首报、初报、续报和处理结果报告。调度部负责通报至运管中心；质量安全部负责通报至建安部。 首次报送应在10分钟内完成，初步报送应在30分钟内完成，第1次跟进续报应在1小时内完成；若事件持续发展应持续报送（每1-2小时报送一次），直至事件处置完毕。处理结果报告在事故应急处理完毕后上报。 首报以录音电话为主。初报及续报以电子版（运营事故事件快报表见附录D）为主，紧急情况下可采用录音电话报送。 当线路发生运营突发事件影响其他线路行车客运、换乘站换乘衔接等线网级事件时，事发线路调度应及时上报线网调度。线网调度接收后，应第一时间通知相关线路调度，并上报调度部负责人。 发生运营险性事件（详见《运营突发事件综合应急预案》内附表C《运营险性事件清单》）时，由调度部负责人或授权人向运管中心报告并抄送质量安全部，质量安全部接报后由部门负责人或授权人向建安部报告。运营险性事件信息报告内容，按照《运营突发事件综合应急预案》内附表A《城市轨道交通运营险性事件快报表》执行。 发生运营险性事件时，向集团公司报送《城市轨道交通运营险性事件快报表》后，无需重复报送《运营事故事件快报表》。 舆情应对 当发生列车延误（预计或已延误20分钟及以上）、车站关站或暂停部分服务、行车中断、线路停运等紧急情况时，OCC需向运管中心报送运营紧急信息，具体流程如下： 事发线路调度根据事件相关情况，在运营紧急信息模板（见附录C）的基础上，编制运营紧急信息，经部门负责人审核后于事发5分钟内报线网调度，并同步将运营紧急信息发送至浙政钉群组。 线网调度研判线网影响后，合理调整运营紧急信息，并于事发10分钟内向运管中心报送。 在首次报送之后，线路调度应根据事件进展，围绕乘客出行、现场情况、应急公交接驳等内容对运营紧急信息进行续报，直至处置完毕。 发生运营突发事故（事件）时，由综合管理部根据事故（事件）信息内容，撰写媒体稿件，由分管副总经理、总经理或其委托人审核后，负责对外信息发布，并向集团公司办公室报告。 注意事项 信息发布系统发生故障时，发现人员应及时报修，不具备短信群发条件时，应尽快以电话形式通知到应急处置的关键人员。 信息报送错误时，报送者应及时更正，报送正确信息。 OCC在电话通报各部门负责人时，连续打两次电话拨通后且单次15秒内均未应答，OCC不再执行电话通报。相关电话接收人员在查看未接电话或短信后应主动了解应急信息。 附则 本规则由运营分公司调度部负责解释，自发布之日起施行。原《运营应急信息通报规则》（温铁投运营〔2024〕93号）同时废止。 附录 附录A 运营应急信息通报流程 附录B 不同级别、类别信息接收群组岗位表 附录C 运营紧急信息 附录D 运营事故事件快报表 附录A 运营应急信息通报流程

source_file: 运营应急管理办法-en-translation.txt
content: Operational emergency management measures Purpose In order to implement relevant national laws and regulations, establish and improve the emergency management working mechanism of the operating branch of Wenzhou Railway and Rail Transit Investment Group Co., Ltd. (hereinafter referred to as the "operating branch"), strengthen emergency management, and continuously improve the

source_file: 运营应急管理办法-en-translation.txt
content: safety production guarantee capacity, disaster prevention and mitigation and emergency rescue capabilities of rail transit operations, the operation emergency management measures are specially formulated. Scope of application The operation emergency management measures are applicable to the emergency plan of the operation line, emergency drills, emergency teams, emergency duty, emergency support

source_file: 运营应急管理办法-en-translation.txt
content: system construction, etc. Citation standards The terms in the following cited documents become the terms of the Operational Emergency Management Measures by reference to the Operational Emergency Management Measures. All subsequent amendments (excluding errata) or revisions of the reference documents with a date or version number are not applicable to

source_file: 运营应急管理办法-en-translation.txt
content: the Operational Emergency Management Measures. The latest version of the cited document without a date or version number is applicable to the Operational Emergency Management Measures. Emergency Response Law of the People's Republic of China (Decree No. 69 of the President of the People's Republic of China)

source_file: 运营应急管理办法-en-translation.txt
content: Work Safety Law of the People's Republic of China (Decree No. 88 of the President of the People's Republic of China) Regulations on the Reporting, Investigation and Handling of Production Safety Accidents (Order No. 493 of the State Administration of Work Safety)

source_file: 运营应急管理办法-en-translation.txt
content: National Urban Rail Transit Operation Emergency Plan (Guo Ban Han [2015] No. 32) Regulations on Work Safety in Zhejiang Province (Announcement No. 86 of the Standing Committee of the 13th People's Congress of Zhejiang Province) Basic Requirements for Emergency Capacity Building for Urban Rail Transit Operations (JT/T1409-2022)

source_file: 运营应急管理办法-en-translation.txt
content: Administrative Measures for Emergency Drills for Urban Rail Transit Operation Emergencies (Jiaoyun Gui [2019] No. 9) Implementation Measures for the Management of Emergency Plans in Zhejiang Province (Zhejiang Government Office [2016] No. 139) Guidelines for the Preparation of Emergency Plans for Production Safety Accidents in Production and Business Units (GB/T29639-2020)

source_file: 运营应急管理办法-en-translation.txt
content: "Emergency Plan for Urban Rail Transit Operation in Wenzhou" (Wen Zhengban [2021] No. 21) "Emergency Plan for Production Safety Accidents of Wenzhou Railway and Rail Transit Investment Group Co., Ltd." (Wen Tietou [2020] No. 93) Define operational contingencies

source_file: 运营应急管理办法-en-translation.txt
content: During the operation of urban rail transit, due to train collisions, derailments, equipment and facility failures, damage, and large passenger flows, resulting in casualties, driving interruptions, and property losses. Define emergency plans A pre-formulated work plan to effectively control possible post-emergencies and minimize damage caused by emergencies.

source_file: 运营应急管理办法-en-translation.txt
content: Define an emergency rescue team After professional training related to emergency rescue, the team responsible for emergency rescue and disposal of emergencies. Define emergency drills Emergency training is carried out according to the emergency plan for possible emergency scenarios. Define emergency supplies

source_file: 运营应急管理办法-en-translation.txt
content: Material support required to deal with various emergencies that affect the operation safety of urban rail transit. Definition Actual combat drills According to the standards determined by the drill objectives, emergency training is carried out through actual operation in real work scenarios or work scenarios built by simulated work equipment.

source_file: 运营应急管理办法-en-translation.txt
content: Overall requirements Work requirements Firmly establish the idea of "safety first", follow the policy of "prevention first, standing and unremitting", adhere to the principles of "unified leadership, hierarchical responsibility, territorial orientation, comprehensive coordination, compliance with laws and regulations, and dynamic management", improve the construction of emergency structure, improve emergency response

source_file: 运营应急管理办法-en-translation.txt
content: capabilities, and ensure the allocation of emergency resources. Overall requirements Work objectives Realize the whole process management of emergency management, establish a complete emergency organizational structure, improve the operation and guarantee mechanism of emergency prevention, incident response, in-process disposal and aftermath management according to the nature, characteristics and hazard grading

source_file: 运营应急管理办法-en-translation.txt
content: response of emergencies, ensure that the rescue work responds in a timely manner, and the measures are decisive, orderly, controllable and rapid, reduce the impact of accidents, and resume operation and production as soon as possible. Emergency Agencies and Responsibilities Emergency Organizations

source_file: 运营应急管理办法-en-translation.txt
content: The operation branch establishes an emergency organization composed of an emergency leading group, an emergency command center, and an on-site headquarters, and clarifies its composition and responsibilities in the "Comprehensive Emergency Plan for Operational Emergencies". Emergency Agencies and Responsibilities Quality and Safety Department

source_file: 运营应急管理办法-en-translation.txt
content: Responsible for the daily affairs of emergency management, implement the decisions and instructions of the emergency management leading agency, and comprehensively coordinate, direct and coordinate the company's daily emergency management work. Emergency Agencies and Responsibilities General Management Department

source_file: 运营应急管理办法-en-translation.txt
content: Responsible for online public opinion response and emergency management publicity in case of emergencies. Emergency Agencies and Responsibilities Material Management Department Responsible for implementing the procurement of emergency materials according to the needs reported by various departments to ensure that the allocation of emergency materials is good.

source_file: 运营应急管理办法-en-translation.txt
content: Emergency Agencies and Responsibilities Financial Management Department Responsible for the management of emergency funds. Emergency agencies and responsibilities All units and departments Responsible for the preparation and revision of the special emergency plan and on-site disposal plan of the unit and department, and participate in the preparation and revision of

source_file: 运营应急管理办法-en-translation.txt
content: the company's comprehensive emergency plan. Responsible for preparing the annual drill plan of the emergency plan of the unit and department, and carrying out emergency plan drills according to the plan, and archiving the emergency plan drill materials.

source_file: 运营应急管理办法-en-translation.txt
content: Responsible for the construction of professional emergency rescue teams in the unit and department, and organize and carry out daily training. Responsible for implementing the reserve of emergency equipment and materials in accordance with the quota standard to ensure that it is in good condition. Emergency plan plan system

source_file: 运营应急管理办法-en-translation.txt
content: According to the management requirements of the superior emergency plan and combined with the actual operation of the operating branch, a three-level emergency plan system of comprehensive emergency plan, special emergency plan and on-site disposal plan is established; the first level refers to the comprehensive emergency plan, the second level refers to the special emergency plan, and the third level refers to the on-site disposal plan.

source_file: 运营应急管理办法-en-translation.txt
content: Emergency plan plan system Comprehensive emergency plan The comprehensive emergency plan is a comprehensive work plan formulated to deal with various production safety accidents, and is the general outline of the overall work procedures, measures and emergency plan system of the operating branch to deal with production safety accidents. It

source_file: 运营应急管理办法-en-translation.txt
content: mainly expounds the principles of emergency work in general, including emergency plan system, risk analysis, emergency organization and responsibilities, early warning and information reporting, emergency response, safeguard measures, etc. Emergency plan plan system Special emergency plan

source_file: 运营应急管理办法-en-translation.txt
content: A special emergency plan is a special work plan formulated to deal with one or more types of production safety accidents, or to prevent production safety accidents in important production facilities, major hazards, and major activities. It mainly includes the analysis of incident types and hazards, emergency command bodies and responsibilities, information reports, emergency response procedures and disposal measures.

source_file: 运营应急管理办法-en-translation.txt
content: Emergency plan plan system On-site disposal plan The on-site disposal plan is an emergency response measure formulated for specific places, devices or facilities according to different types of production safety accidents. It mainly includes incident characteristics, emergency organization and responsibilities, emergency response and precautions, operational accessories, etc.

source_file: 运营应急管理办法-en-translation.txt
content: Emergency plan plan preparation Preparation requirements and procedures The preparation of the plan should comply with the relevant laws, regulations, rules and standards and normative documents of the national, provincial, municipal and group companies, and establish a comprehensive and top-down emergency plan system in combination with the actual situation of

source_file: 运营应急管理办法-en-translation.txt
content: the operating branch. The emergency plan shall meet the following basic requirements: The division of responsibilities of emergency organizations and personnel is clear, and there are specific implementation measures. There are clear and specific emergency prevention measures and emergency procedures, and they are suitable for their emergency response capabilities.

source_file: 运营应急管理办法-en-translation.txt
content: There are clear emergency safeguard measures and can meet the emergency work requirements of the unit. The basic elements of the plan specified in the regulations and standards are complete and complete, and the information provided in the annex to the plan is accurate.

source_file: 运营应急管理办法-en-translation.txt
content: The relevant emergency plans and the emergency plans of other units or relevant government departments involved should be connected with each other in content. Emergency plan plan preparation Preparation requirements and procedures Preparation procedures

source_file: 运营应急管理办法-en-translation.txt
content: Establish a working group. The leader of the comprehensive emergency plan preparation working group is the person in charge of the operation branch, the leader of the special emergency plan preparation working group is the leader in charge of the operation branch, and the leader of the on-site disposal plan preparation working group is the head of the emergency plan preparation department. The members are the main departments and business-related personnel involved in the emergency plan, relevant experts and personnel with on-site disposal experience.

source_file: 运营应急管理办法-en-translation.txt
content: Collect relevant information. Including laws and regulations, technical standards, relevant emergency plans from superiors, industry emergency response cases and analysis data, system documents and technical data of the unit, etc.

source_file: 运营应急管理办法-en-translation.txt
content: Risk identification and analysis. According to the characteristics of operational emergencies, identify risks, identify hazard factors, analyze the possible direct consequences and secondary and derivative consequences of the incident, evaluate the risk level, and propose measures to control risks and manage hidden dangers, as the basis for the preparation of the unit's emergency plan.

source_file: 运营应急管理办法-en-translation.txt
content: Emergency resource investigation and emergency capacity assessment. It should comprehensively find out the emergency team, equipment, materials, places and other emergency resources mobilized by the unit, and conduct an emergency capacity assessment, and improve emergency support measures based on the evaluation results.

source_file: 运营应急管理办法-en-translation.txt
content: Solicit and improve opinions. In the process of preparing emergency plans, expert consultation and demonstration should be fully carried out, and the opinions of relevant departments, units and personnel should be widely listened to. Where the responsibilities of external units are involved, the opinions of relevant units shall be solicited in writing.

source_file: 运营应急管理办法-en-translation.txt
content: Emergency plan plan review Experts from other units shall be organized to review the newly formulated comprehensive emergency plan and special emergency plan before it is issued, and the reviewers shall include experts in safety production and emergency management.

source_file: 运营应急管理办法-en-translation.txt
content: The evaluation results shall form an evaluation opinion, and the evaluation experts shall sign the evaluation opinions in accordance with the principle of "who reviews, who signs, and who is responsible".

source_file: 运营应急管理办法-en-translation.txt
content: The operating branch shall record and archive the review opinions, and revise and improve the emergency plan based on the content of the opinions. Emergency plan The plan was released After the emergency plan is reviewed, internal countersigning shall be organized.

source_file: 运营应急管理办法-en-translation.txt
content: The emergency plan is completed and issued in accordance with the requirements of the "Administrative Measures for the Rules and Regulations of the Operating Branch". Emergency plan plan for filing

source_file: 运营应急管理办法-en-translation.txt
content: After the release of the comprehensive emergency plan and the special emergency plan, the quality and safety department shall report to the Group Safety Committee Office and the municipal urban rail transit operation department for the record within 20 working days. Emergency plan Plan implementation

source_file: 运营应急管理办法-en-translation.txt
content: The emergency plan is publicly released to all employees of the company, and is timely distributed to the relevant departments, posts and relevant emergency rescue teams of the unit. Emergency plan Revision of the plan

source_file: 运营应急管理办法-en-translation.txt
content: The emergency plan system shall be comprehensively evaluated every three years, and the evaluation content shall include the completeness of the plan system, the pertinence, practicability and operability of the plan content, etc., and it is advisable to entrust a third-party professional institution to carry out the evaluation, and the emergency plan system and content shall be revised within 3 months after the evaluation opinion is issued.

source_file: 运营应急管理办法-en-translation.txt
content: In any of the following circumstances, the emergency plan shall be revised within 3 months: Problems in actual operation need to be improved, and the emergency plan drill evaluation report requires revision; Changes in relevant laws, regulations, standards, and relevant provisions in the superior plan;

source_file: 运营应急管理办法-en-translation.txt
content: Changes in affiliation, business relationships, responsible persons, etc. due to organizational structure adjustments; Changes in facilities and equipment, production processes and technical requirements; changes in the surrounding environment, forming new major sources of risk; The command system or responsibilities of the emergency organization have been adjusted; Other cases.

source_file: 运营应急管理办法-en-translation.txt
content: If there are major changes in the emergency command body and responsibilities, emergency response procedures and main disposal measures, and emergency response grading content in the comprehensive emergency plan and special emergency plan, experts from other units shall be organized to review the plan after the revision of the plan, and the revision work shall be organized with reference to the preparation, review, release, and filing procedures of the plan as stipulated in the operational emergency management measures.

source_file: 运营应急管理办法-en-translation.txt
content: Emergency drills According to the different subjects of the drill, emergency drills are divided into company-level drills, department-level drills, and team-level drills; according to the different forms of drills, emergency drills are divided into desktop drills, actual combat drills, and double-blind drills.

source_file: 运营应急管理办法-en-translation.txt
content: The comprehensive emergency plan drill can rely on the special emergency plan, organize a special emergency plan drill at least once every six months, and each special emergency plan drill at least once every three years.

source_file: 运营应急管理办法-en-translation.txt
content: Each team should conduct all relevant on-site disposal plans at least once a year, and should be combined with daily work to carry out regular drills on the on-site disposal plans, and drills of different on-site disposal plans can be combined.

source_file: 运营应急管理办法-en-translation.txt
content: The operating branch and other operating units shall organize a joint emergency plan drill for the transfer line at least once a year. The operating branch shall establish an emergency drill management system, formulate an annual drill plan, clarify the drill project, drill time, drill level, drill form, organizational department

source_file: 运营应急管理办法-en-translation.txt
content: and cooperating department, etc., of which the proportion of actual combat drill shall not be less than 70%, and shall be reported to the safety committee office of the group company and the municipal urban rail transit operation department within 20 working days after the drill is released. Emergency drills

source_file: 运营应急管理办法-en-translation.txt
content: After the emergency drill, the drill evaluation shall be carried out, of which the company-level and department-level drills shall form a drill evaluation report, and the team-level drill can be evaluated through on-site summary and comments.

source_file: 运营应急管理办法-en-translation.txt
content: Emergency drill evaluators should have corresponding professional skills and work experience, be familiar with relevant emergency plans, drill implementation plans and management systems in advance, observe and judge the development of emergency drills throughout the process, and carry out assessment work independently and objectively. When necessary, industry experts may be invited or third-party institutions may be entrusted to carry out drill evaluation work.

source_file: 运营应急管理办法-en-translation.txt
content: Drills involving the public and normal operations shall assess risks in advance, implement safety protection measures, and release publicity and notification information in advance. Encourage the use of double-blind drills without prior notice of the time, place and content of the drill to improve the authenticity of the drill and

source_file: 运营应急管理办法-en-translation.txt
content: ensure the detection effect of emergency response and disposal capabilities. Encourage the public to invite "frequent passengers" and volunteers to participate in emergency drills, and provide necessary training and safety protection for the public participating in emergency drills. Emergency rescue team

source_file: 运营应急管理办法-en-translation.txt
content: The operation branch should establish an emergency rescue team, and the emergency rescue team members should master the professional knowledge and skills related to urban rail transit operation, be familiar with the on-site situation and have good physical and psychological quality.

source_file: 运营应急管理办法-en-translation.txt
content: Each outsourced unit should set up a professional rescue team, which is divided into categories such as power supply, mechanical and electrical, vehicle, public works, and general number. After the emergency response is launched, all relevant professional rescue teams rush to the scene in accordance with the OCC instructions to

source_file: 运营应急管理办法-en-translation.txt
content: carry out emergency response work in accordance with the "Comprehensive Emergency Plan for Operational Emergencies". The Quality and Safety Department takes the lead in the overall management of the emergency rescue team, and each department updates the information of the emergency team personnel in June and December every year and

source_file: 运营应急管理办法-en-translation.txt
content: reports it to the Ministry of Quality and Safety for the record. Emergency outreach mechanism Social emergency resources are mainly composed of external units with social emergency rescue qualifications such as fire protection, public security, medical care, public transportation, and engineering around Wenzhou rail transit lines.

source_file: 运营应急管理办法-en-translation.txt
content: The operating branch establishes an all-round, multi-level and three-dimensional emergency external linkage mechanism with government agencies, affiliated enterprises, social groups and media publicity departments according to its own situation, and implements seamless docking and effective linkage. The operating branch can regularly organize joint drills with the above-mentioned relevant departments to implement various emergency linkage measures and improve the level of emergency linkage.

source_file: 运营应急管理办法-en-translation.txt
content: In the event of a major safety accident or incident with a large social impact, the Group Company shall immediately report to the Group Company for guidance and coordination of external unit support. Emergency training

source_file: 运营应急管理办法-en-translation.txt
content: Emergency rescue team members should carry out professional job training before taking up their posts, and engage in job work after passing the assessment. All departments and maintenance units should carry out continuous training for on-the-job emergency rescue team members. Each part-time emergency rescue team member shall participate in safety

source_file: 运营应急管理办法-en-translation.txt
content: and emergency related training for no less than 2 hours per month. The pre-job training and continuous training of the emergency rescue team should cover relevant laws and regulations on emergency response, the relevant systems of the unit's emergency response, emergency plans, safety protection measures in emergency rescue operations, the

source_file: 运营应急管理办法-en-translation.txt
content: use of emergency materials, the identification and emergency disposal methods of abnormal situations, self-rescue, mutual rescue knowledge, emergency communication and contact methods and emergency routes, emergency emergency cases, etc. Station attendants, train drivers and train dispatchers should have the theoretical knowledge and job skills related to emergency response as required.

source_file: 运营应急管理办法-en-translation.txt
content: Emergency training The operating branch shall use emergency drills, technical competitions, etc. to strengthen the emergency response ability of employees, and the frequency shall not be less than once a quarter. The operating branch shall use random testing and third-party evaluation to assess the emergency response ability of employees, and

source_file: 运营应急管理办法-en-translation.txt
content: the frequency shall not be less than once a year. The Quality and Safety Department shall formulate an annual plan for emergency capability training, stipulate the content, object, time, assessment, etc. of emergency capability training, and carry out emergency capability training according to the plan.

source_file: 运营应急管理办法-en-translation.txt
content: When the government issues or revises emergency related laws and regulations, the unit issues or revises emergency related systems or emergency plans, or the unit or other units have operational risk incidents, the Quality and Safety Department shall organize training in a timely manner, and the training situation shall be recorded.

source_file: 运营应急管理办法-en-translation.txt
content: Emergency plan training is included in the safety production training work plan, organized at least once a year, to ensure that all employees are familiar with the unit's emergency plan, have basic emergency skills, and master the accident prevention measures and emergency response procedures of their posts. Emergency supplies

source_file: 运营应急管理办法-en-translation.txt
content: Material allocation The allocation of emergency materials follows the principle of "regional sharing, professional complementarity, collaborative management, and overall layout". According to the needs of emergency rescue work and reasonable reserve needs, each department shall put forward the requirements of various equipment, facilities and equipment to the material management department,

source_file: 运营应急管理办法-en-translation.txt
content: and the material management department shall purchase them uniformly. Material management The Quality and Safety Department shall regularly carry out supervision and inspection work. Implement emergency material reserves and management requirements.

source_file: 运营应急管理办法-en-translation.txt
content: Emergency materials should be stored in a fixed place that is easy to access and neatly placed, and special personnel should be arranged to manage them, and the responsibility should be implemented to people. Each department should establish an emergency material management ledger, including the name, model, use, quantity, placement, use and maintenance management department of emergency rescue materials, and when the physical quota standard changes, replenish the materials and update the ledger in time, and submit the emergency materials to the Ministry of Quality and Safety for the record after the update is completed, and the emergency material management ledger shall be kept for no less than 3 years.

source_file: 运营应急管理办法-en-translation.txt
content: In the process of emergency rescue, the OCC can uniformly allocate emergency rescue materials within its jurisdiction according to the needs of emergency rescue. The units and departments to which the emergency materials belong shall carry out daily maintenance and regular inspections in accordance with regulations to ensure that they

source_file: 运营应急管理办法-en-translation.txt
content: are in good condition and that the quality meets the standard requirements; establish maintenance and inspection records of emergency equipment and materials, and keep them for no less than 1 year.

source_file: 运营应急管理办法-en-translation.txt
content: In principle, the inspection cycle of emergency materials and spare parts is once a month, and seasonal emergency materials (flood control materials, etc.) should be comprehensively inspected two months before the arrival of a specific seasonal support task.

source_file: 运营应急管理办法-en-translation.txt
content: When some spare parts are lower than the quota standard due to fault repair, the responsible management unit or department shall promptly apply for and supplement to ensure that the requirements of emergency response are met. Emergency duty duty work system

source_file: 运营应急管理办法-en-translation.txt
content: The emergency duty work implements the 24-hour "leader leading the shift and special person on duty" system in accordance with relevant requirements. The normalized emergency duty work is undertaken by the full-time dispatch and vehicle control room staff, and the shift leader is composed of the company's leadership team, middle-level

source_file: 运营应急管理办法-en-translation.txt
content: cadres and above, responsible for reviewing the emergency information that needs to be reported to the superior competent department, and directing and coordinating the emergency response work. In case of special periods, the system of on-duty leaders with shifts is implemented according to the requirements of superiors, and the comprehensive

source_file: 运营应急管理办法-en-translation.txt
content: management department is responsible for coordinating the formulation of the emergency duty schedule of the operation branch (see Appendix A of the Operational Emergency Management Measures). During the duty period, the duty personnel should grasp the operation of the line and the status of various equipment and facilities, and should

source_file: 运营应急管理办法-en-translation.txt
content: take the initiative to understand the on-site situation when receiving emergency information, and immediately organize personnel to quickly and effectively deal with emergencies. Emergency duty duty information reporting OCC needs to understand the emergency duty arrangements and requirements in advance, and grasp the information of the duty personnel and shift

source_file: 运营应急管理办法-en-translation.txt
content: leaders of relevant departments. During special periods such as statutory holidays, the personnel on duty should do a good job of "daily reporting and zero reporting" of operation information to the superior department and the group company in accordance with the requirements of the superior department. Emergency funds

source_file: 运营应急管理办法-en-translation.txt
content: Emergency funds are mainly used for emergency rescue, expert consultation and emergency drills, and are included in the company's annual safety production expense budget. The Quality and Safety Department is responsible for the centralized management of emergency funds in the operating branch, takes the lead in formulating the annual budget

source_file: 运营应急管理办法-en-translation.txt
content: of emergency funds, clarifies the scope of use, and does a good job in supervision and management. Emergency funds are mainly used for emergency rescue implementation, bus connection, expert consultation, risk assessment, emergency drills, logistics support, etc., excluding the aftermath costs of equipment and facility restoration and reconstruction, loss claims,

source_file: 运营应急管理办法-en-translation.txt
content: etc. Supplementary Provisions The Operational Emergency Management Measures shall be interpreted by the Company's Quality and Safety Department and shall be implemented from the date of promulgation. In the relevant numerical expressions of the operational emergency management measures, "above" includes the number, and "below" does not include the number.

source_file: 运营应急管理办法-en-translation.txt
content: If there is a conflict with national laws, regulations, and standards, the operational emergency management measures shall be implemented in accordance with national laws, regulations, and relevant standards. Appendix Operational Emergency Management Measures Appendix A "Emergency Duty Table of Operating Branches"

source_file: 运营突发事件综合应急预案-en-translation.txt
content: Operate a comprehensive emergency plan for emergencies General Provisions Purpose of preparation In order to improve the ability of the operating branch of Wenzhou Railway and Rail Transit Investment Group Co., Ltd. (hereinafter referred to as the "operating branch") to deal with operational emergencies, standardize prevention, monitoring, early warning and

source_file: 运营突发事件综合应急预案-en-translation.txt
content: emergency preparedness, emergency response and rescue, post-event recovery and reconstruction, information reporting and media response, etc., minimize casualties and property losses, ensure operational safety, and maintain normal social order, a comprehensive emergency plan for operational emergencies is specially formulated. General Provisions Basis for Compilation

source_file: 运营突发事件综合应急预案-en-translation.txt
content: The terms in the following cited documents become the terms of the Operational Comprehensive Emergency Plan by reference to the Operational Emergency Plan. All subsequent amendments (excluding errata) or revisions to the dated (or version number) of the cited document are not applicable to the Operational Emergency Plan. For any undated (or version number) of the referenced document, the latest version is applicable to the Operational Emergency Plan.
