content: Work Safety Law of the People's Republic of China (Decree No. 88 of the President of the People's Republic of China) Emergency Response Law of the People's Republic of China (Decree No. 69 of the President of the People's Republic of China)

source_file: 运营突发事件综合应急预案-en-translation.txt
content: National Overall Emergency Plan for Public Emergencies (Guo Fa [2005] No. 11) National Urban Rail Transit Operation Emergency Plan (Guo Ban Han [2015] No. 32) Guidelines for the Preparation of Emergency Plans for Production Safety Accidents in Production and Business Units (GB/T29639-2020)

source_file: 运营突发事件综合应急预案-en-translation.txt
content: Regulations on Reporting, Investigation and Handling of Production Safety Accidents, Order No. 493 of the State Council in 2007 "Administrative Measures for the Reporting and Analysis of Dangerous Events in Urban Rail Transit Operations" Transportation Regulations [2024] No. 6

source_file: 运营突发事件综合应急预案-en-translation.txt
content: Regulations on Work Safety in Zhejiang Province (Announcement No. 86 of the Standing Committee of the 13th People's Congress of Zhejiang Province) Guidelines for Urban Rail Transit Operation Emergency Reporting and Emergency Response Work in Zhejiang Province (Trial) (Zhejiang Jiaoban [2023] No. 37)

source_file: 运营突发事件综合应急预案-en-translation.txt
content: "Emergency Plan for Urban Rail Transit Operation in Wenzhou" (Wen Zhengban [2021] No. 21) "Wenzhou City Extreme Disaster Weather Prevention and Response Work Rules (Trial)" (Wen Zhengban [2022] No. 40)

source_file: 运营突发事件综合应急预案-en-translation.txt
content: "Guiding Opinions on Wenzhou's Response to Extreme Weather Disasters (Typhoon and Flooding) "Five Stops" (Trial)" (Wen Xun Zhi [2022] No. 13) "Emergency Plan for Production Safety Accidents of Wenzhou Railway and Rail Transit Investment Group Co., Ltd." (Wen Tietou [2020] No. 93)

source_file: 运营突发事件综合应急预案-en-translation.txt
content: "Special Emergency Plan for Rail Transit Operation Emergencies of Wenzhou Railway Investment Group" (Wen Tietou (2024) No. 106) Operational Emergency Management Measures (WTTYY/ZAB(I)/AQ-027-01) General Provisions Scope of application It is applicable to the response to various emergencies within the jurisdiction of the operating branch. The "Overview of the Operating Branch"

source_file: 运营突发事件综合应急预案-en-translation.txt
content: is shown in Appendix A of the Comprehensive Emergency Plan for Operational Emergencies. General Provisions Emergency plan system According to the management requirements of the superior emergency plan and combined with the actual operation of the operating branch, a three-level emergency plan system of comprehensive emergency plan, special emergency plan

source_file: 运营突发事件综合应急预案-en-translation.txt
content: and on-site disposal plan is established. General Provisions Emergency Plan System Comprehensive Emergency Plan The comprehensive emergency plan is a comprehensive work plan formulated to deal with various production safety accidents, and is the general outline of the overall work procedures, measures and emergency plan system of the operating branch

source_file: 运营突发事件综合应急预案-en-translation.txt
content: to deal with production safety accidents. General Provisions Emergency Plan System Special Emergency Plan A special emergency plan is a special work plan formulated to deal with one or more types of production safety accidents, or to prevent production safety accidents in important production facilities, major sources of danger, and

source_file: 运营突发事件综合应急预案-en-translation.txt
content: major activities. General Emergency Plan System On-site Disposal Plan The on-site disposal plan is an emergency response measure formulated for specific places, devices or facilities according to different types of production safety accidents. General Principles of emergency work People-oriented, safety first, scientific decision-making.

source_file: 运营突发事件综合应急预案-en-translation.txt
content: Give full play to the public service functions of rail transit, and take ensuring the safety of passengers' lives and minimizing losses caused by accidents as the primary task of responding to emergencies. In the process of rescue and rescue, it is necessary to adhere to safety first, give priority to personnel avoidance measures, rescue the personnel involved, eliminate faults in a timely manner, and prevent secondary disasters. It is necessary to use advanced technology and equipment, give full play to the role of experts, and implement scientific and democratic decision-making.

source_file: 运营突发事件综合应急预案-en-translation.txt
content: Unified command, hierarchical response, first communication and then reply. After initiating the emergency response, each department shall dispatch rescue and rescue personnel at the corresponding response level in accordance with the hierarchical response principle of each special emergency plan or on-site disposal plan, establish an emergency command structure in accordance

source_file: 运营突发事件综合应急预案-en-translation.txt
content: with the provisions of each plan, perform work duties in accordance with the division of labor at each command level, and give priority to ensuring the opening of traffic under the premise of ensuring safety, and resume normal operation as soon as possible.

source_file: 运营突发事件综合应急预案-en-translation.txt
content: Respond quickly, coordinate and cooperate, and respond effectively. All departments should respond quickly after receiving emergency response information, and all units at the scene of the emergency should actively cooperate, closely cooperate, integrate resources, and form a joint force to ensure timely information transmission and fast and effective disposal.

source_file: 运营突发事件综合应急预案-en-translation.txt
content: Prevention is the main focus, prevention and control are combined, and standing and unremitting. All departments should adhere to the principle of prevention first and combination of prevention and control, strengthen investment in emergency work, strengthen monitoring, prediction, early warning, prevention and judgment of operational emergencies, enhance early warning analysis,

source_file: 运营突发事件综合应急预案-en-translation.txt
content: combine prevention and emergency response, effectively control risks, and achieve early detection, early reporting, early control, and early resolution. Establish a network interconnection, information sharing, fast and efficient emergency response platform, establish a professional emergency response team and configure sufficient emergency equipment and materials, and do a good job in

source_file: 运营突发事件综合应急预案-en-translation.txt
content: daily ideological mobilization, skills training, plan drills, publicity and education. Event classification and grading Event classification Emergencies of operating branches are divided into four categories: natural disasters, accidents, public health incidents and social security incidents.

source_file: 运营突发事件综合应急预案-en-translation.txt
content: Natural disasters. Various natural disasters are early warning and forecasted by meteorology, earthquake, land, flood control and other departments. Accidents and disasters. It mainly includes fires, collapses of buildings (structures), train collisions, derailments or overturns, major equipment failures and sudden large passenger flows and other emergencies that seriously affect the

source_file: 运营突发事件综合应急预案-en-translation.txt
content: operation and production of rail transit. Public health incidents. It mainly includes food safety accidents, acute occupational hazards, infectious disease epidemics, biochemical, toxic gas and radioactive pollution and other emergencies that seriously affect the physical and mental health and life safety of the public and employees.

source_file: 运营突发事件综合应急预案-en-translation.txt
content: Social security incidents. It mainly includes network information security incidents, major criminal cases, terrorist attacks, and emergencies that seriously affect rail transit operation and production, such as crowd disturbances, explosions, and hostage-taking in rail transit operation and production sites.

source_file: 运营突发事件综合应急预案-en-translation.txt
content: According to the "Emergency Plan for Urban Rail Transit Operation in Wenzhou", operational emergencies are divided into four levels: particularly major, major, large and general according to the degree of harm, casualties, economic losses and scope of impact. Particularly major emergencies. The following situations occur:

source_file: 运营突发事件综合应急预案-en-translation.txt
content: causing more than 30 deaths or more than 100 serious injuries; direct economic losses of more than 100 million yuan; It has a particularly serious social impact that exceeds the emergency response capacity of the districted municipal government at the place where the incident occurred;

source_file: 运营突发事件综合应急预案-en-translation.txt
content: The State Council determines that it is a particularly major operational emergency. Major emergencies. The following situations occur: Causing deaths of more than 10 people and less than 30 people, or serious injuries of more than 50 people and less than 100 people;

source_file: 运营突发事件综合应急预案-en-translation.txt
content: direct economic losses of more than 50 million yuan and less than 100 million yuan; Continuous interruption of driving for more than 24 hours. Causing serious social impacts that exceed the ability of the districted municipal government at the place of the incident to deal with it;

source_file: 运营突发事件综合应急预案-en-translation.txt
content: The provincial government identifies it as a major operational emergency. Major emergencies. The following situations occur: causing the death of more than 3 people and less than 10 people, or serious injuries of more than 10 people and less than 50 people;

source_file: 运营突发事件综合应急预案-en-translation.txt
content: direct economic losses of more than 10 million yuan and less than 50 million yuan; Continuous interruption of driving for more than 6 hours and less than 24 hours; It has a great social impact. General emergencies. The following situations occur:

source_file: 运营突发事件综合应急预案-en-translation.txt
content: causing less than 3 deaths or serious injuries to less than 10 people; direct economic losses of more than 500,000 yuan and less than 10 million yuan; Continuous interruption of driving for more than 2 hours and less than 6 hours; Operational risk events

source_file: 运营突发事件综合应急预案-en-translation.txt
content: It refers to the events that occur in the process of urban rail transit operation and have a great impact on the safety and service of urban rail transit operations. The "List of Operational Risk Events" is shown in Appendix C of the Comprehensive Emergency Plan for Operational Emergencies

source_file: 运营突发事件综合应急预案-en-translation.txt
content: Emergency organization and responsibilities Emergency organization According to its own risks, each emergency plan divides the emergency response into four levels according to the impact or possible cause of operational delays, the degree of operational impact, the degree of personnel injury, and the degree of harm, with level I being

source_file: 运营突发事件综合应急预案-en-translation.txt
content: the highest. Each level of emergency corresponds to the corresponding level of emergency command structure, forming the "Emergency Response Classification List" in Appendix D of the Comprehensive Emergency Plan for Operational Emergencies, and the "Emergency Command Structure Table" in Appendix E of the Comprehensive Emergency Plan for Operational Emergencies. In

source_file: 运营突发事件综合应急预案-en-translation.txt
content: order to ensure the rapid, orderly and efficient emergency rescue of rail transit operation emergencies, an emergency leading group, an emergency command center and an on-site headquarters are established in the event of an emergency, and emergency response work is carried out under the unified leadership of the emergency leading

source_file: 运营突发事件综合应急预案-en-translation.txt
content: group. Emergency organization and responsibilities Emergency leading group Team leader: General manager of the operation branch Deputy team leader: deputy general manager of the operation branch and leader in charge of the maintenance unit Members: Heads of various departments of the operation branch and maintenance unit

source_file: 运营突发事件综合应急预案-en-translation.txt
content: Responsibilities of the emergency leading group Research and make decisions about emergencies. Responsible for coordinating the emergency rescue work of rail transit operation. Research and formulate the development plan and policy measures for emergency management of the operation branch.

source_file: 运营突发事件综合应急预案-en-translation.txt
content: Participate in and cooperate with the emergency rescue work of rail transit operation led by the group company, the urban rail transit operation department and above departments. The emergency leading group has an emergency management office (hereinafter referred to as the "emergency office"), which is located in the Quality and

source_file: 运营突发事件综合应急预案-en-translation.txt
content: Safety Department and is responsible for daily emergency related affairs. Responsibilities of the emergency office Under the leadership of the emergency leading group, it is specifically responsible for the daily emergency management of the operation branch.

source_file: 运营突发事件综合应急预案-en-translation.txt
content: Responsible for organizing and supervising the preparation and revision of various emergency related rules and regulations by various departments. Responsible for supervising and guiding all departments to carry out emergency drills and emergency training.

source_file: 运营突发事件综合应急预案-en-translation.txt
content: Responsible for supervising and guiding the establishment of full-time/part-time emergency teams and emergency material ledgers in various departments. Responsible for the assessment of the emergency management work of various departments. Regularly report to the leader and deputy leader of the emergency leading group.

source_file: 运营突发事件综合应急预案-en-translation.txt
content: Complete other tasks assigned by the emergency leading group. Emergency command center Location: Operation Control Center Commander-in-Chief: According to the emergency response level, it is determined with reference to Appendix E of the Comprehensive Emergency Plan for Operational Emergencies.

source_file: 运营突发事件综合应急预案-en-translation.txt
content: Members: Other responders required by the "Emergency Command Structure Table" in Appendix E of the Comprehensive Emergency Plan for Operational Emergencies of the OCC of the Dispatch Department. Responsibilities of the emergency command center Responsible for initiating and terminating plans and deciding to upgrade or downgrade emergency response.

source_file: 运营突发事件综合应急预案-en-translation.txt
content: Responsible for organizing and directing the emergency response of the branch office. When an emergency exceeds the handling capacity of the operating branch, we will request support from the group company and external units in accordance with the procedures.

source_file: 运营突发事件综合应急预案-en-translation.txt
content: When the response to the "Wenzhou Urban Rail Transit Operation Emergency Plan" was initiated, the emergency commander was renamed the operation command and followed the command of the municipal emergency command center for handling rail transit operation emergencies.

source_file: 运营突发事件综合应急预案-en-translation.txt
content: Timely report and continue to report the progress of emergency handling to the group company and the urban rail transit operation department. On-site headquarters The on-site headquarters is the on-site dispatch agency of the emergency command center, composed of the on-site commander-in-chief and the heads of various professional rescue teams.

source_file: 运营突发事件综合应急预案-en-translation.txt
content: When initiating Level I and Level II response, a personnel evacuation team, an equipment emergency repair team, a safety technology group, a logistics support team, a news media group, an expert group, and an aftermath disposal team should be set up to carry out emergency response in accordance with the

source_file: 运营突发事件综合应急预案-en-translation.txt
content: instructions of the emergency command center and the on-site commander-in-chief; when initiating Level III and IV responses, the person in charge of emergency repair, professional workshop personnel, station personnel, etc. shall carry out emergency response according to the instructions of the on-site commander-in-chief. Responsibilities of the on-site headquarters

source_file: 运营突发事件综合应急预案-en-translation.txt
content: Carry out on-site emergency response command according to the plan; Organize the implementation of the decisions and tasks assigned by the emergency command center, and direct and coordinate the operation of various departments and external units of the branch to carry out emergency response work;

source_file: 运营突发事件综合应急预案-en-translation.txt
content: Organize rescue personnel to use emergency equipment and materials to take various measures to control the development of the situation and minimize casualties and property losses. Under the authorization of the emergency command center, the on-site headquarters has the right to mobilize various resources of the company to carry out

source_file: 运营突发事件综合应急预案-en-translation.txt
content: rescue and rescue work; Responsible for guiding and coordinating various specialties and external units to enter the scene to carry out rescue work, and provide convenience for them to carry out rescue work; Report the emergency scene to the emergency command center in a timely manner;

source_file: 运营突发事件综合应急预案-en-translation.txt
content: Resume rail transit line operation services as soon as possible. Emergency Organization and Responsibilities On-site Headquarters Emergency Working Group Personnel Evacuation Group The personnel transportation team is composed of the passenger transport department and the vehicle department.

source_file: 运营突发事件综合应急预案-en-translation.txt
content: The Passenger Transport Department is responsible for the emergency organization of passenger transport in trains, stations and other operating places. The team leader in Level I response is the person in charge of the Passenger Transport Department; in the case of Level II response, the team leader is the deputy of the Passenger Transport Department. Including:

source_file: 运营突发事件综合应急预案-en-translation.txt
content: Rescue of the wounded: responsible for the initial rescue of the injured at the scene of the incident and the setting up of the resettlement area for the wounded. Passenger transport organization: responsible for the implementation of passenger flow control, passenger evacuation, passenger guidance and explanation, station opening and closing

source_file: 运营突发事件综合应急预案-en-translation.txt
content: stations, etc. Reception and guidance: Responsible for receiving all foreign aid teams/units to enter the venue; Responsible for guiding and comforting passengers' families (including on-site and late arrivals). The vehicle department is responsible for train driving and passenger guidance in the train. The team leader in the case of level

source_file: 运营突发事件综合应急预案-en-translation.txt
content: I response is the person in charge of the vehicle department; in the case of level II response, the team leader is the deputy of the vehicle department. Including: monitor the operating status of the train and related driving equipment, and do a good job in train driving related operations;

source_file: 运营突发事件综合应急预案-en-translation.txt
content: Use train broadcasts to comfort passengers, guide passengers to deal with emergency rescue procedures, and guide passengers to carry out emergency evacuation in sections. If the scene of the incident is a depot or rail transit control center and there are injured, a separate team should be set up on

source_file: 运营突发事件综合应急预案-en-translation.txt
content: site to be responsible for the initial rescue of the wounded, and the commander-in-chief of the scene or the person designated by the highest person in charge of the site at that time shall serve as the team leader.

source_file: 运营突发事件综合应急预案-en-translation.txt
content: Emergency organization and responsibilities On-site headquarters Emergency working group Equipment emergency repair team It is composed of the relevant professional emergency repair team of the equipment management department to coordinate the maintenance unit. In the case of level I response, the team leader is the person in charge of the

source_file: 运营突发事件综合应急预案-en-translation.txt
content: equipment management department; in the case of level II response, the deputy position of the equipment management department is the deputy. Responsible for the emergency repair, monitoring, restoration and other work of vehicles, platform doors, ventilation and air conditioning, SCADA, ISCS, ACS, BAS, communication, signal, AFC, water supply and drainage,

source_file: 运营突发事件综合应急预案-en-translation.txt
content: low-voltage power distribution, transformer and distribution, catenary, lines, structures, housing construction and other facilities and equipment. Emergency organization and responsibilities On-site headquarters emergency working group Safety technical group It is composed of relevant personnel from the Quality and Safety Department and the Technical Contract Department, with the head of the

source_file: 运营突发事件综合应急预案-en-translation.txt
content: Quality and Safety Department and the deputy team leader being the head of the Technical Contract Department. The team leader is the deputy of the Quality and Safety Department and the deputy leader is the deputy of the Technical Contract Department.

source_file: 运营突发事件综合应急预案-en-translation.txt
content: Responsible for on-site investigation, evidence collection and analysis; Cooperate with the superior investigation team to carry out work. Responsible for leading all kinds of technical information and program support required at the scene of emergencies. Responsible for taking the lead in building the company's emergency outreach mechanism.

source_file: 运营突发事件综合应急预案-en-translation.txt
content: Emergency organization and responsibilities On-site headquarters Emergency working group Logistics support group It is composed of the General Management Department, the Material Management Department and the Financial Management Department. The team leader in the case of level I response is the head of the General Management Department; the team leader

source_file: 运营突发事件综合应急预案-en-translation.txt
content: in the case of level II response is the deputy position of the General Management Department. Responsible for the arrangement of rescue vehicles, food supply, material transportation, emergency fund support, etc. Emergency Organization and Responsibilities On-site Headquarters Emergency Working Group News Media Group

source_file: 运营突发事件综合应急预案-en-translation.txt
content: The General Management Department is responsible for online public opinion response, emergency publicity, and public opinion supervision in the event of emergencies. The team leader in the case of level I response is the head of the General Management Department; in the case of level II response, the team leader is the deputy of the General Management Department.

source_file: 运营突发事件综合应急预案-en-translation.txt
content: Emergency organization and responsibilities On-site headquarters Emergency working group expert group According to the characteristics and needs of emergencies, invite experts in driving, signaling, vehicles, power supply, tracks, fire protection, etc. when necessary to put forward decision-making suggestions and provide technical guidance on emergency response work.

source_file: 运营突发事件综合应急预案-en-translation.txt
content: Responsibilities of the Expert Group: Provide technical support for emergency preparedness, emergency response, emergency termination, recovery and reconstruction, incident impact assessment, etc., provide a basis for the decision-making of the emergency command center, and provide opinions for the determination of the implementation plan for on-site rescue and rescue;

source_file: 运营突发事件综合应急预案-en-translation.txt
content: Participate in incident investigations and provide opinions and suggestions. Emergency Organization and Responsibilities On-site Headquarters Emergency Working Group Aftermath Disposal Team The deputy general manager in charge of safety is the team leader, and all departments and maintenance units jointly form a working group. Responsible for aftermath matters including public

source_file: 运营突发事件综合应急预案-en-translation.txt
content: security management, personnel placement, insurance claims, compensation for requisitioned materials, and replenishment of rescue materials. Emergency Response Information Report The basic principles of operating emergency information reporting are fast, accurate, direct reporting, and continuous reporting, and the implementation of the "immediate reporting" system, and no department or individual shall report

source_file: 运营突发事件综合应急预案-en-translation.txt
content: late, falsely, conceal, omit, or misreport. Emergency Response Information Report Report Content The unit, location, and category of the accident/incident; the time, place and scene of the accident/incident; The initial cause of the accident/incident; Brief history of the accident/incident;

source_file: 运营突发事件综合应急预案-en-translation.txt
content: casualties (including disappearances and evacuations) and preliminary estimates of direct economic losses that have been or may be caused by accidents/events; The impact of the accident/incident on the surrounding environment and whether it caused environmental damage; measures already taken; matters requesting coordination and support;

source_file: 运营突发事件综合应急预案-en-translation.txt
content: The name, title and contact number of the reporter; Other situations that should be reported, and if new situations appear after the report, they shall be reported in a timely manner. Emergency Response Information Report Information Report

source_file: 运营突发事件综合应急预案-en-translation.txt
content: After various operational emergencies, on-site personnel such as stations, depots, and train drivers should report to OCC as soon as possible, and call 110, 120, and 119 rescue numbers as appropriate.

source_file: 运营突发事件综合应急预案-en-translation.txt
content: After receiving the information, OCC immediately verified the information, and notified the leaders of the operating branch, the heads of various departments, the maintenance units, the rescue team, and the internal group in the form of SMS publishing platform and telephone, and continuously updated the information.

source_file: 运营突发事件综合应急预案-en-translation.txt
content: After receiving various emergency information issued by the superior department, the duty officer immediately reported to the deputy general manager and conveyed it to the relevant departments in a timely manner.

source_file: 运营突发事件综合应急预案-en-translation.txt
content: After each department discovers or receives emergency information, according to the degree to which it may affect operations, according to the division of responsibilities, analyzes its occurrence, development trend and degree of harm, promptly puts forward corresponding emergency response suggestions to OCC, and makes a follow-up report on the on-site situation.

source_file: 运营突发事件综合应急预案-en-translation.txt
content: Before the emergency plan is activated, the OCC shall be subject to the information reported by the on-site personnel; after the emergency plan is activated, the OCC shall be subject to the information reported by the on-site headquarters. Emergency Response Information Report Information Report

source_file: 运营突发事件综合应急预案-en-translation.txt
content: When Level I and some Level II information occur (the specific report content is stipulated in Appendix C of the "Operational Emergency Information Notification Rules"), OCC will notify the information within the scope of the operating branch according to the process; the Quality and Safety Department will send a special person to OCC to learn more about the incident and report the initial report, follow-up report and treatment result to the group company. The initial report should be submitted by telephone and should be completed as soon as the incident occurs. The follow-up report shall be submitted in the form of oral report and written report, and will be reviewed by the leader in charge. If the incident continues to develop, it should be reported continuously (every 1-2 hours) until the incident is handled. The handling result report shall be reported after the accident emergency treatment is completed. The dispatch department is responsible for notifying the operation management center (digital center) of the group company; the quality and safety department is responsible for notifying the construction and safety department (internal security office) of the group company. In addition, other levels of information are released by the OCC in the emergency information notification group. The "Emergency Reporting Flow Chart" is described in Appendix F of the Comprehensive Emergency Plan for Operational Emergencies, and the Contact Information of Relevant Emergency Departments, Institutions or Personnel is shown in Appendix G of the Comprehensive Emergency Plan for Operational Emergencies.

source_file: 运营突发事件综合应急预案-en-translation.txt
content: In the event of an operational risk event, the person in charge or authorized person of the quality and safety department shall report to the operation management department of the group and the safety management department of the group, and the person in charge or authorized person of the dispatch department shall report to the operation and management department of the group. According to Article 5 of the Emergency Plan for Operation Emergencies of Municipal Railway Investment Group, the group shall report to the rail transit authority within 1 hour after receiving the incident report.

source_file: 运营突发事件综合应急预案-en-translation.txt
content: The content of the information report on operational risk events shall be implemented in accordance with the "Quick Report on Operational Risk Events for Urban Rail Transit Operations" (see Appendix A of the Comprehensive Emergency Plan for Operational Emergencies). Emergency Response Information Report Information Disposal and Judgment

source_file: 运营突发事件综合应急预案-en-translation.txt
content: According to the possible impact of the received information on the operation, the OCC analyzes its occurrence, development trend and degree of harm, and initiates the corresponding level of emergency response according to the incident classification standard, and completes the first SMS release of incident information within 5 minutes, and releases the information on a rolling basis according to the nature and impact of the incident.

source_file: 运营突发事件综合应急预案-en-translation.txt
content: If the conditions for response initiation are not met, the duty officer can make a decision on early warning activation and prepare for response after review and confirmation based on the opinions of professional departments.

source_file: 运营突发事件综合应急预案-en-translation.txt
content: When operational safety is endangered due to operational emergencies (including dangerous events), natural disasters, social security incidents and other reasons, the operating branch may first take measures to close the station or suspend the operation, and then report to the group company, which will report to the municipal urban rail transit operation department and other relevant departments.

source_file: 运营突发事件综合应急预案-en-translation.txt
content: The suspension standards and emergency measures are as follows: When the municipal prevention and control index launches the level I emergency response or emergency flood control period, organize the entire rail transit line to be suspended.

source_file: 运营突发事件综合应急预案-en-translation.txt
content: When the local meteorological department issues a red warning of heavy rain, the operating branch shall implement the speed limit of each train, strengthen the lookout and line patrol along the way, and stop the train operation as appropriate.

source_file: 运营突发事件综合应急预案-en-translation.txt
content: When the wind reaches level 9 or above, the ground or elevated track line is suspended to guide the evacuation of stranded passengers and transfer them to a safe area. Emergency Response Information Report Information Disposal and Judgment The suspension standards and emergency measures are as follows:

source_file: 运营突发事件综合应急预案-en-translation.txt
content: When the train is forced to stop on the flooded line and cannot be trained, the "Special Emergency Plan for Interval Evacuation" should be activated immediately, and passengers should be evacuated, and the ESC should immediately stop the power supply to the catenary.

source_file: 运营突发事件综合应急预案-en-translation.txt
content: When the water overflows the waist of the track, the driver immediately stops and reports to the line, and the train organizes the train to return to the departure station, evacuate the passengers, and the stopped train clears the passengers on the spot to withdraw from the service, and the subsequent train is prohibited from entering the waterlogged section.

source_file: 运营突发事件综合应急预案-en-translation.txt
content: When the water on the road outside the station entrance and exit is about to reach the first-level flood control warning line at the entrance and exit, and there is a continuous upward trend, the entrance and exit will be closed immediately and passengers will be guided to enter and exit the station from other entrances and exits.

source_file: 运营突发事件综合应急预案-en-translation.txt
content: When the number of station entrances and exits is closed more than 1/2; or the road outside the station is flooded in a large area, and the accumulated water overflows into the station through any location; or the rivers, lakes and reservoirs near the station have collapsed embankments; or the accumulated water overflows into the station through the evacuation channel and affects the operation of the station, the station immediately carries out the station closure procedure and releases information.

source_file: 运营突发事件综合应急预案-en-translation.txt
content: After the response is initiated, attention should be paid to tracking the development of the situation, scientific research and judgment, and adjusting the response level in a timely manner to avoid insufficient or excessive response. Emergency Response Information Report Media Information Release

source_file: 运营突发事件综合应急预案-en-translation.txt
content: In the event of an operational emergency (incident), the news media team shall write a press release according to the information circular of the OCC, and the general management department shall be responsible for the release of external information after review by the deputy general manager, general manager or their principal.

source_file: 运营突发事件综合应急预案-en-translation.txt
content: Emergency response monitoring and early warning monitoring Monitoring institutions: Each unit and department is the main department for daily monitoring and collecting information, and communicates and reports relevant information in a timely manner according to their respective responsibilities. Emergency response monitoring and early warning monitoring methods

source_file: 运营突发事件综合应急预案-en-translation.txt
content: Automatic monitoring of facilities and equipment. Through functional design and upgrading, the automatic monitoring and alarm function of bridges, tunnels, tracks, roadbeds and other facilities is realized; the equipment system function is used to realize automatic monitoring of the operation process, including train operation monitoring, power supply system operation monitoring, station and train environment monitoring, line status monitoring, building facility monitoring, fire risk monitoring, passenger flow monitoring, protected area monitoring, etc.

source_file: 运营突发事件综合应急预案-en-translation.txt
content: Manual inspection operations. Including station safety inspections, station personnel inspections, equipment room inspections, manual patrols in the rail area, etc. Third-party monitoring and evaluation. Hire a third-party professional monitoring and testing agency to verify the operating status of equipment and facilities, special work or overall management system.

source_file: 运营突发事件综合应急预案-en-translation.txt
content: Safety inspection and hidden danger investigation. By strengthening the inspection of systems, awareness, skills, equipment conditions, environmental risks and other aspects, possible hidden dangers are discovered in a timely manner, and rectification and control measures are proposed in a timely manner, and the monitoring and management of hidden dangers are strengthened to prevent accidents. The "Risk Assessment Results" are found in Appendix H of the Comprehensive Emergency Plan for Operational Emergencies.

source_file: 运营突发事件综合应急预案-en-translation.txt
content: Emergency Response, Monitoring and Early Warning, Early Warning According to the degree of harm, urgency and development trend of urban rail transit emergencies, the early warning level is divided into four levels: level IV (blue), level III (yellow), level II (orange), and level I (red) from low to high.

source_file: 运营突发事件综合应急预案-en-translation.txt
content: Each maintenance unit and department will respond according to the early warning response level, and set up an emergency rescue team, and report the duty list, duty location, contact information, equipment and facilities and emergency materials to the OCC.

source_file: 运营突发事件综合应急预案-en-translation.txt
content: During the early warning and response period, all departments and maintenance units report dynamic information to OCC every day, including the list and number of emergency response personnel, duty location, contact information, use and consumption of emergency materials, inspection and rescue and other information.

source_file: 运营突发事件综合应急预案-en-translation.txt
content: Early warning information is implemented in accordance with the principle of "who releases and who releases". When OCC receives early warning information (special meteorology, epidemic, anti-terrorism, etc.) issued by superior departments and group companies covering the company's jurisdiction, forwards emergency early warning response information, pays close attention, and releases early

source_file: 运营突发事件综合应急预案-en-translation.txt
content: warning change information in a timely manner. The internal release of the company's early warning information is in the form of SMS publishing platform, telephone, etc. The external release of early warning information is in the form of telephone, PIS information, announcements, broadcasting, newspapers or television media. The information content

source_file: 运营突发事件综合应急预案-en-translation.txt
content: should include the category of emergencies, early warning level, start time, possible impact scope, warning matters, etc. When the risk of causing an operational emergency has been lifted, the duty officer will announce the lifting of the warning according to the process and terminate the relevant measures in a timely

source_file: 运营突发事件综合应急预案-en-translation.txt
content: manner. Emergency Response Monitoring and Early Warning Response Preparation Level IV Early Warning Response Each department of the operation branch and the maintenance unit will arrange professional engineers or safety engineers, and each station of the line will arrange station managers and professional foremen to be on duty by telephone

source_file: 运营突发事件综合应急预案-en-translation.txt
content: (24 hours). All personnel on duty should keep communication open at all times and report early warning information to OCC. All stations and specialties on the line should strengthen the monitoring of on-site passenger flow at the station, investigate hidden dangers in key parts and rectify them in a timely

source_file: 运营突发事件综合应急预案-en-translation.txt
content: manner, and check that the on-site emergency equipment and materials are sufficient and effective. Emergency Response Monitoring and Early Warning Response Preparation Level III Early Warning Response On the basis of Level IV (blue) early warning, the leaders of the operation branch will be on duty (24 hours), and the

source_file: 运营突发事件综合应急预案-en-translation.txt
content: departments of the operation branch and maintenance unit will arrange professional engineers or safety engineers, station managers, professional foremen and other stations on site duty (24 hours). All personnel on duty should keep communication open at all times and report the early warning information to OCC.

source_file: 运营突发事件综合应急预案-en-translation.txt
content: Report incident information to the superior unit and request support if necessary. Strengthen inspections and make preparations for emergency response and rescue. Emergency Response Monitoring and Early Warning Response Preparation Level II Early Warning Response

source_file: 运营突发事件综合应急预案-en-translation.txt
content: On the basis of the yellow warning, according to the nature of the incident and the severity of the impact of the fault, the general manager of the operation branch (or the designated vice president) will be on duty (24 hours), and the person in charge of the maintenance unit and the head of the relevant department will be on duty (24 hours).

source_file: 运营突发事件综合应急预案-en-translation.txt
content: Carry out emergency response preparations according to relevant special emergency plans, and increase the frequency of inspections at the scene of the incident. Take response measures to prevent the occurrence or expansion of the situation, and put the emergency work on alert.

source_file: 运营突发事件综合应急预案-en-translation.txt
content: Emergency Response Monitoring and Early Warning Response Preparation Level I early warning response On the basis of the orange warning, the general manager (or assigned vice president) of the operation branch is on duty (24 hours), and the production department and the maintenance professional emergency rescue team are on standby

source_file: 运营突发事件综合应急预案-en-translation.txt
content: at any time. All stations and professional personnel on duty on the line have been involved in emergency rescue, and the disaster locations in the area under their jurisdiction have been investigated and rectified one by one. Emergency response response initiation Initial response

source_file: 运营突发事件综合应急预案-en-translation.txt
content: If the response initiation conditions have been met, the emergency plan will be activated immediately, and the command structure personnel at all levels will respond according to the activation level, and each department will implement the response procedures in the special emergency plan or on-site disposal plan.

source_file: 运营突发事件综合应急预案-en-translation.txt
content: In the early stage of the emergency (incident), the duty director is responsible for the overall command, and the stationmaster on duty at the station where the incident occurred, the stationmaster on duty at the adjacent station in the incident section, the field adjustment of the incident depot, and the train driver of the incident are the commander-in-chief of the scene, and the name, position and contact information of the on-site commander-in-chief are released through the SMS publishing platform. OCC notifies the production dispatch, and the production dispatch notifies the person in charge of equipment emergency repair to arrive at the scene to carry out rescue work.

source_file: 运营突发事件综合应急预案-en-translation.txt
content: The on-site commander-in-chief is responsible for carrying out the initial emergency repair work, and timely reports the on-site information to the relevant on-duty scheduling, and the duty director is responsible for the initial emergency command decision-making, driving organization, information release and resource allocation according to the on-site feedback information and rescue needs.

source_file: 运营突发事件综合应急预案-en-translation.txt
content: After the occurrence of an emergency (incident), the professionals who arrive immediately are the person in charge of emergency repair, and do a good job in the collection of on-site fault information, feedback, request, and sales point for emergency rescue. Emergency response response initiation Change and handover of on-site commands

source_file: 运营突发事件综合应急预案-en-translation.txt
content: In principle, the commander-in-chief of the site shall be the highest leader of the position who arrives at the scene, and if the position is the same, the head of the key professional department for on-site emergency repair and disposal shall be appointed.

source_file: 运营突发事件综合应急预案-en-translation.txt
content: After the on-site commander-in-chief at the higher level arrives at the scene, he and the current on-site commander-in-chief will hand over the on-site command authority, and inform the on-site disposal situation, and at the same time transfer the on-site disposal command authority to the emergency command center, and the emergency command center will release the on-site command and liaison personnel information (name, telephone, major) through the SMS release platform.

source_file: 运营突发事件综合应急预案-en-translation.txt
content: In order to ensure the coherence of the on-site emergency response organization and avoid problems such as information deviation caused by frequent personnel turnover, the on-site command should not be changed multiple times. Emergency response response initiation emergency response

source_file: 运营突发事件综合应急预案-en-translation.txt
content: After the emergency response is launched, in principle, personnel at all levels who respond by hierarchical response should rush to the scene of emergency agencies at all levels in time in accordance with the provisions of the plan.

source_file: 运营突发事件综合应急预案-en-translation.txt
content: After arriving at the scene, personnel at all levels shall report to the command post at the higher level according to the command structure of hierarchical response, and organize and implement the on-site disposal work according to the order of the superior command. Before the superior disposal plan is determined, stand by at the designated location, and the person in charge of the professional emergency repair team should grasp the on-site situation as soon as possible and prepare to accept the task.

source_file: 运营突发事件综合应急预案-en-translation.txt
content: In principle, the chief commander of the emergency command center and the on-site commander shall not be far from their posts, and if they must leave due to on-site disposal needs, they must keep their handheld desks and telephones unblocked.

source_file: 运营突发事件综合应急预案-en-translation.txt
content: In the whole on-site disposal process, the emergency command structure implements a single command from the top down, and the report of on-site personnel implements bottom-up level-by-level reporting, and no leapfrog command or leapfrog reporting is allowed.

source_file: 运营突发事件综合应急预案-en-translation.txt
content: Changes to the emergency repair implementation plan must be approved by the on-site headquarters and reported to the emergency command center. When the scene of the emergency needs to be blocked due to the investigation of the incident, the on-site headquarters requests the rail public security to block the scene,

source_file: 运营突发事件综合应急预案-en-translation.txt
content: and no other personnel are allowed to enter the blocked emergency scene except for the relevant rescue and rescue and accident investigators. Emergency response response initiation disposal measures Driving organization

source_file: 运营突发事件综合应急预案-en-translation.txt
content: According to the situation at the scene of the emergency and the requirements of the passenger transport organization, actively adopt methods such as detention, train tripping, operation interchange and train operation mode adjustment to adjust the train operation plan within the scope of the emergency in a timely manner, ensure the safety and orderliness of train operation, reduce the impact of emergencies on the driving organization as much as possible, and prevent and deal with other derivative accidents that may occur.

source_file: 运营突发事件综合应急预案-en-translation.txt
content: Timely implement train operation safety protection measures and related facilities and equipment adjustments, focusing on train safety operation intervals and catenary power cuts. Timely do a good job in real-time monitoring of train operation adjustment, and deploy internal and external support forces according to the situation to ensure safe and

source_file: 运营突发事件综合应急预案-en-translation.txt
content: orderly train operation. emergency response response initiation disposal measures passenger transport organization Actively do a good job in self-safety protection and early first aid assistance for casualties, and reduce the losses caused by emergencies to personnel safety as much as possible.

source_file: 运营突发事件综合应急预案-en-translation.txt
content: According to the situation at the scene of the emergency and the adjustment and cooperation requirements of the driving organization, the personnel evacuation team timely did a good job in the evacuation and guidance of the scene of the incident, personnel flow restriction, ticket processing, bus connection and other passenger transport organization, and guided passengers to evacuate the scene of the incident in an organized and orderly manner.

source_file: 运营突发事件综合应急预案-en-translation.txt
content: Emergency response response start disposal measures equipment emergency repair Start the level I and II emergency response, and the person in charge or deputy of the equipment management department organizes the professional emergency repair team of the facilities and equipment to carry out emergency repair, monitoring, restoration and other work.

source_file: 运营突发事件综合应急预案-en-translation.txt
content: Professional engineers from the equipment management department immediately rushed to the scene of the incident. After receiving the emergency repair order, the captain of the professional emergency repair team immediately mobilized professional emergency repair personnel and equipment to choose the best route to the scene of the incident.

source_file: 运营突发事件综合应急预案-en-translation.txt
content: After receiving the emergency plan or the emergency repair order of the captain of the professional emergency repair team, the backbone of the professional emergency repair team and relevant duty personnel in the area shall rush to the scene within 20 minutes to participate in the initial disposal in principle, and the members of the professional emergency repair team in the adjacent area or depot shall rush to the scene within 30 minutes in principle. After receiving the information, the off-duty personnel of the professional emergency repair team immediately rushed to the scene under the condition of going to the scene of the incident.

source_file: 运营突发事件综合应急预案-en-translation.txt

content: Wenzhou is a central subtropical monsoon climate zone, with significant alternating winter and summer monsoons, moderate temperatures, four distinct seasons, and abundant rainfall. source_file: 运营突发事件综合应急预案-en-translation.txt
content: According to potential dangers, existing conditions and triggers, the company's safety risk sources can be divided into four types: personnel factors, facilities and equipment factors, environmental factors and management factors.

source_file: 运营突发事件综合应急预案-en-translation.txt
content: 1. Personnel factor. Personnel factors are the control factors for rail transit operation and production safety, especially in key positions such as driving command and train driving, which may directly cause the occurrence of various safety accidents due to people's safety awareness paralysis, unsafe behaviors and illegal operations.

source_file: 运营突发事件综合应急预案-en-translation.txt
content: 2. Facilities and equipment factors. It mainly includes five major factors: vehicle system factors, line system factors, power supply system factors, electromechanical system factors and communication signal system factors, and the risk sources of each factor mainly include:

source_file: 运营突发事件综合应急预案-en-translation.txt
content: (1) Vehicle system factors: mechanical failures, electrical failures, brake failures, door failures and other factors may cause train derailments, train fires, train collisions and other accidents, or cause secondary accidents such as crowding stampedes;

source_file: 运营突发事件综合应急预案-en-translation.txt
content: (2) Line system factors: Factors such as line breakage, deformation of expanding rail, damage to turnouts, and disease of track beds may cause train delays, speed limits, suspensions, etc., and may even cause accidents such as train derailments;

source_file: 运营突发事件综合应急预案-en-translation.txt
content: (3) Power supply system factors: traction power supply system failure, catenary/contact rail failure, power supply system failure and other factors may cause large-scale power outages, operation interruptions, fire accidents, etc.;

source_file: 运营突发事件综合应急预案-en-translation.txt
content: (4) Mechanical and electrical system factors: elevators/escalators, AFC systems, platform doors, ventilation systems, lighting systems, water supply and drainage systems, FAS, BAS, fire extinguishing system failures and other factors may cause casualties, operational order disorder, fire accidents, etc.;

source_file: 运营突发事件综合应急预案-en-translation.txt
content: (5) Communication signal system factors: Factors such as trackside or on-board signaling equipment failures, turnout control failures, signal interlock failures, and interruptions of the dispatching and command system may cause train conflicts, loss of operation command control, and chaos in operation order.

source_file: 运营突发事件综合应急预案-en-translation.txt
content: 3. Environmental factors. It mainly includes three categories: natural environmental factors, operating environmental factors and social environmental factors, and the risk sources of each factor mainly include: (1) Natural environmental factors: including bad weather, floods, earthquakes, etc., which may lead to rail transit suspension, equipment failure, infrastructure damage, etc.;

source_file: 运营突发事件综合应急预案-en-translation.txt
content: (2) Operating environment factors: including rail transit vehicles, stations, and commercial spaces are relatively closed, narrow, densely populated, and highly mobile, which may lead to rapid spread of emergencies, high danger, difficulty in evacuating personnel, and difficulty in on-site control.

source_file: 运营突发事件综合应急预案-en-translation.txt
content: (3) Social and environmental factors, including unsafe riding/waiting behavior of passengers, man-made destruction of station/train facilities and equipment, and terrorist attacks, may lead to damage to operating equipment, interruption of operation, and casualties of passengers.

source_file: 运营突发事件综合应急预案-en-translation.txt
content: 4. Management factors. Imperfect management system and inadequate management work may lead to safety problems in personnel, operations, facilities and equipment. In order to standardize the hierarchical control of safety risks and the investigation and management of hidden dangers in the operation branch, comprehensively improve the overall pre-control ability of

source_file: 运营突发事件综合应急预案-en-translation.txt
content: safety production, and continue to investigate and eliminate potential safety hazards, in accordance with the "Management Measures for the Hierarchical Control of Safety Risks and the Investigation and Management of Hidden Dangers in Urban Rail Transit Operations", combined with the actual situation of the operating branch, the dynamic management of
